The Andaman & Nicobar Administration, Directorate of Sports & Youth Affairs has released the official notification for Khelo India State Centre of Excellence Recruitment 2026 under the Khelo India Scheme. Candidates looking for government sports jobs in 2026 can apply for multiple contractual positions including High Performance Manager, Head Coach, Physiotherapist Grade-1, Nutritionist, Strength & Conditioning Expert, Masseur and Young Professional. The application process is completely offline, and eligible candidates must submit the prescribed application format before the closing date. This recruitment offers attractive monthly remuneration and an opportunity to work at the Netaji Sports Complex, Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

  • Qualification: Matriculation pass or equivalent from recognized Board with proficiency in Barber's trade job.

  • 18 to 25 Years.
  • Person with Benchmark Disability: Age relaxation of 10 years (15 years for SC/ST and 13 years for OBC candidates) in upper age limit shall be allowed to persons with disabilities.
  • Ex-ServicIndian Army DG EMEn (ESM): For ESM, resultant age after deducting period of service from actual age should not exceed prescribed age limit by more than 3 years. Calculation of age shall be as per the category for which the application has been made.
  • Departmental candidates: Departmental candidate with three years continuous service in Central Govt will be given age relaxation up to 40 years of age (45 years for SC/ST)

Important Dates

Last date for receipt of application 21 days (including Sundays and holidays) from the date of publication of the advertisIndian Army DG EMEnt in the Employment News and 28 days (including Sundays and holidays) for those in Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Ladakh Division of Jammu & Kashmir State, Lahaul and Spiti Districts and Pangi Sub-Division of Chamba District of Himachal Pradesh, Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep. First date of this advertisIndian Army DG EMEnt in the Employment Newspaper will be taken into account for calculating 21/28 days. If closing date falls on holidays, then next working day will be taken as closing date for receipt of application.

Selection Process

  • Written test will be offline (Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) based) and "Objective Type" for 150 marks with Negative Marking of 0.25 mark for each wrong answer. Duration of examination is two hours. Question paper will be in bilingual i.e. English and Hindi and the syllabus will be in accordance to minimum qualification prescribed for the post at Para 2. Question paper will be "Multiple Choice Question" as under:-
  • Part-I: General Intelligence & Reasoning (50 Questions, 50 Marks)
  • Part-II: General Awareness (50 Questions, 50 Marks)
  • Part-III: General English (25 Questions, 25 Marks)
  • Part-IV: Numerical Aptitude (25 Questions, 25 Marks)
  • Skill test and Physical test (wherever applicable) will be conducted for candidates who pass the written test and come in merit. Skill test and Physical test (wherever applicable) will be qualifying in nature and the candidates who fail to qualify Skill/Physical test shall not be eligible for selection.

General Information / Instructions

  • The number of vacancies is subject to change. Further, the employer has the right to cancel or modify notification without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Abbreviations used: UR- Un-reserved
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply against unreserved post will not be given age relaxation and other concession meant for SC/ST/OBC.
  • The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the last date of receipt of application.
  • The age relaxation will be applied only in case of those candidates who produce valid certificate(s) of caste/category.
  • Date of Birth filled in by the candidate in application form and the same recorded in the matriculation examination certificate will be considered for determining the age and no subsequent request will be accepted.
  • Posts mentioned above are subject to "All India Transfer Liability and Field Service Liability Rules". Candidates selected may be posted to any "Unit or Location" depending on the organisational interest. No representation will be entertained.
  • Persons working in Central Govt/State Govt/PSUs must provide the "NOC" document obtained through the competent authority of his/her present organization to Recruitment Agency at the time of selection.
  • Application(s) will be shortlisted on the basis of percentage of marks obtained in the Essential Qualification referred at Para 2 and Admit cards will be issued accordingly. No weightage will be given for additional/ higher qualification.
  • Merely fulfilling the essential qualification does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test.
  • Admit card will NOT be issued in case of rejection/ late receipt of applications. Candidates will not be intimated in case of rejection of their application and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • Incomplete/ Eligible application will be deIndian Army DG EMEd invalid and rejected without intimation to the candidate.
  • Application(s) without DAVP advertisIndian Army DG EMEnt reference number will not be accepted.
  • No man who has more than one wife living and no woman who has more than one husband living, shall be eligible for appointment.
  • Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidature. No enquiry or correspondence will be entertained.
  • The selection board shall not be responsible for any lapse on the part of the candidate in this regard. Candidates are responsible for providing all factually correct data and correct certificates/documents. Providing factually incorrect data, fake certificates/documents for providing incomplete certificates/documents by the candidates will result in automatic rejection of his/her candidature.
  • Date of Document Verification, Written Examination and Skill Test for Barber trade as applicable will be intimated via admit card sent through ORDINARY POST in the envelope provided by the candidate alongwith the application and it should remain valid for the future communication. "Place of Work" and location for tests may be same i.e. Static Wksp Indian Army DG EME, Minnie Bay, Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
  • Date & Place of written examination for each trade will be intimated through admit card.
  • The selection committee has discretion to fix minimum qualifying marks in any or all parts of papers.
  • No Transportation Allowance/Dearness Allowance will be admissible. Examination including written / skill test / physical test (where applicable) will be for TWO (02) to FIVE (05) days or more days and may spread across different dates. Candidates will have to make their own arrangIndian Army DG EMEnt for lodging/boarding during conduct of all types of examination.
  • Candidates are required to carry "Admit Card" along with identity proof (either Passport, Aadhar card, PAN Card, Driving Licence) for confirmation while reporting for the document verification, physical test (where applicable), written test and skill test. Aadhar Card prepared more than 10 years ago will not be accepted and identity proof should have same name as given in the application.
  • Bio-metric will be done on first day and subsequent days of reporting of the candidate for the documents verification and written test/ Skill Test/ Physical Test.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation and re-checking of the scores. No correspondence in this regard will be entertained. The decision of appointing authority regarding selection/rejection will be final.

How to Apply

  • Candidates to forward application as per prescribed format given in the advertisIndian Army DG EMEnt alongwith a self-addressed envelope (size-10.5 cm x 25 cm) with postal stamp of Rs 5/- properly sealed in an envelope to the address mentioned against the post applied for through ORDINARY POST. Candidates are requested to superscribe the words "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF "BARBER" on the top of the envelope while sending the application form.
  • Candidates are allowed to apply at one location and applications once submitted cannot be modified under any circumstance. No application will be received by hand.

Candidates must satisfy the following educational requirements:

  • Master of Dental Surgery (MDS).
  • Post Graduate Dental degree (MDS) from a Dental college/Institution recognized by Dental Council of India (DCI).
  • Must have A.P. State Dental Council Registration.

Local Candidature:

  • A candidate who studied at least 4 years from 4th to 10th in Andhra Pradesh.

Eligibility Criteria

  • For Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) - Post Code 3/26:
    • Class XII pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
    • Typing Speed test of 35 words per minute on computer (35 words per minute corresponds to 10500 Key Depression per hour - KDPH on an average of 5 Key Depression for each word)
  • For Driver - Post Code 4/26:
    • Class X/ITI or equivalent pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
  • Minimum Qualifying Service for LDC & JSA:
    • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) of the concerned Department with 8 (Eight) years of regular service in the grade, and possessing Class-XII pass certificate from a recognized Board/Institution, OR
    • Skilled Contingency Staff with minimum of 12 (Twelve) years of continuous service as skilled contingency in the concerned Department/office and possess educational qualification of Class-XII pass certificate from a recognized Board/Institution
  • Minimum Qualifying Service for Driver:
    • Contingency skilled driver who possess Class X/ITI or equivalent pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution with 10 (Ten) years of service in the concerned Department/Office, OR
    • Handyman who possess Class X/ITI or equivalent pass Certificate from a recognized Board/Institution with 6 (Six) years of regular service in the concerned Department/Office
  • General Eligibility:
    • The candidate must be a citizen of India
    • The educational qualification, required length of service, age, category as stipulated shall be determined as on the closing date of submission of application i.e. 25-02-2026
    • The name of the candidate should be in the certified list of eligible candidates submitted by the HoD/HoO

  • For Driver (Post Code 4/26):
    • Not applicable (eligibility determined by the Departments)

Category Fee Amount
APST Candidates Rs. 150
General Candidates Rs. 200
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) Nil (Exempt)
  • Payment Mode: Online only
  • The application fee is non-refundable

Important Dates

Event Date
Opening Date of Application 12/02/2026 (Thursday)
Closing Date of Application 25/02/2026 (03:00 PM) (Wednesday)
Tentative Date of Written Examination 29/03/2026 (Sunday)

Selection Process

  • For LDC (Post Code 2/26) & JSA (Post Code 3/26):
    • Stage-I (Written Examination): Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions - 200 Marks, Duration: 2 Hours
      • General Awareness: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • Test of English Language and Comprehension: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 33% aggregate marks in the written examination paper
    • Stage-II (Skill Test): Typing Speed Test of 35 words per minute on computer (10500 KDPH). The Typing Test is of qualifying nature only and marks will not be counted for final merit
  • For Driver (Post Code 4/26):
    • Stage-I (Written Examination): Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions - 200 Marks, Duration: 2 Hours
      • General Awareness: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Test of English Language and Comprehension: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Technical Paper: 100 marks (50 questions of 2 marks each)
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 33% aggregate in both the papers separately i.e., for Common Paper and Technical Paper
    • Stage-II (Driving Test): Qualifying nature only. Candidate shall produce a valid Driving License for appearing in the Driving Test
  • Shortlisting for Stage-2: The total number of candidates shortlisted for Stage 2 will be in 1:3 ratio (if total vacancies are 10, then 30 candidates will be shortlisted)
  • Final Merit List: Will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in written examination only. Marks in Skill Test/Driving Test will not be counted but candidates must qualify
  • Note: There is no negative marking in the examination

General Information/Instructions

  • Application Mode: Only online applications will be accepted. Applications received through any other mode shall be summarily rejected
  • Login Credentials: Login credentials will be sent to eligible candidates through e-mail & SMS to their respective e-mail addresses and mobile numbers furnished by their Departments/Offices
  • Eligibility Determination: APSSB will not entertain any representations from candidates with regards to eligibility and the same shall be determined solely by the concerned Head of Department/Office
  • Provisional Candidature: Candidature of applicants shall be purely PROVISIONAL at all stages of the recruitment process
  • Examination Centre: The Centre for the examination will be ITANAGAR
  • ID Proof Requirement: Candidate will have to provide a valid Aadhar Card/Government authorized Photo Identity Card. They will have to carry the same ID card in original along with the admit card to the Examination Centre
  • Prohibited Items: Use of Calculator, Laptop, Palmtop, other digital instrument/Mobile/Cell Phone/Pager/Electronic watches etc. is not allowed. Candidates found in possession of any such gadget will be debarred from examination
  • Admit Card: Individual Admit cards will not be sent to candidates and have to be downloaded from the website www.apssb.nic.in
  • Vacancy Status: The vacancies published are provisional and subject to change. In case the vacancy position is reduced or withdrawn by the user department, the Board shall not be liable to compensate the applicant
  • No Re-evaluation: There is no provision of re-evaluation/re-checking of Answer sheet/Answer scripts
  • Board's Rights: The Board reserves the right to reject candidature at any stage, cancel part or entire examination process, change examination scheme, conduct medical test for PwBD candidates, and make any amendments as deemed necessary
  • Scribe Facility for PwBD: Facility of scribe will be provided to eligible PwBD/PwD candidates as per Government guidelines. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination will be provided to persons allowed use of scribe
  • Multiple Applications: In case an applicant applies multiple forms for the same post, only the latest application form shall be considered by APSSB
  • Malpractice Action: Candidates found involved in violating guidelines, impersonation, using unfair means, submitting fabricated documents etc. will face strict action including police action, FIR lodging and debarment from all future APSSB examinations
  • Final Selection: The Board makes provisional selection and recommends to the Indenting/User Department. The Appointing Authority verifies and satisfies about authenticity of documents before finally appointing the candidate

How to Apply

  • Eligible departmental candidates are required to apply online only through the website www.apssb.nic.in using their unique login credentials/passwords
  • Login credentials will be sent to eligible candidates' respective mobile numbers & e-mail IDs by their departments
  • Application period: 12-02-2026 to 25-02-2026 (03:00 PM)
  • Only those candidates who have been certified as eligible by their Head of Department are eligible to apply
  • Documents to be scanned and uploaded at time of online application:
    • Scanned signature of the candidate on white paper with black ink pen (10-50 kb in jpg/jpeg/png format)
    • Latest/recent passport size photo (50-100 kb in jpg/jpeg/png format)
  • Documents to be submitted during Document Verification:
    • Recent passport size Photograph (2 copies)
    • Matriculation certificates/II issued by the Board/Institute for proof of date of birth
    • Class XII pass certificate & marksheet issued from a recognized Board/University
    • APST Certificate (if applicable)
    • Valid Driving License (for Driver post)
    • Print out of Admit Card
    • Any other documents as may be relevant
  • Shortlisted candidates will have to produce above-mentioned Certificates/Documents in original during Document Verification failing which candidature will be summarily rejected
  • The applicants are advised to fill up the application form carefully. They will not be allowed to edit/modify the details after the closing date
  • Application with incomplete or invalid details will be summarily rejected
  • Candidates are advised to keep track of the Board website www.apssb.nic.in for any latest information related to the examination
  • No request for change in date, time and centre of exam will be accepted under any circumstances

Eligibility Criteria

  • Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical)
    • Essential Qualification: Post graduate degree including integrated PG degree in Life Science/ Pharmacology or allied subjects from a recognized university.
    • Desirable Qualification:
      1. Candidates who have qualified NET/GATE or an equivalent examination.
      2. Those possessing hands-on experience in Molecular biology techniques such as RT-PCR & genome sequencing, LCMS/HPLC techniques.
      3. At least 1 year of experience in health research preferably involving hospital-based study.
      4. Prior experience in ICMR/DST/DBT/other funded projects
      5. Knowledge of data analysis using SPSS/Stata/R.
      6. Familiarity with ICMR ethical guidelines, GCP and project coordination and fluency in English, Hindi and Punjabi
      7. Good communication and team coordination skills in managing hospital level liaison.
  • Project Technical Support III
    • Essential Qualification: Post Graduate degree in Life Sciences/Pharmacology or allied subjects from a recognized university or Bachelor's degree in Pharmacology/Life sciences or allied subjects from a recognized university with three years of experience.
    • Desirable Qualification:
      1. Preference will be given to candidates having hands on experience in LCMS/HPLC technique and molecular biology techniques.
      2. Knowledge of Biostatistics and Bioinformatic analysis.
      3. Familiarity with ICMR ethical guidelines, GCP and project coordination and fluency in English, Hindi and Punjabi

Salary/ Stipend

  • Emoluments per month: As per ICMR rules.

Age Limit (as on 10-02-2026)

  • Relaxation will be given as per rules

Important Dates

Last Date for Submission of Application 10-02-2026, 5:00PM

Selection Process

  • Shortlisted candidates shall be invited to appear for interview along with original certificates/ degrees/ marksheets.

General Information / Instructions

  • The engagement in the project is purely on a temporary basis maximum for the period of duration of the project.
  • However, appointments will initially be offered for a period of one year and to be extended on a yearly basis depending upon satisfactory performance and co-terminus with the project.
  • Please note that it is not a PGIMER/ICMR appointment and will not confer any right on the incumbent to any claim implicit or explicit on any position.
  • The correspondence will be through email and/or mobile phone. It is the responsibility of the candidate to ensure that the provided contact details are legible and correct.
  • No separate interview letters will be sent. No TA/DA will be paid.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Blood Transfusion Officer (Level-11; Age 18–35 years): Recognized medical qualification included in I or II Schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956; five years’ experience in Blood Bank work after registration as Medical Graduate; registration with a State Medical Council.
  • Store Keeper (Level-6; Age 18–30 years): Bachelor degree in Maths/Economics/Commerce/Statistics and MBA/Postgraduate in Maths/Economics/Commerce/Statistics/Finance from a recognized University with at least 50% marks.
  • Junior Engineer (Civil/Electrical/Refrigeration & Air Conditioning/Horticulture) (Level-6; Age 18–30 years): Degree in respective branch of Engineering OR minimum three years diploma in respective branch of Engineering from a recognized Institute.
  • Pharmacist Grade-II (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or its equivalent; Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognized Institution/Board; registered Pharmacist under Pharmacy Act, 1948. Desirable: Degree in Pharmacy and experience in dispensing and/or storage and dispensing of drugs in a reputed hospital/Institution or pharmaceutical concern.
  • Receptionist (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Degree from a recognized University; Postgraduate diploma in journalism/Public relations. Desirable: Experience in public relations/publications/printing/publishing; exposure to working on Personal Computer.
  • Sanitary Inspector Grade-II (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; certificate of Sanitary Inspector course from a recognized Institution; at least four years’ experience in the line preferably in a hospital of repute.
  • Junior Photographer (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; Diploma in Photography from a recognized Institute; two years’ experience in Photography in a teaching Institute/Hospital OR Matriculation and five years’ experience in Medical Photography in a teaching Institute/Hospital.
  • Dental Mechanic Grade-II (Level-4; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric with Science; Dental Mechanic course of two years duration from a recognized Dental Institution approved by Dental Council of India. Desirable: Two years’ experience as Dental Mechanic; special training/experience in crown and bridge chrome cobalt, myofunctional orthodontic appliances.
  • Hand Prosthesis Technician (Level-4; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation; Diploma from I.T.I. or equivalent in trade of turner, fitter or metal worker with five years’ experience in making and fitting splints, braces or appliances for disabled people.
  • Dark Room Assistant Grade-III (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; Diploma or certificate in Radiography of minimum one year duration from a recognized Institution. Desirable: One year’s experience as Dark Room Assistant in a hospital.
  • Animal Keeper (Level-2; Age 18–30 years): Matric with Science and two years’ experience in breeding and keeping of animals preferably in a medical or research Institution.
  • CSR Assistant Grade-II (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric with Science and certificate course of Operation Theatre Assistant of one year duration from this Institute. Desirable: Diploma in Operation Theatre Techniques.
  • Technician Grade-IV (Manifold Room/Plant) (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric/10th Standard with ITI certificate in the respective trade OR Matric with trade certificate from a recognized Institute/Board/authority with five years’ experience in the trade where ITI certificate is not available.
  • Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; valid Driving Licence for driving heavy vehicles; knowledge of motor mechanism and ability to remove minor defects; three years’ experience of driving motor vehicles (including heavy vehicles). Desirable: Three years’ service as Home Guard/Civil Volunteer.
  • Laboratory Attendant Grade-II (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: 10th class pass (with Science as one of the subjects) from a recognized Board. Desirable: Experience in Medical Laboratory.
  • Technician Grade-I (Laundry) (Level-1; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation; ITI in respective trade with two years’ experience in the trade.
  • Security Guard Grade-II (Level-1; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation from a recognized Board/University (relaxable up to Middle Standard pass for certain Ex-servicemen); prescribed physical standards and qualifying Physical Efficiency Test as detailed in the guidelines. Desirable: Service in Armed Forces/Para-Military Forces/Police; experience of performing security duties, preferably in a hospital of repute.

Salary/Stipend

  • Blood Transfusion Officer: Level-11 (Rs. 67,700 – 2,08,700/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Store Keeper and all Junior Engineer posts: Level-6 (Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Pharmacist Grade-II, Receptionist, Sanitary Inspector Grade-II, Junior Photographer: Level-5 (Rs. 29,200 – 92,300/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Dental Mechanic Grade-II and Hand Prosthesis Technician: Level-4 (Rs. 25,500 – 81,100/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Dark Room Assistant Grade-III, Animal Keeper, CSR Assistant Grade-II, Technician Grade-IV (Manifold Room/Plant), Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade, Laboratory Attendant Grade-II: Level-2 (Rs. 19,900 – 63,200/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Technician Grade-I (Laundry) and Security Guard Grade-II: Level-1 (Rs. 18,000 – 56,900/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.

Age Limit 

  • For Blood Transfusion Officer: 18–35 years.
  • For all other advertised posts: 18–30 years.
  • Upper age limit shall be determined as on the last date of submission of online application form i.e. 16.02.2026.
  • Permissible relaxations in upper age limit for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, Central Govt. Civilian Employees, Ex-Servicemen, Widows/Divorced women/women judicially separated and not remarried, candidates domiciled in J&K, Defence personnel disabled, Service Clerks and permanent employees of PGIMER are as per detailed table in the guidelines.

Application Fee

  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Exempted from payment of application fee.
  • SC/ST category candidates: Rs. 800/- plus Transaction Charges as applicable.
  • All others including General/OBC/EWS candidates: Rs. 1500/- plus Transaction Charges as applicable.
  • Application fee is to be deposited through online payment gateway available at the application portal using Debit/Credit Card/Net Banking (payment through UPI may be avoided).
  • The cost of Application Form includes the fee for the Computer Based Test and is non-refundable.

Important Dates

Item / Activity Timeline / Remarks
Opening date for online registration for filling up of online application on PGIMER’s website (Recruitment link at Home Page) 01.01.2026
Closing date for online registration & submission of online applications 16.02.2026
Crucial date for determining eligibility w.r.t. essential qualification(s), age and experience 16.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates who successfully submit online applications will appear in an online Computer Based Test (CBT) conducted in English language only, on an all-India basis.
  • For Group ‘A’ posts: CBT of 85 MCQs (85 marks) and Interview of 15 marks; total 100 marks with minimum qualifying criteria of 40% (General/EWS) and 35% (SC/ST/OBC).
  • For Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts: CBT of 100 MCQs (100 marks) with minimum qualifying criteria of 40% (General/EWS) and 35% (SC/ST/OBC); no interview for Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts.
  • There will be negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in CBT.
  • Shortlisting will be done post-CBT for scrutiny of applications and document verification, using candidate-wise merit and prescribed ratios (3× or 5× of posts as applicable).
  • For Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade and Security Guard Grade-II, shortlisted candidates must qualify Trade Test/Physical Efficiency Test as per parameters given in the guidelines.
  • Final selection will be based purely on merit: marks in CBT for Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts, and CBT plus Interview for Group ‘A’ posts, subject to verification of documents and eligibility conditions.

General Information/Instructions

  • Information relating to this recruitment including Addendum/Corrigendum, CBT notice, results, eligibility notice, provisional and final results will be displayed only on PGIMER’s website; no individual intimation will be sent.
  • All applicants must read the Guidelines and Help Manual carefully before online registration and ensure that no column is left blank and all entries are correct; once submitted, entries cannot be changed.
  • Candidature of applicants is purely provisional at all stages and may be cancelled if eligibility conditions are not met or incorrect information is found at any stage, even after appointment.
  • Incomplete applications, applications without requisite documents, applications where fee is not paid properly, or where eligibility/age criteria are not met, are liable to be rejected without correspondence.
  • No offline application form or copy of downloaded application form will be accepted by PGIMER.
  • Roll Numbers/Admit Cards for the CBT will be available online only and must be downloaded from the website; they will not be sent by post.
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in document verification or further stages of recruitment.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the applicant; candidates must be in good mental and bodily health as per medical examination requirements.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must visit PGIMER website (www.pgimer.edu.in), check the advertisement and confirm their eligibility before applying online.
  • Applicants should have a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, which must remain active throughout the recruitment process; these are required for initial registration and communication.
  • Candidates must first complete online registration by filling mandatory details like Advertisement Number, Date, Name (as per Matriculation), Date of Birth, Mobile Number and Email ID; these details cannot be changed once registered.
  • After registration, candidates should log in using their User ID and password, fill the Online Application Form section-wise (personal information, qualifications, experience, and document uploads), and then proceed to fee payment.
  • Application fee must be paid online through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card using the payment gateway on the application portal; fee is non-refundable.
  • Candidates must upload legible scanned copies of required documents: educational qualifications (from Matric onwards), mark sheets, date of birth proof, category certificates, experience certificates, NOC (if applicable), etc.
  • Photograph must be a clear passport-size coloured photo with light background, in .jpg/.jpeg format, 50–80 KB in size, showing the candidate’s name and date of photograph (snapped on or after 01.10.2025).
  • After final submission and successful fee payment, candidates should take a printout of the completed application form for future reference; no changes are allowed after final submission.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

How to Apply for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Step 1: Create an Account (if not already created)

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link
  • Authenticate using DigiLocker/Aadhaar (strongly recommended)
  • Enter valid mobile number and email ID (CANNOT be changed later)
  • Complete OTP verification
  • Create login credentials

Step 2: Fill Online Application

  • Login with created credentials
  • Select CEN 09/2025
  • Choose ONE RRB/Railway Zone (CANNOT be changed)
  • Fill personal details, educational qualifications
  • Select post preferences within chosen Railway
  • Choose examination language (English/Hindi/Regional)
  • Capture live photograph using webcam/mobile camera
  • Upload scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, black ink, running handwriting)
  • Upload SC/ST certificate (if claiming free travel pass)
  • Indicate scribe requirement (if applicable)
  • Verify all details carefully

Step 3: Pay Application Fee

  • Select payment mode: Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
  • Pay Rs. 500/- (General/EWS/OBC-NCL Male) or Rs. 250/- (SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC)
  • Complete payment (all service charges borne by candidate)
  • Save payment receipt

Step 4: Final Submission

  • After successful payment, application will be accepted
  • Receive confirmation via SMS and email
  • Download and save final application form
  • Note Application Number for future reference

Step 5: Modification (if required)

  • Window: 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Login and modify details (except Create Account info & Chosen Railway)
  • Pay Rs. 250/- per modification
  • Pay additional fee if changing from reserved to unreserved category

Step 6: Enter Scribe Details (if applicable)

  • Window: 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
  • Login to application portal
  • Enter scribe's OTR number
  • Enter OTP sent to scribe's mobile to confirm

Documents to Upload:

  1. Live photograph (captured during application)
  2. Signature (scanned - JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, running handwriting)
  3. SC/ST certificate (PDF, <400 KB) - if claiming free travel pass

Documents Required at DV (Original + 2 self-attested photocopies):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate (for age & education)
  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable)
  • SC/ST certificate (Annexure-I)
  • OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-II) - issued on/after 01.04.2025
  • OBC-NCL self-declaration (Annexure-II A)
  • EWS certificate (Annexure-III) - valid for 2025-26, based on F.Y. 2024-25
  • EBC certificate (Annexure-III A) / BPL card / Izzat MST (if claimed fee concession)
  • Minority affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure-IV)
  • PwBD certificate (Annexure V-A/V-B) with UDID
  • ExSM certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • ExSM declaration (Annexure VI)
  • ExSM NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) - if serving
  • CCAA - NAC certificate from NCVT
  • LASIK declaration (Annexure-VII) - for A2/A3 posts
  • NOC from employer (if Govt. employee)
  • Caste change certificates (if name differs from 10th certificate)
  • Medical certificates (for scribe eligibility - Annexure V-E/V-F/V-G)

Project Research Scientist - II (Medical) 01
Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) 01
Project Technical Support - III 02

Eligibility Criteria

Project Research Scientist - II (Medical):

  • MDS, Public Health Dentistry Registered with DCI

Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical):

  • Post-graduate degree in social science or life sciences, including the integrated PG degree in a relevant subject/field

Project Technical Support - III:

  • Three-year Graduate in social science or life sciences + three years' experience OR PG in social science or life sciences

2. Desirable Qualifications

Project Research Scientist - II (Medical):

  • Experience of working in dental public health projects
  • Experience of biostatistical application in the field of medical statistics and/or epidemiology
  • Good publication record
  • Excellent writing and verbal skills for communication
  • Candidate must be willing to travel extensively in rural/urban parts of the Panchkula district

Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical):

  • Experience of conducting qualitative research and focus group discussions
  • Knowledge of qualification data management including qualitative research software
  • Prior exposure to social sciences related work or any other degree in clinical epidemiology research
  • Experience in medical research and use of statistical software for analysis
  • Post experience of working in a public health related project
  • Candidate must be willing to travel extensively in rural/urban parts of the Panchkula district

Project Technical Support - III:

  • BSW/MSW
  • Experience in research and use of statistical software for data analysis
  • Candidate must be willing for extensive travel in rural/urban parts of Panchkula district

3. Age Limit

The age limit for PGIMER Chandigarh Project Research Scientist Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Project Research Scientist - II (Medical): Not exceeding 40 years of age
  • Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical): Not exceeding 35 years of age
  • Project Technical Support - III: Not exceeding 35 years of age
  • Age Relaxation: As per ICMR/PGIMER guidelines
  • Age Calculation Date: Age and experience will be counted till the date of interview (02/02/2026)

Selection Process 

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Walk-in Interview before the selection committee
  • Document Verification

How To Apply 

Eligible candidates can apply for PGIMER Chandigarh Project Research Scientist 2026 by appearing for walk-in interview by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: www.pgimer.edu.in
  2. Download the official notification and application form
  3. Read the official notification carefully
  4. Fill in the application form with correct details
  5. Prepare all required documents (degree/diploma/certificate, experience certificates, age proof, publications list)
  6. Appear for walk-in interview on 02/02/2026 at 2:30 PM at the office of the Head, Oral Health Sciences Centre, PGIMER, Chandigarh
  7. Bring original certificates along with the completed application form and all attachments
  8. No separate communication will be sent for the interview

Important Dates for PGIMER Chandigarh Project Research Scientist 2026

Event Date
Notification Release Date 19/01/2026
Walk-in Interview Date 02/02/2026 at 2:30 PM
Interview Location Office of the Head, Oral Health Sciences Centre, PGIMER, Chandigarh
Project Duration Initially up to 02/11/2026 and extendable up to completion of project (Tentative completion: 02/02/2029)

Instructions for PGIMER Chandigarh Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support 2026

  • The above assignment is purely on a contract basis
  • Applications lacking complete information as per the proforma and failure in submission of copies of relevant documents will be rejected without any communication
  • This appointment will not vest any right to claim for regular appointment or permanent absorption in the Institute or for continued contractual appointment which may be renewed or terminated on the basis of satisfactory performance and conduct
  • The competent Authority reserves the right to change the number of vacancies, withdraw the process in full or in part and also the right to reject any or all applications received without assigning any reasons or giving notices
  • He/she should conform to the rules of discipline and conduct as applicable to the Institute employees
  • No travelling or other allowances will be paid to the candidate for interview or for joining the post
  • The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law
  • If any declaration given or information furnished by the candidate proves to be false or if the candidate is found to have wilfully suppressed any material information, he/she will be liable to be removed from service or such action as the appointing authority may deem fit
  • The decision of the Competent Authority regarding the selection of the candidate will be final and no representations will be entertained in this regard
  • Canvassing of any kind will be a disqualification

Documents to be Enclosed

Candidates must carry the following documents (self-attested) to the walk-in interview:

  • Degree/Diploma/Certificate
  • Experience Certificates
  • Age Proof
  • List of Publications (Attach list in Vancouver style of referencing)
  • Original certificates along with photocopies
  • Completed application form (along with all attachments)

  • Note: In the light of resolution memo no. 2374 dated 16.07.2007 of Personnel and Administrative Reforms Department, Bihar and resolution memo no. 962 dated 22.01.2021 of General Administration Department, 40 (forty) percent for general category, 36.5 (thirty-six and a half) percent for backward class, 34 (thirty-four) percent for extremely backward class and 32 (thirty-two) percent minimum qualifying marks for scheduled caste/scheduled tribe/women and disabled candidates is mandatory.

  • B. Practical Test Examination:-
  • (i) In the shorthand test examination, 80 (eighty) words per minute speed for Hindi and English dictation total 320 (three hundred twenty) words have to be written in sign script in the provided notebook in 04 (four) minutes {(1 minute additional time at the beginning for dictation writing)} duration.   • (ii) Typing test examination (Hindi and English) will be taken on computer.
  • (iii) In Hindi typing test examination, Mangal font in Remington Gail Keyboard Layout will be used.
  • (iv) In Hindi typing test examination, candidates have to type total 300 (three hundred) words at a speed of 30 (thirty) words per minute in 10 (ten) minutes.
  • (v) In English typing test examination, “UTF-8” Under English (US) Keyboard Layout will be used.
  • (vi) In English typing test examination, total 300 (three hundred) words have to be typed in 10 (ten) minutes at a speed of 30 (thirty) words per minute.

  • (viii) Compensatory time will be given to benchmark disabled (visually impaired) candidates as per rules.
  • (ix) More than 10 percent error in shorthand speed and 1.5 percent in typing will not be acceptable for success in the practical test examination.
  • (x) Candidates will ensure to follow the instructions displayed on the Computer Screen from time to time during the examination.

  • Syllabus:- The syllabus of the written examination is as follows:-
  • Section (a):- General Studies:- The objective of the questions will be to test the candidate's general knowledge of the surrounding environment and its application in society. Questions related to current events and subtle observation of day-to-day events and scientific approach towards them will also be included, about which an educated person is expected to have knowledge. Questions may be asked especially about Bihar, India and its neighboring countries.
  • (i) Contemporary Issues:- Scientific progress, National/International Awards, Indian Languages, Book, Script, Capital, Currency, Sports-Players, Important Events.
  • (ii) India and its Neighboring Countries:- History of Neighboring Countries, History of India, Culture, Geography, Economic Scenario, Freedom Movement, Main Features of Indian Agriculture and Natural Resources and Constitution and Polity of India, Political System of the Country, Panchayati Raj, Community Development, Five-Year Plan and Contribution of Bihar in the National Movement.
  • Section (b):- General Science and Mathematics:- Questions may generally be asked from the following subjects at the Matric level-
  • (i) General Science:- Basic questions related to Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Geography and knowledge of computer basics/word processing.
  • (ii) Mathematics:- Questions related to number system, computation of whole numbers, decimals and fractions, interrelationship between numbers, basic arithmetical operations, percentage, ratio and proportion, average, interest and profit and loss.
  • Section (c):- Mental Ability Test:- Both verbal and non-verbal types of questions may be asked such as- analogy, similarity and difference, space visualization, problem solving, analysis, visual memory, discrimination, observation, relationship concept, arithmetical reasoning, arithmetical number series, code writing and code interpretation, series, classification, mirror image, hidden figure, picture matrix, paper cutting, group images, shape construction and dice, analogy, analytical reasoning, water image, pattern completion, paper folding, rule detection, dot situation, picture formation and analysis.

    • Paper II - Graduate Level Physics: 100 marks consisting of 100 objective multiple choice questions. Duration: 3 hours. Minimum 33% marks required to qualify. Based on marks in this paper, candidates up to 5 times the number of vacancies (category-wise) will be shortlisted for Physical Efficiency Test
  • Negative Marking: 0.2 marks will be deducted for each wrong answer in both stages
  • Stage 3 - Physical Efficiency Test: Qualifying nature (no marks awarded). All tests must be passed separately:
    • Running: Male candidates (all categories): 1 mile (1.6 km) in maximum 7 minutes. Female candidates (all categories): 1 km in maximum 7 minutes
    • High Jump: Male: Minimum 3 feet 6 inches. Female: Minimum 2 feet 6 inches
    • Long Jump: Male: Minimum 10 feet. Female: Minimum 7 feet
    • Shot Put: Male: 16 pounds shot - Minimum 14 feet. Female: 12 pounds shot - Minimum 8 feet
  • Maximum three attempts will be given for High Jump, Long Jump and Shot Put
  • Failure to achieve minimum standard in any of the four events will result in disqualification
  • Final Merit List: Based on marks obtained in Main Examination Paper II (Physics), successful candidates in Physical Efficiency Test will be selected as per number of vacancies category-wise
  • In case of normalization required due to multi-session/multi-paper examinations, Equi-Percentile Method will be used
  • Medical examination, character verification and background verification will be conducted by appointing authority before final appointment

Physical Measurement Standards

  • Height Requirements:
    • Unreserved and Backward Class Male Candidates: Minimum 165 cm
    • Extremely Backward Class, Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Male Candidates: Minimum 160 cm
    • Female Candidates (All Categories): Minimum 155 cm
  • Chest Measurement (For Male Candidates Only):
    • Unreserved, Backward Class and Extremely Backward Class Male: Unexpanded - 81 cm (minimum), Expanded - 86 cm (minimum). Minimum 5 cm expansion compulsory
    • Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Male: Unexpanded - 79 cm (minimum), Expanded - 84 cm (minimum). Minimum 5 cm expansion compulsory
    • No chest measurement for female candidates
  • Weight: Female candidates (all categories): Minimum 48 kg
  • For Kinnar/Kothi/Hijra/Transgender (Third Gender): Gender determination will be done as per identification card issued by District Magistrate under Section 6 of Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2020 in Form-3. Category will be determined accordingly

General Information/Instructions

  • Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) is conducting recruitment for Assistant Sub-Inspector (Operation) posts in Bihar Police Radio (Wireless), Bihar, Patna
  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Male, Female and Third Gender candidates can apply
  • Reservation will be applicable as per Bihar Reservation of Vacancies in Posts and Services (for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Classes) Act, 1991 (Bihar Act 3, 1992) as amended from time to time
  • Women Reservation: 35% horizontal reservation for women in each reservation category (keeping intact 3% reservation for Backward Class women). This 35% horizontal reservation is admissible only to original residents of Bihar State as per General Administration Department resolution dated 09/07/2025. However, as per Section 4(3) of Bihar Act 3, 1992, women can also be appointed on merit basis in addition to 35% reservation
  • Freedom Fighters' Descendants: 2% horizontal reservation for grandchildren (grandson/granddaughter) of Bihar State freedom fighters who have been granted pension by Central Government as per General Administration Department resolution dated 03/09/2015. Selected candidates will be counted in their respective reserved/unreserved category
  • EWS Reservation: Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections as per Bihar Reservation in Vacancies in Posts and Services (for Economically Weaker Sections) Act, 2019. Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2024-25 will be acceptable
  • Transgender Reservation: Kinnar/Kothi/Hijra/Transgender (Third Gender) are included at serial number 47 in Schedule-2 of backward classes list. They will get benefit of reservation applicable to backward classes as per General Administration Department resolution dated 12/09/2014
  • Benefit of reservation applicable only to original residents of Bihar State. Candidates from other states belonging to reserved categories will be treated as unreserved category candidates
  • Candidates working in State/Central Government/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies should apply through proper channel or produce No Objection Certificate at the time of selection
  • During written examination and physical efficiency test, candidates must follow social distancing and all latest instructions issued by administration for prevention from Corona infection
  • Admit card for written examination will be issued online. Information will be provided through newspapers and commission website. Important information may be sent through SMS/E-mail
  • Normally 06 months time may be required to complete selection process. Candidates are advised to ensure their availability for written examination, physical efficiency test and document verification. Request for time extension will not be accepted under any circumstances (family, personal, medical, bone fracture, pregnancy etc.)
  • The appointing authority for Assistant Sub-Inspector (Operation) post is Deputy Inspector General of Police (Wireless and Technical Services)
  • Before final appointment, medical examination, character and antecedents verification of all selected candidates will be conducted by appointing authority as per prescribed rules
  • Candidates must be free from such diseases, structural defects or physical weakness which make them unfit for duties
  • Medical examination will include tests for vision defects, color blindness, hearing power, stammering, flat foot, knocking knee etc. Being found fit in medical examination is mandatory for appointment
  • Candidates with stammering or stuttering defects will not be eligible for selection
  • BPSSC reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process or change any terms and conditions without further notice or assigning any reason at any stage
  • In case of any discrepancy found in Hindi version of advertisement, English version will prevail

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only through BPSSC website https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in
  • Click on "Bihar Police" tab on the website and then click on Advertisement No. 04/2026 link
  • Online application start date: 04/02/2026
  • Online application last date: 04/03/2026
  • No other mode of application will be accepted
  • Before registration and payment, keep a valid and active mobile number and email ID which should preferably be registered in your name
  • Mobile number and email ID are mandatory for registration
  • If you don't have your own email ID, please create one as important information will be shared on your email ID and mobile phone during application and selection process
  • Commission will communicate with candidate on the same mobile number/email ID provided during registration till completion of final stage of recruitment
  • Commission will not be responsible for wrong, invalid or disconnected mobile number or email ID
  • Application Process - Part 1 (Registration):
    • First registration of candidate will be done where information like name, nationality, mobile number, email ID, Bihar State domicile, reservation category, gender and date of birth will be taken
    • After registration, payment process must be completed
    • After successful registration, Registration Number and Password will be sent immediately through SMS/E-mail to candidate's mobile phone and email ID
    • Before payment, candidates have facility to "Edit" their details
    • If you have registered with wrong details, you can use "Cancel Registration Form" provision to cancel your registration after payment. However, previously paid application fee will not be refunded and you will have to pay application fee again for new registration
  • Application Process - Part 2 (Final Submission):
    • After successful registration, login with provided Registration Number and Password
    • Fill required information like father's/husband's name, mother's name, address, educational qualification etc. correctly and give consent on declaration
    • Upload scanned recent color photograph (within 2 months old, white background, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif format)
    • Upload signature separately in English and Hindi (in black or blue ink, white background, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif format)
    • If instructions regarding photo and signature are not followed, online application will be rejected/cancelled
    • After uploading photo and signature, candidates can edit details by clicking "Edit Details" button before final submission
    • Once confirmed and submitted, application details cannot be edited
    • After submission, confirmation message (SMS/E-mail) will be received on registered mobile number/email ID
    • Print acknowledgement of submitted application on A4 size paper and keep it safely for future correspondence
  • Only one mobile number can be used for one application only
  • Only one application per candidate is allowed. In case of multiple applications from a candidate, all applications will be rejected
  • Candidates applying with fake name and address will be disqualified and strict legal action will be taken
  • Candidates should mention date of birth exactly as per matriculation/equivalent board examination certificate
  • Candidates should fill name, father's/husband's name, address and all other information correctly. If any discrepancy is found during certificate verification, candidature will be cancelled
  • If wrong reservation category is entered in application, candidature will be cancelled
  • Reserved category candidates are advised to obtain detailed information about their category/caste/class from General Administration Department, Bihar Government website state.bihar.gov.in
  • There is no need to send filled online application to BPSSC, however Registration Number is required for future correspondence. Keep printout of acknowledgement (with photo) safely
  • No extension will be given in last date of online application. Request for correction received through post or other means will not be considered
  • Exercise caution while making online payment and avoid multiple payments for single application
  • Payment of application fee through online mode is mandatory
  • For any guidance on filling application and information regarding advertisement, contact Mobile Number: Not specified in working days

Eligibility Criteria for Special Assam TET 2026

Basic Eligibility Requirements

A. Residency: Candidates must be permanent residents of Assam.

B. Academic and Professional Qualifications: Candidates must meet NCTE-prescribed minimum qualifications.

Minimum Qualification for Lower Primary TET (Classes I to V)

Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications:

  1. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education
  2. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)
  3. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education)
  4. Graduation + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education

Minimum Qualification for Upper Primary TET (Classes VI to VIII)

Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications:

  1. Graduation + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education
  2. At least 50% marks in Graduation + B.Ed.
  3. At least 55% marks in Post Graduation (or equivalent grade) + 3-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.
  4. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)
  5. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year B.A./B.Sc. Ed. or B.A. Ed./B.Sc. Ed.
  6. Graduation with at least 50% marks + 1-year B.Ed. (Special Education)

Important Note: Minimum percentage requirements in graduation do not apply to candidates who took admission to B.Ed. or B.El.Ed. or equivalent courses before July 29, 2011.

Relaxation in Eligibility

  • 5% relaxation in academic marks (HSSLC or Graduation) for SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/PWD(PH) candidates
  • PWD candidates must have a minimum 40% degree of handicap certified by competent authority

Exam Duration: 2 hours 30 minutes (150 minutes) for each paper Additional Time: 20 minutes per hour for visually impaired candidates Marking Scheme: Each question carries 1 mark Negative Marking: No negative marking

Qualifying Marks for Special Assam TET 2026

For SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/PWD(PH) Candidates

  1. No Automatic Appointment: Qualifying the Special Assam TET 2026 does not confer automatic right to appointment. Teacher recruitment in government/provincialized schools is a separate process conducted when vacancies arise.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
