Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

For EWS Candidates:

  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25

    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR

  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board

  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.
  • These guidelines are subject to change in terms of GoI guidelines/ clarifications, if any, from time to time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply online only from January 26, 2026, up to February 15, 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Scan their: Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), Signature (with black ink), Left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), A handwritten declaration (on a white paper with black ink) (text given below), The consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation, Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree, Caste Certificate (if applicable) Ensuring that all these scanned documents adhere to the required specifications as given in this Advertisement.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • The left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged. (If a candidate is not having left thumb, he/she may use his/ her right thumb for applying.)
  • The text for the handwritten declaration is as follows – “I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”
  • The above-mentioned handwritten declaration has to be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only. If it is written and uploaded by anybody else or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid.
  • Keep the necessary details/documents ready to make Online Payment of the requisite application fee/ intimation charges.
  • Have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. Bank may send intimation to download call letters for the Examination etc. through the mentioned e-mail ID and / or SMS. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying on-line and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • Candidates to visit Online Application and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature detailed under point "C".
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before COMPLETE REGISTRATION.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.

(d) Organized two activities in cumulative of Conference(s) OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course(s).
  • Desirable criteria for Assistant Professor (Level -12): (a) Good quality publications with at least 5 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least one ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project OR one patent granted. (c) Supervised at least one Ph.D. completed/ ongoing.   • Financial assistance for attending national/international conferences for presenting research papers or Chairing sessions, for sponsored training in India and abroad, for membership of professional Societies etc. under the Scheme of Cumulative Professional Development Allowance [CPDA] limited to Rs.1.00 lakh per annum subject to the maximum limit of Rs.3.00 lakh in a block period of three years or as per rules.

  • LTC as per Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • HRA as per the Government of India (GoI) norms.

  • Original documents along with one set of self-attested copies will have to be produced at the time of interview for verification.

  • Note: if the candidate achieves the degree under integrated mode, then it shall be considered as two degrees among UG/PG/PhD.

  • Govt. of India (GoI) norms of Reservations are followed in the Institute. All reserved candidates are required to submit their Caste/Category certificates in prescribed format [Annexure-IV/V/VII] along with the hard copy of application. No other certificate will be accepted as sufficient proof of Caste/Category.
  • The Caste/Tribe/Community certificates (Annexure-IV) in the proforma prescribed and issued by any of the authorities stated in the OM No. 36012/6/88-Estt. (SCT), Dated 24.4.1990 and OM No.36012/22/93-Estt. (Res.), Dated 15.11.1993, GoI, No. 36028/1/2014-Estt (Res), Dated 3rd September, 2015 will only be accepted as sufficient proof in support of a candidate’s claim belonging to Schedule Caste/ Schedule Tribe/ Other Backward Class (NCL). Relevant Caste /Tribe/ Community certificates are required to be submitted with duly completed application form. No other certificate will be accepted as sufficient proof.
  • (i) The caste of the candidate must be in the State-wise Central list of SCs given at: https://socialjustice.gov.in/common/76750 or https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/Compendium-2016.pdf
  • (ii) The caste of the candidate must be in the State-wise Central list of STs given at: https://tribal.nic.in/ST/LatestListofScheduledtribes.pdf
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate issued on or after 1stApril 2025 shall only be considered for reservation under OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category. [Refer Annexure-V].
  • EWS certificate should be issued by Competent Authority (Tahsildar or above). Also, this certificate must be issued on or after 1st April 2025 in order to be considered for reservation under EWS category [Refer Annexure-VI], (NOT APPLICABLE IN THIS ADVERTISMENT).

  • The reserved candidates who have applied for unreserved posts will not be eligible for any age relaxation or any other concessions as per DOPT Office Memorandum No. 36011/1/98 Est. (Res) Dated, 1-7-98.
  • The directives contained in the matter of reservation in posts and implementation of Central Educational Institutions Act, 2019 enunciated in the Ministry of Education’s letter dated 05.11.2019 (attached herewith as Annexure-VIII) shall be applicable.
  • Canvassing in any form and/or bringing any influence of any form will be treated as disqualification for the faculty position applied.
  • Legal disputes if any, with NIT Raipur will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Raipur Courts only.
  • The applicant will be solely responsible for the authenticity of submitted information, documents and photographs, etc.
  • The list of candidates shortlisted for further participation in the selection process such as written test/presentation/interview etc. will be displayed on the Institute Website only. The applicants need to keep on visiting Institute Website www.nitrr.ac.in for updates. No correspondence will be made regarding non-eligibility/ not-short listing/ non-selection of the candidates.
  • Information uploaded on the website shall not be provided to the candidate or any other person under R.T.I Act. 2005. The information uploaded on the website shall remain for a specific period only. Therefore, the candidates are advised to download the uploaded information and keep with them for future. During ongoing process of recruitment, neither any application under Right to Information Act. 2005 shall be entertained nor information will be provided. Factual information under the R.T.I Act shall be provided only after declaration of final results of the process. Inferential questions or speculative questions shall not be answered in RTI.

How to Apply

  • Please note that application(s) filled only through the official portal (Google Chrome is more friendly for filling the online application) in the institute website (www.nitrr.ac.in) shall be accepted. Applications received through any other mode shall not be accepted but summarily rejected.   • Complete hardcopy of Application Form(s) for each applied Branch/Discipline/ Post must be submitted in separate envelopes.   • Please also note that an online application for which hard-copy application along with necessary documentation is not received in the Institute upto the stipulated time, the online application will be rejected summarily.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification
    • Case Worker: Graduation in Sociology/Social Science/Psychology and at least 3 years experience in law/social work in relevant fields related to women in government or semi-government project/program. Should be a resident of the local community for effective operation.
    • Multi Purpose Staff: Literate woman with knowledge/experience in the related field. Preference will be given to High School pass or equivalent qualification.
    • Security Guard: 8th pass from a recognized board and minimum 2 years experience as security personnel at district/state level in government or reputed organization. Preference to retired military/paramilitary personnel.
  • Experience
    • Case Worker: At least 3 years in relevant fields.
    • Multi Purpose Staff: Knowledge/experience in the related field.
    • Security Guard: Minimum 2 years as security personnel.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Case Worker: 18420/- per month (Level-6)
  • Multi Purpose Staff: 11720/- per month (Level-01)
  • Security Guard: 11360/- per month (Level-01)

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum age 21 years and maximum 35 years as on 01 January 2026.
  • With relaxations as per state government instructions, maximum age limit will not exceed 45 years.

Important Dates

Notification Date 21 January 2026
Start Date 22 January 2026
Last Date 05 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Applications will be invited online based on the qualifications mentioned above.
  • Merit will be prepared based on the marking system.
  • In case of equal marks in the merit list, preference will be given based on seniority in age.
  • Priority will be given to applications from surplus service providers of Sakhi One Stop Center whose services have been terminated or are under process, based on their qualification and experience.
  • The committee will prepare the merit list based on the marking system as above and select accordingly.
  • The selection committee will send the recommendation list for selection to the District Collector, and the District Collector will issue the appointment order.

General Information / Instructions

  • Age verification/support will be based on birth certificate or mark sheet of class 6th or 10th where date of birth is mentioned. Original and self-attested copy mandatory at document verification.
  • The candidate must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh. Residence certificate issued by competent authority will be valid.
  • For reserved category, permanent caste certificate issued by competent authority must be attached.
  • The selected candidate's educational documents will be sent for verification to the concerned board/university and experience to the concerned institution. If documents are found fake, criminal case will be registered and action taken as per rules.
  • The selected candidate must undergo medical examination within 01 month after selection and submit fitness certificate. If found unfit, services will be terminated.
  • Sakhi One Stop Center is extremely sensitive work, so selected candidate must undergo police background verification before appointment and submit the certificate at the time of joining. At the time of application, non-conviction certificate must also be submitted.
  • The nature of work at Sakhi One Stop Center is sensitive and confidentiality of victims is legally very important. Selected candidate must maintain confidentiality of all work-related matters, victims/cases, and data, and submit an affidavit. On violation, services will be terminated.
  • Any candidate who has married before the minimum age limit for marriage will not be eligible for appointment. In case of selection, the selected candidate must submit an affidavit notarized on Rs. 50/- stamp paper.
  • A candidate who has married a person who already has a living spouse will not be eligible. In such cases, the government may decide otherwise if satisfied with sufficient reasons.
  • Application form must be submitted online on the portal along with desired certificates, mark sheets, and other documents attested by gazetted officer or self.
  • For experience, the candidate must attach full-time work experience certificate issued by the employer of the concerned institution, certified by gazetted officer.
  • The decision of the appointing authority District Collector regarding validation of experience given in the application will be final.
  • Any voluntary service certificate will not be considered as experience.
  • Employees working in government/semi-government institutions must submit their application with no objection certificate from employer, otherwise application will not be considered.
  • Incomplete, unclear, and erroneous application forms will not be notified separately to candidates and such applications will be rejected. Candidates without prescribed qualification please do not apply.
  • Separate online applications must be submitted for each post.
  • Applicants should self-check their eligibility and apply only if they meet the prescribed eligibility and conditions for the advertised post. If found ineligible at any stage of selection, the application can be canceled and candidature terminated.
  • Service providers appointed on lump sum service fee under the scheme will be governed by Chhattisgarh Civil Services Conduct Rules 1965 and bound to follow them.
  • Appointed service providers will be paid only lump sum service fee and no other salary allowances, gratuity will be payable.
  • These service providers will be eligible for maternity leave facility. In special circumstances, if sent on travel or training, travel allowance will be payable as per rules after appropriate approval.
  • The service fee of the above service providers is as per the limit and instructions set by Government of India and in future, if increased by Government of India, the service fee will be given accordingly.
  • All posts under Sakhi One Stop Center will have District Collector as the appointing authority.
  • The district level selection committee will carry out the recruitment process as per prescribed criteria for vacant posts at Sakhi One Stop Center and recommend to District Collector.
  • The committee will determine transparent process for appointment/recruitment criteria (merit) and process, and invite applications through advertisement via online medium. Merit will be prepared based on marking system on received applications as per prescribed criteria.
  • All these posts will be selected/appointed on lump sum service fee initially for a maximum period of 02 years, and thereafter, based on work performance, capacity, behavior, and department's need, and on recommendation of controlling officer, the suitability will be assessed and service period can be extended by 01 year each time by District Collector, otherwise on expiry of service period without extension, appointment will be considered automatically terminated.
  • The appointment of selected service provider will be completely temporary and can be terminated without assigning any reason.
  • During the work period, appointment can be terminated by either party by giving one month notice or one month salary in lieu thereof.
  • The duration of these posts will be limited to the period of scheme operation by Government of India and thereafter posts will be abolished. After abolition of posts, the department will have no responsibility for the service providers working on these posts.
  • The decision of District Collector regarding selection will be final and acceptable to all.
  • For online application, can be viewed on Women and Child Development Department website https://sakhionestop.e-bharti.in/ and for detailed information of advertisement, can be seen on www.raipur.gov.in at District Information and Science Officer (NIC) Raipur.

How to Apply

  • Online applications can be made from 22 January 2026 to 05 February 2026 on the Women and Child Development Department website https://sakhionestop.e-bharti.in/.
  • Separate applications must be made for each post on the online portal.
  • Along with the application, attach desired certificates, mark sheets, and other documents attested by gazetted officer or self.

Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of Young Professionals proposed to be engaged on contract basis in the Ministry of Ayush is 06, subject to changes as decided by the Ministry. These positions form a panel of Young Professionals for various functional areas in the Ministry on a purely contractual basis.

Eligibility Criteria for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must meet the following qualification requirements:

  • Essential: Bachelor degree in a relevant subject or technical qualifications such as B.Tech, MBA or equivalent in relevant field/subject.
  • Desirable: Masters / M.Phil / Ph.D or MD with research experience, published papers and working experience in the relevant field.
  • The candidate should have good command over writing English or Hindi, good working knowledge of technology-based skills on the computer and ability to work on ICT applications.
  • Candidates should possess strong communication and interpersonal skills.

2. Age Limit

The age conditions for Young Professional engagement are:

  • Maximum Age: Below 32 years of age as on 1st July 2026 (01/07/2026).
  • Age Relaxation: Criteria may be relaxed in exceptional cases based on justification in the interest of Government with the approval of Secretary (Ayush), as per guidelines.
  • Age calculation date: 01 July of the year of advertisement (01/07/2026).

3. Other Eligibility & Attributes

  • Young Professionals are expected to provide high quality professional inputs in areas like AYUSH Systems, Budget, Finance, AYUSH Education, Public Health & Infrastructure, Commerce & Trade, Marketing & Export Promotion of Medicinal Plants, Skill Development, IT, Media and related domains.
  • Candidates must demonstrate proven academic credentials, professional achievements and leadership qualities.

Selection Process for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026

The selection of Young Professionals will follow the procedure and guidelines notified by the Ministry of Ayush:

  • Short-listing of applications based on eligibility criteria and requirements of various divisions as per Terms of Reference.
  • Short-listed candidates will undergo the recruitment process as per Ministry guidelines and requirements.
  • Final selection will be based on merit as decided by the Selection Committee.
  • Applications will be scrutinized by a Screening Committee; shortlisted applications will be sent to concerned divisions to recommend a panel (with waitlist, if required).
  • A Performance Appraisal Board (PAB) chaired by Joint Secretary (Admn.) will appraise work and performance for extension beyond the first year.

Note: Ministry of Ayush reserves the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason and to cancel the advertisement at any stage.

Application Fee for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026

  • The notification does not mention any application fee for Young Professional engagement.

How to Apply for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional Recruitment 2026?

Interested and eligible applicants can apply for Ministry of Ayush Young Professional 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Download or use the enclosed application format (Annexure-II) provided with the notification.
  2. Fill the application form strictly in the enclosed format, providing all personal details, educational qualifications and professional experience.
  3. Prepare a CV and attach self-attested copies of relevant documents supporting qualifications and experience.
  4. Place the completed application form, CV and relevant documents in an envelope.
  5. Superscribe the envelope clearly with: “Application for the assignment of Young Professional in Ministry of Ayush”.
  6. Send or submit the application to:
    Establishment-II Section, Ministry of Ayush, Ayush Bhawan, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi – 110023.
  7. Ensure that the application reaches the above address by 08 February 2026 till 5:30 PM.

  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

Important Dates

Selection Process

  • Selection to this position is to be made on the basis of open written competitive examination.
  • There will be two papers i.e. Paper – I and Paper – II.
  • The Paper-II will be evaluated only for those candidates who secure the minimum threshold marks (to be determined by the Selection Committee) in Paper-I.
  • The Final merit list will be prepared only on the basis of the marks obtained by the candidates in Paper-II.
  • Paper – I will be OMR based or Computer based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination, while Paper-II will be descriptive type.
  • The candidates fulfilling essential qualification / experience and other necessary criteria as per advertisement and as recommended by Screening / Selection Committee / Competent Authority will be invited for a Skill / Physical Test and Personality Assessment Test which will be of qualifying in nature.
  • Those candidates who will qualify the Skill / Physical and Personality Assessment Test will be called for Competitive Written Exam.
  • The final merit list will be prepared on the basis of the performance of the candidates in the competitive written examination.
  • The candidates fulfilling essential qualification and other necessary criteria as per advertisement and as recommended by Screening / Selection Committee / Competent Authority will be invited for a Trade Test which will be of qualifying in nature.
  • Those candidates who will qualify the Trade Test will be called for a Written Test.
  • The final merit list will be prepared on the basis of the performance of the candidates in the competitive written examination.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates are advised in their own interest to submit online applications much before the closing date and not to wait till the last date to avoid the possibility of disconnection/ inability or failure to login to the CSIR-CRRI online recruitment portal on account of heavy load on the website during the closing days.
  • CSIR-CRRI will not be responsible for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the aforesaid reasons or for any other reason beyond the control of CSIR-CRRI.
  • Hard Copy of Application shall not to be sent to CSIR-CRRI. Relaxations in upper age limit will be as under: Other Backward Classes (OBC-NCL) 03 Years for MTS post only, PwBD (Unreserved & EWS) 10 Years for MTS posts and JHT post only, PwBD (OBC) 13 Years for MTS post only, Ex-Servicemen 3 years after deduction of the actual military service rendered from the actual age as on the closing date (for all the posts), Widow / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women As per Section 4(xvii) of this advertisement (for all the posts), Regular Council/Government/ Autonomous Bodies/PSU employees Upto 05 years for Junior Hindi Translator post only in accordance with the instructions and orders issued by Government of India / CSIR from time to time in this regard.,
  • Any other age relaxations As per extant GoI / DoPT/ CSIR Instructions. SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates applying against Unreserved (UR) post will not be eligible for any age relaxation.
  • Candidates belonging to the reserved categories of SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS must upload a scanned copy of their certificate with their online applications.
  • This certificate should be in the prescribed format and issued by the Competent Authority authorized to issue such certificates, such as the SDO, District Magistrate, or Deputy Commissioner, as specified by the Government of India. SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS certificates should be in the prescribed formats for appointment to posts under the Government of India (GoI).
  • The OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificates must also meet the Non-Creamy Layer criteria for appointment to posts under the GoI as laid down by the GoI and not for appointment in any of the States of Union bearing references to those States Govt. orders.
  • Candidate belonging to OBC (NCL) must upload a scanned copy of Latest OBC (NCL) Certificate valid as on last date of submission of online application.
  • Eligibility for OBC(NCL) candidates will be based on castes listed in the Central List of the Government of India, and their sub-caste must match the entries in this list; otherwise, their candidature will not be considered under any reserved category and will be treated as Unreserved (UR), if otherwise eligible. OBC candidates in the “Creamy Layer” are not entitled to concessions available to the OBC-NCL category and must indicate their category as General/Unreserved.

How to Apply

Eligibility Criteria for NHB General Manager Recruitment 2026

1. Educational Qualification

General Manager – Credit Monitoring (Regular)

  • Chartered Accountant (CA) / Master of Business Administration (MBA) / Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) / Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management (PGDBM) from a recognized University/Institution.
  • All qualifications must be from Universities/Institutions/Boards recognized by Government of India/approved by Government Regulatory Bodies.
  • Candidates must possess valid degree/qualification certificates as on 01.01.2026 and indicate percentage as per prescribed conversion rules.

General Manager – Treasury (on contract)

  • Chartered Accountant (CA) / Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) / MBA / PGDM / PGDBM in Management-related fields from recognized Universities/Institutions.
  • Domain knowledge of Banking, Forex, regulatory norms, IT, forecasting and analytical skills is desirable.

2. Experience

General Manager – Credit Monitoring

  • Minimum 20 years’ experience in Banks/All India Financial Institutions (AIFIs)/NBFCs/Housing Finance Companies (HFCs).
  • Out of the above, minimum 10 years’ experience must be in housing finance.
  • Candidates must have headed the credit function as Zonal/National Head during their career, or be holding a regular post of Scale VI/Grade E in a Bank/AIFI.
  • Experience certificates must clearly indicate housing finance experience.

General Manager – Treasury (on contract)

  • At least 20 years’ experience in Banking or Financial Services.
  • Out of this, minimum 10 years in Money Market / Government Securities / Forex / Integrated Treasury Operations.
  • Serving officers in Senior Management of Regulatory Bodies/Banks/AIFIs/NBFCs/HFCs are eligible to apply.

3. Nationality

  • Citizen of India, or
  • Subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or
  • Person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with the intention of permanently settling in India, with eligibility certificate issued by Government of India where applicable.

Selection Process for NHB General Manager Recruitment 2026

The selection will be based on shortlisting and Interview.

  • Preliminary screening of applications may be conducted by a Screening Committee.
  • If required, Group Discussion may be conducted for shortlisting candidates for Interview.
  • Candidates must secure minimum marks in Interview to be considered for the final merit list.
  • Merit list will be prepared in descending order of Interview scores; in case of tie, higher age will rank higher.
  • Mere fulfilling of minimum qualifications and experience does not guarantee interview call; the Bank’s decision on shortlisting is final.

Application Fee for NHB General Manager Recruitment 2026

  • SC/ST/PwBD: ₹175 (Intimation Charges only) plus applicable GST and bank/transaction charges.
  • Other Categories: ₹850 (Application Fee including Intimation Charges) plus applicable GST and bank/transaction charges.
  • Fee/intimation charges are non-refundable and cannot be reserved for any other recruitment.
  • Payment must be made online only as per the procedure in the advertisement.

How to Apply for NHB General Manager Recruitment 2026?

Candidates can apply online only, and no other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Visit the official website: www.nhb.org.in.
  2. Go to “Opportunities” → “CURRENT VACANCIES” → “Recruitment of Officers in Various Posts – 2025-26/04”.
  3. Click on “Click here to Apply Online” and choose “Click here for New Registration”.
  4. Enter basic details to obtain a provisional registration number and password.
  5. Fill in personal, educational and experience details carefully and use “Save & Next” to verify entries.
  6. Upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per specified formats and file sizes.
  7. Upload eligibility documents (qualification and experience) as required on the portal.
  8. Preview the application and click “Complete Registration” after verifying all details.
  9. Proceed to pay the application fee/intimation charges online via Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking or IMPS.
  10. On successful transaction, generate and print the e-Receipt and final online application form for future reference.

Eligibility Criteria for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

1. Educational Qualification

  • Performance Analyst (Physiotherapy): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Physiotherapy from any recognized University/Institution; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Physiotherapy.
  • Performance Analyst (Physiology): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Medical Physiology / Human Physiology / Sports and Exercise Physiology / Biological Sciences; with specified equivalence for B.Sc. (CBZ) and Physiology; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Physiology.
  • Performance Analyst (Anthropometry): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Anthropology or Human Biology; desirable 1 year experience in Anthropometry in sports science.
  • Performance Analyst (Psychology): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Psychology / Clinical Psychology / Applied Psychology / Sports Psychology; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Psychology.
  • Performance Analyst (Strength & Conditioning): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Strength and Conditioning / Sports and Exercise Science / Sports Science; OR Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Sports Coaching / Physical Education / Performance Coaching with specified Strength & Conditioning certifications (ACSM, NSCA-CSCS, ASCA, UKSCA, NCCA USCCA, NSNIS PG Diploma, NSDC Level 4/6/7, government-recognized gym/fitness certifications, EXOS with ACSM credits); desirable 1 year experience in Strength & Conditioning.
  • Performance Analyst (Nutrition): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Nutrition & Dietetics / Food Science & Nutrition / Sports Nutrition / Nutrition / Food & Nutrition / Food Nutrition & Dietetics / Clinical Nutrition & Dietetics / Home Science with specified Nutrition specializations; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Nutrition.
  • Performance Analyst (Biomechanics): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Biomechanics / Sports Biomechanics / Sports Biomechanics & Kinesiology / Kinesiology (with Biomechanics) / Exercise & Sports Sciences (with Biomechanics) / Human Movement Sciences / Sports Sciences (with Biomechanics) / Biophysics / Physiotherapy (MPT Sports Biomechanics) with Biomechanics as major subject; with specified equivalent Bachelor’s degrees; desirable 1 year experience in Biomechanics.

2. Age Limit

  • Maximum Age: Up to 30 years as on the opening date for submission of online application forms.
  • SC/ST: Relaxation up to 5 years.
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): Relaxation up to 3 years.
  • Ex-servicemen: Relaxation as per Ex-servicemen (Re-employment in Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979.
  • Departmental/SAI contractual employees: Relaxation as per detailed SAI guidelines, including service-based cumulative relaxation.
  • Date of Birth Proof: As recorded in Matriculation/Secondary or equivalent certificates; no other documents accepted for age proof.

3. Nationality

Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply for SAI Performance Analyst posts.

Selection Process for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

The selection process will be based on a Computer-Based Test (CBT) with the following structure:

  • Mode: Computer-Based Test (CBT) in fully proctored environment with biometric authentication.
  • Duration: 2 hours.
  • Total Questions: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer.

Sections of CBT:

  • Section A (Common for all disciplines):
    • Basic Sports Science Knowledge (Section A1) – 32 marks.
    • General Sports Awareness (Section A2) – 8 marks.
    • Total: 40 marks.
  • Section B (Discipline-specific): Applied Sports Science Knowledge – 40 marks.
  • Section C (Discipline-specific): Sports-related Case Studies (passage/analytical) – 20 marks.

Final Merit List: Prepared solely on total CBT marks (out of 100). No additional weightage or supplementary evaluation is applied. Tie-breaking will follow sequential criteria based on marks in Sections C, B, A, A1, A2, then age (older candidate) and alphabetical order of name.

  • Applicants will be shortlisted for engagement on the basis of a system-generated merit list.

  • GDS cannot be retained beyond 65 years of age.
  • A Sevak should have another source of income besides the allowances paid by the Government for adequate means of livelihood.
  • Candidates selected as BPM are required to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.

  • Fill all details in the online application form including Personal Details, Board/Educational Details, Division selection and Post preference.
  • Upload recent photograph (JPG/JPEG format, 30 KB to 100 KB, 320×400 pixels recommended) and signature (JPG/JPEG format, 20 KB to 100 KB, 300×120 pixels recommended).

  • Candidates can apply for one or more vacant posts in only one selected Division.

Selection Process

Eligible candidates will be required to appear for the following stages of examination:

Stage-I: Preliminary Examination (CBT Objective Type) - Qualifying Stage

  • Total Questions: 120 Questions
  • Total Marks: 120 Marks
  • Total Time: 120 Minutes
  • Negative Marking: 25% (deduction of 0.25 Mark for each wrong answer)

Paper Structure:

  • Part-I: English Language & Comprehension - 45 Questions = 45 Marks (Vocabulary, Synonyms, Antonyms, Comprehension Passage, Idioms & Phrases, One Word Substitution, Gender, Degrees, Preposition, Articles, Fill in the Blanks, Shuffling of Sentence Parts, Spot the Error, Active/Passive Voice, Direct/Indirect Narration, etc.)
  • Part-II: General Awareness/Knowledge and Current Affairs/Events - 45 Questions = 45 Marks (30 Questions on Salient Features of Constitution of India, Indian Judiciary, Sports & Games, Art & Culture, Indian History, Polity & Geography, Everyday Science, National/International Organizations/Institutions/Awards, Famous Personalities, Important Days, Inventions & Discoveries; 15 Questions on Current Affairs/Events)
  • Part-III: General Intelligence, Reasoning Ability & Numerical/Arithmetic Ability - 30 Questions = 30 Marks (Verbal and non-verbal types - Analogies, Similarities & Differences, Classification, Problem Solving/Decision Making, Relationship Concepts, BODMAS, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Time-Speed-Distance, Time & Work, Ratio & Proportion, etc.)

Qualifying Criteria:

  • General Category: 60 Marks (50% of 120 Marks)
  • Reserved Category (including PwBD): 54 Marks (45% of 120 Marks)
  • Candidates to the extent of 15 times the number of vacancies in each category will be called for Stage-II

Stage-II: Main (Descriptive) Examination

  • Total Marks: 100 Marks
  • Total Time: 120 Minutes
  • Part-A: Essay (250 words = 40 Marks) & Letter (10 Marks)
  • Part-B: Grammar (30 Marks) & Translation (25 words = 20 Marks)

Minimum Passing Marks:

  • General Category: 50 Marks (50% of 100 Marks)
  • Reserved Category (including PwBD): 45 Marks (45% of 100 Marks)
  • Candidates to the extent of 6 times the number of vacancies in each category will be called for Stage-III

Stage-III: English Typing Test - Qualifying Stage

  • Duration: 10 minutes
  • Minimum Speed Required: 35 words per minute on Computer
  • Calculation Method: Characters with space for calculating typing speed
  • Permissible Mistakes: 3% of total words typed (rounded to 0.5 for 0.01 to 0.49 and to 1.0 for 0.51 to 0.99)
  • All successful/qualified candidates will be called for Stage-IV (Interview)

Stage-IV: Interview

  • Maximum Marks: 15 Marks
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: As prescribed

Final Merit List:

  • Final select/merit list will be prepared by adding marks secured in Stage-II (Main Descriptive Examination) and Stage-IV (Interview) only
  • Stage-I (Preliminary Examination) and Stage-III (English Typing Test) are qualifying in nature
  • There shall be no rounding off of marks at any stage of examination

Tie Resolution:

  • Total Marks in Stage-II (Main Descriptive Examination)
  • Total Marks in Stage-IV (Interview)
  • Date of Birth (older candidate gets preference over younger)

Score Normalization:

  • If exam is held in multiple shifts, normalization of scores will be done considering variation in difficulty level
  • Normalization will be done using "Score Normalization Based on Deviation Method" Formula

Selection Process

  • Step 1 - Online Application: Candidates must apply online through www.joinindianarmy.nic.in (Offline application for widows of defence personnel to be sent to Directorate General of Recruiting)
  • Step 2 - Shortlisting: Applications will be shortlisted based on cumulative percentage of marks obtained by candidates upto final semester/year. Cut-off will be applied for each Engineering stream based on vacancy to call up ratio.
  • Step 3 - Allotment of Selection Centre: After shortlisting, centre allotment will be intimated via email. Candidates will select their SSB dates on first come first serve basis.
  • Step 4 - SSB Interview: Two-stage selection procedure conducted at one of the Selection Centres - Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka) and Jalandhar Cantt (Punjab). Duration is five days.
  • Step 5 - Medical Examination: Candidates who get recommended after Stage-2 of SSB will undergo medical examination. Validity of SSB medical examination is 270 days.
  • Step 6 - Merit List: Merit list will be prepared engineering stream/subject wise based on SSB interview marks.
  • Step 7 - Joining Letter: Candidates in merit list who come within stipulated stream-wise vacancies and are medically fit will be issued joining letters for pre-commissioning training at PCTA, subject to meeting all eligibility criteria.

Note: Mere qualifying at SSB interview does not confirm final selection. Selection is based on merit, medical fitness and availability of vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

  • Type of Commission: Short Service Commission (SSC)
  • Training Duration: 49 weeks at Officers Training Academy, Gaya, Bihar
  • Rank After Training: Lieutenant
  • Commission Grant: Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission on probation in the rank of Lieutenant from the date of commencement of the course
  • Ante Date Seniority: One year ante date seniority from the date of commission will be granted to Engineering Graduates
  • Tenure of Engagement: Officers shall be liable to serve for ten years
  • Option for Release:
    • First option - After 5 years of service (with Army HQ approval based on merit)
    • Second option - After 10 years of service
    • Third option - After 14 years of service
  • Option for Permanent Commission: Officers desirous of seeking Permanent Commission may be considered in the 10th year of service based on eligibility and suitability
  • Service Extension: Ten year service tenure may be extendable by further four years subject to eligibility
  • Arms/Services Allocation: Primary Arms/Services are Corps of Engineers, Corps of Signals and Corps of Electronics and Mechanical Engineers. Candidates may get commissioned in other Arms/Services as well based on organizational requirements
  • Training Cost: Entire cost of training at PCTA is at Government expense
  • Cost Recovery: Candidates withdrawn from training academy for personal reasons will be liable to refund cost of training at ₹16,260 per week (as on 2023) or as notified from time to time
  • Promotion Criteria: Promotion to Captain after 2 years, Major after 6 years, Lieutenant Colonel after 13 years of reckonable commissioned service
  • Liability of Service: Officers may be granted commission in any Arm/Service and will be liable for service in any part of the world
  • Marriage Restriction: Candidates must not marry until they complete full training at Officers Training Academy. Marriage during training will result in discharge and recovery of expenditure
  • Special Provision for Widows: Widows of Indian Armed Forces Defence Personnel who died in harness, including those with children, are eligible provided they have not remarried. Their candidature will be considered only against specific vacancies released for said category.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)
