  • Candidates are advised in their own interest that they should not furnish any particulars that are false, tampered with or fabricated and should not suppress any material information while submitting application. At the time of examination, interview or in a subsequent selection procedure, if a candidate is (or has been) found guilty of: (i) Using unfair means (ii) Impersonating or procuring impersonation by any person, OR (iii) Misbehaving in the examination/interview hall or disclosing, publishing, reproducing, transmitting, storing or facilitating transmission and storage of contents of the test(s) or any information therein in whole or part thereof in any form or by any means, verbal or written, electronically or mechanically for any purpose, OR (iv) Resorting to any irregular or improper means in connection with his/ her candidature, OR (v) Obtaining support for his/ her candidature by unfair means, OR (vi) Carrying mobile phones or similar electronic devices of communication in the examination/ interview hall. Such a candidate may, in addition to rendering himself/ herself liable to criminal prosecution, shall be liable; a) to be disqualified from the examination for which he/ she is a candidate: b) to be debarred either permanently or for a specified period from any examination conducted by the Bank. c) for termination of service, if he/ she has already joined the Bank.
  • CANDIDATES REPORTING LATE i.e., after the reporting time specified on the call letter for Examination will not be permitted to take the examination. The reporting time mentioned on the call letter is prior to the Start time of the test. Though the duration of the examination is 2 hours 30 minutes, candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours including the time required for completion of various formalities such as verification and collection of various requisite documents, giving of instructions, etc.
  • In the examination hall as well as at the time of interview, the call letter along with original and a photocopy of the candidate’s currently valid photo identity (bearing exactly the same name as it appears on the call letter) such as PAN Card/ Passport/ Permanent Driving License/ Voter’s Card/ Bank Passbook with photograph/ Photo identity proof issued by a Gazetted Officer on official letterhead along with photograph / Photo identity proof issued by a People’s Representative on official letterhead along with photograph / valid recent Identity Card issued by a recognized College/ University/ Aadhar card/ E-Aadhar Card with a photograph/ Employee ID/ Bar Council Identity Card with photograph should be submitted to the invigilator for verification. The candidate’s identity will be verified with respect to his/her details on the call letter, in the Attendance List and requisite documents submitted. If identity of the candidate is in doubt the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the Examination.
  • Ration Card and Learner’s Driving License are not valid id proof.
  • Note: Candidates must produce in original the photo identity proof and submit photocopy of the photo identity proof along with Examination call letter as well as the Interview Call Letter while attending the examination/ interview respectively, without which they will not be allowed to take up the examination/ interview. Candidates must note that the name as appearing on the call letter (provided during the process of registration) should exactly match the name as appearing on the photo identity proof. Female candidates who have changed first/last/middle name post marriage must take special note of this. If there is any mismatch between the name indicated in the Call Letter and Photo Identity Proof the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the examination. In case of candidates who have changed their name, will be allowed only if they produce original Gazette notification / their original marriage certificate / affidavit in original.
  • 1. The examination will be conducted at venues given in the respective call letters.
  • 2. No request for change of centre/venue/date/session for Examination shall be entertained.
  • 3. Export-Import Bank of India, however, reserves the right to cancel any of the Examination Centres and/ or add some other Centres, at its discretion, depending upon the number of candidates, administrative feasibility, etc.
  • 4. Export-Import Bank of India also reserves the right to allot the candidate to any Centre other than the one he/she has opted for.
  • 5. Candidate will appear for the examination at an Examination Centre at his/her own risks and expenses and Export-Import Bank of India will not be responsible for any injury, expense or losses etc. of any nature.
  • 6. Choice of centre once exercised by the candidate will be final. If sufficient number of candidates do not opt for a particular centre for examination, OR if the number of candidates is more than the capacity available for exam for a centre, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to allot any other centre to the candidate.
  • Decision of Export-Import Bank of India in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate. No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained by the Export-Import Bank of India in this behalf.
  • Export-Import Bank of India would be analysing the responses (answers) of individual candidates with those of other candidates to detect patterns of similarity of right and wrong answers. If in the analytical procedure adopted by Export-Import Bank of India in this regard, it is inferred/ concluded that the responses have been shared and scores obtained are not genuine/ valid, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to cancel the candidature of the concerned candidates and the result of such candidates (disqualified) will be withheld.
  • There will be no sectional cut off but the final list for interviews will be drawn based on the candidate’s performance in the written test.
  • Instances for providing incorrect information and/or process violation by a candidate detected at any stage of the selection process will lead to disqualification of the candidate from the selection process and he/she will not be allowed to appear in any recruitment process of Export-Import Bank of India in the future. If such instances go undetected during the current selection process but are detected subsequently, such disqualification will take place with retrospective affect.
  • A pre-recruitment training will be organised for the candidates from reserved categories. Details of the training and its mode of delivery (online / offline) will be intimated to the candidates who opt for it through the online application form. Details will be shared with such candidates after the last date of registration.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is adversely affected permanently for any reason can use their own scribe at their cost during the examination. In all such cases where a scribe is used, the following rules will apply:
  • • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination. If violation of the above is detected at any stage of the process, candidature of both the candidate and the scribe will be cancelled. Candidates eligible for and who wish to use the services of a scribe in the examination should invariably carefully indicate the same in the online application form. Any subsequent request may not be favourably entertained.
  • • A person acting as a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate.
  • • The scribe may be from any academic stream.
  • • Both the candidate as well as scribe will have to give a suitable undertaking confirming that the scribe fulfils all the stipulated eligibility criteria for a scribe mentioned above. Further in case it later transpires that he/she did not fulfil any laid down eligibility criteria or suppressed material facts the candidature of the applicant will stand cancelled, irrespective of the result of the examination.
  • • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • • Scribe should not answer on his/her own. Any such behaviour observed will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • • Only candidates registered for compensatory time will be allowed such concessions since compensatory time given to candidates shall be system based, it shall not be possible for the test conducting agency to allow such time if he / she is not registered for the same. Candidates not registered for compensatory time shall not be allowed such concessions.
  • • During the exam, at any stage, if it is found that scribe is independently answering the questions, the exam session will be terminated, and candidate’s candidature will be cancelled. The candidature of such candidates using the services of a scribe will also be cancelled if it is reported after the examination by the test administrator personnel that the scribe independently answered the questions.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.
  • These guidelines are subject to change in terms of GoI guidelines/ clarifications, if any, from time to time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply online only from January 26, 2026, up to February 15, 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Scan their: Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), Signature (with black ink), Left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), A handwritten declaration (on a white paper with black ink) (text given below), The consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation, Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree, Caste Certificate (if applicable) Ensuring that all these scanned documents adhere to the required specifications as given in this Advertisement.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • The left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged. (If a candidate is not having left thumb, he/she may use his/ her right thumb for applying.)
  • The text for the handwritten declaration is as follows – “I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”
  • The above-mentioned handwritten declaration has to be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only. If it is written and uploaded by anybody else or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid.
  • Keep the necessary details/documents ready to make Online Payment of the requisite application fee/ intimation charges.
  • Have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. Bank may send intimation to download call letters for the Examination etc. through the mentioned e-mail ID and / or SMS. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying on-line and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • Candidates to visit Online Application and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature detailed under point "C".
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before COMPLETE REGISTRATION.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.

  • Consolidated Remuneration: ₹35,000/- fixed per month (no other allowances like DA, HRA, accommodation, medical, etc.)

  • No TA/DA: Provided for attending the interview.

Objectives & Roles

Young Professionals will support DAIC's mission as a Centre of Excellence for research, analysis, and policy-making in socio-economic transformation, reducing inequalities, and Buddhist studies. Key areas include:

  • High-quality research on social and economic issues
  • Developing national databases and disseminating knowledge
  • Policy review, research, and advocacy
  • Acting as a think tank for government, corporates, and NGOs
  • Public involvement in research
  • Training/orientation for scholars and government personnel
  • Research on Dr. Ambedkar's vision, sustainable development, livelihoods
  • International collaboration with knowledge hubs

Terms of Reference (ToR) will be specific, measurable, results-based, and time-bound as part of the contract.

  • Graduate from any recognized University with minimum 55% marks
  • Minimum one year experience in a reputed firm / Government of India organization, etc.

Desirable:

  • Knowledge of MS Office, media, IT, LAN, software/hardware, latest technologies
  • Good communication skills in English and Hindi
  • Knowledge of GeM, CPP Portal, and GFR Rules

Leave & Other Conditions

  • 8 days leave per year (pro-rated from joining date; no carry-forward; no remuneration for absence beyond this)
  • Working hours same as regular DAIC employees (no extra pay for overtime/holidays)
  • Confidentiality required; no publishing/sharing information without sanction
  • One month's notice or salary in lieu for resignation
  • Automatic termination for unauthorized absence of 8 continuous days
  • Income Tax deducted at source

    • Identity proof
    • Updated CV
    • Educational qualifications certificates
    • Experience documents
    • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD, if applicable)

Fill the application proforma with details like name, DOB, qualifications, experience, employment history (in table format), etc., and sign the declaration.

  • Shortlisting of candidates for Assistant Professor positions in colleges is based on a 100 point scale covering academic record (graduation, post-graduation), M.Phil./M.Tech./LLM/M.Ed. or equivalent, Ph.D., NET/JRF, research publications, teaching/post doctoral experience, and awards, as per the attached guidelines.

Selection Process

  • The selection process is through interaction. However, written examination shall be conducted, if required, based on the decision of the Consultancy Evaluation Committee (CEC);
  • Only candidates who strictly fulfill the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted and called for the written examination, which will include report writing and presentation on a given topic on the spot.
  • Only the candidates who qualify in the written examination will be called for report writing and presentation followed by interaction
  • The final selection of the candidates shall be based on the ranking/merit of combined score of the qualification, experience, written examination and interaction;
  • Candidates called for interaction would be required to bring original documents relating to qualification, experience and salary slip for the past six months. These documents shall be examined before interaction with the selection committee;
  • In case of non-submission of the salary slip for the past six months, the candidate will be considered for selection at the minimum range of the scale;

In deserving cases, an escalation up to 10% on the fee may be given with the approval of the Chairperson based on the performance during the preceding year.
  • The Staff consultants shall be entitled to performance-related variable pay of up to 40% of the Monthly fee, which will be admissible on achieving the prespecified annual targets by the Commission for organisation, division or team and individual and released on a quarterly or six-monthly basis as per the procedure issued by the Commission.
  • The consultant shall be paid lump sum monthly professional fees on completion of the month. TDS shall be deducted as per relevant rules.
  • This agreement is liable to be terminated by either party, by mutual consent, by giving one month notice in writing or month to the other or one month consolidated professional fees in lieu of such notice. In case, any consultant chooses to left CERC within one year, they may have to serve three months' notice in writing or three month's consolidated professional fees in lieu of such notice.
  • in case the Staff Consultant is unable to perform the assigned work or the work undertaken by them is not to the satisfaction of the Controlling Officer/Competent authority in CERC, the Staff Consultant shall be liable to be terminated after one month notice in writing.

  • in case the Staff Consultant is absent from duty, for a period of more than 30 days, without prior intimation/prior sanction and is not covered under medical emergency consultant, shall be liable to be terminated, in public interest, without any notice and without assigning any reason.
  • On pre-mature termination of the assignment, CERC shall pay the Staff Consultant, the profession fees for the work performed by him till the date of such termination, after deductions, if any.

Chief (Admin.), 8th Floor, Tower-B, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi 110 029 by 27th February, 2026 up to 5.00 PM. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date will be rejected.

The intervening Saturdays/ Sundays / holidays, if any, shall not be counted as leave. Unutilised leave shall not be carried forward to the next calendar year and is not encashable. Leave of any other nature is not admissible
  • (a) 1st Quarter: (January to March) – 04 days

Its main objective is to emerge as a significant contributor to the global clean energy mission by providing high-quality performance-enhancing materials and to maintain a global reputation and sustainably grow the core business of heavy minerals and rare earths. IREL is a Schedule-'B' Mini Ratna Category-1 CPSE in Minerals and Metals sector under the administrative control of Department of Atomic Energy.

Preference would be given to candidates from listed Companies. (* The average audited annual turnover of three financial years preceding the calendar year in which the post is advertised shall be considered for applying the approved limits.)

  • 1. (e) Relevant Jobs handled in the past with details.
  • (a) fill up the Application Form online only against this Job Description on the website of PESB - https://pesb.gov.in/ and thereafter forward it online, as specified in para V(1);
  • Or (b) fill up the Application Form online only against this Job Description on the website of PESB - https://pesb.gov.in/, take a printout and send it offline, as specified in para V(1).

Selection Process for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

The selection process includes:

  • Scrutiny of applications and supporting documents submitted by email.
  • Shortlisting of eligible candidates based on laid down qualification and experience criteria.
  • Intimation to shortlisted candidates via email regarding personal interview schedule (venue, date and time).

The shortlisted candidates will be considered for engagement on fixed term contract basis. Candidature is purely provisional and liable to rejection at any stage if eligibility criteria or document authenticity is not satisfied. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.

Instructions & Terms for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

  • Contract period is 3 years, extendable for another 2 years (year-on-year basis) subject to satisfactory performance and mutual consent.
  • Annual increment of 5% may be allowed on the negotiable monthly package.
  • During training period, stipend of Rs. 50,000 per month will be paid; full remuneration starts from commencement of supervisor line flying (SLF).
  • Aviation Personal Accident (PA) / Loss of License (LOL) insurance premium will be borne by AAI as per guidelines, with current cover of Rs. 50 lakhs each.
  • Co-Pilot must make himself/herself available for license and medical renewals, IR/PPC and simulator checks as scheduled; failure makes the pilot ineligible to draw contracted amount on pro rata basis until currency is restored.
  • AAI will arrange hotel accommodation and transportation at outstations during calibration duties as per entitlement of Joint General Manager, AAI; accommodation at base station (Delhi) is to be arranged by the Co-Pilot.
  • Co-Pilot will be eligible for 12 days casual leave and 18 days sick leave in a calendar year; un-availed leave cannot be carried forward or encashed and excess leave attracts pro rata deduction.
  • No Gratuity, CPF or medical facility will be provided by AAI to Co-Pilot or dependents.
  • Contract can be terminated by either side by giving 6 months’ notice; AAI can also terminate if Co-Pilot remains absent continuously for more than 15 days beyond entitled leave.
  • During contract, Co-Pilot must make himself/herself available for AAI calibration duties and related jobs and cannot engage elsewhere without approval of Executive Director (FIU) for license currency or additional flying hours.

Salary/Stipend & Training for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

  • Monthly Package: Negotiable, starting from Rs. 2.50 lakhs per month, including assured flying allowance of 50 hours; overtime flying allowance for hours beyond 50 per month as per guidelines.
  • Annual Increment: 5% on negotiable monthly package, subject to AAI policy.
  • Training & Bonds (Initial Currency / Non-rated Pilots):
    • Initial currency training on type and associated expenditure arranged by AAI, subject to execution of a 3-year bond; costs recovered on reducing basis @ Rs. 1 lakh per month.
    • Non-rated co-pilots on type, if selected, will undergo DGCA-approved training arranged by AAI against suitable bank security and must execute a 3-year bond. If training is not successfully completed, repeat training at own cost is required; otherwise AAI recovers expenses from bank security.
    • Training & associated TA/DA expenses recovered @ Rs. 1.5 lakhs per month after attaining initial currency.
    • For IR/PPC simulator training, co-pilot must execute a bond to serve AAI for minimum 1 year from completion of simulator training; fees/charges paid by AAI against bank guarantee/postdated cheque.
    • Stipend during training: Rs. 50,000 per month; full remuneration from start of SLF.
  • Sustenance Allowance: 50% of monthly hiring charges will be paid during suspension period on pro rata basis; in case of adverse outcome, this allowance must be returned by the co-pilot.

Vacancy Details

Post Name Experience
Chief Operating Officer (COO) Minimum 8 years of overall experience in the IT industry, start-up ecosystem as co-founder/founder/CxO and/or as an enabler of Start-up, Innovation & entrepreneurship ecosystem by virtue of managing/leading/scaling reputed Innovation & start-up promoting organizations/ incubators/ accelerators/ centres-of-entrepreneurship/ entrepreneurship development cells / mentoring organization etc
Incubation Manager 5+ years of work experience including minimum 3 years of experience in incubation management & Incubation Ecosystem, demonstrating ability to cultivate, build and maintain strong working relationships with start-ups, entrepreneurs, mentors, universities, research institutions, industry experts, associations, chamber of commerce & industries, state & central government, angel investors etc.
Technology Specialist Should have 4 to 6 Years of experience in IoT and experience preferably in applications in IoT, energy, water, or environmental IoT solutions.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification for COO: Bachelor’s in Technology/Engineering (or equivalent degree) or Master in Technology/ Engineering/ Science or MBA from a recognized, accredited and reputed institute/university
  • Experience for COO: Minimum 8 years of overall experience in the IT industry, start-up ecosystem as co-founder/founder/CxO and/or as an enabler of Start-up, Innovation & entrepreneurship ecosystem by virtue of managing/leading/scaling reputed Innovation & start-up promoting organizations/ incubators/ accelerators/ centres-of-entrepreneurship/ entrepreneurship development cells / mentoring organization etc
  • Essential Qualification for Incubation Manager: Graduate from a recognized university
  • Desirable Qualification for Incubation Manager: Post-Graduation in Management
  • Experience for Incubation Manager: 5+ years of work experience including minimum 3 years of experience in incubation management & Incubation Ecosystem, demonstrating ability to cultivate, build and maintain strong working relationships with start-ups, entrepreneurs, mentors, universities, research institutions, industry experts, associations, chamber of commerce & industries, state & central government, angel investors etc.
  • Essential Qualification for Technology Specialist: Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, Mechatronics or related field.
  • Desirable Qualification for Technology Specialist: Post-Graduation in related fields.
  • Experience for Technology Specialist: Should have 4 to 6 Years of experience in IoT and experience preferably in applications in IoT, energy, water, or environmental IoT solutions.

Salary/ Stipend

  • COO: Rs. 1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand Only) per month (relaxation as per industry standards permissible for deserving candidates) subjected to provisions in DPR.
  • Incubation Manager: In the range of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 75,000 per month (relaxation as per industry standards permissible for deserving candidates).
  • Technology Specialist: Rs. 100000/- (Rupees one Lakh only) per month (relaxation as per industry standards permissible for deserving candidates).

Age Limit (as on the last date of receipt of the applications)

  • COO: Below 45 years (relaxation permissible for deserving candidates)
  • Incubation Manager: Below 35 years (relaxation permissible for deserving candidates)
  • Technology Specialist: Below 40 years (relaxation permissible for deserving candidates)

Selection Process

  • Applications received by the last date will be first screened by a duly constituted ‘Screening Committee’. The candidates meeting the educational & other qualifications and experience, as advertised, may be screened-in by the Committee.
  • The ‘screened-in’ shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview before the duly constituted ‘Search-cum-Selection Committee’ or ‘Selection Committee’ on the scheduled date & time. The committee may consider other candidates also fulfilling the eligibility as advertised.
  • Search-cum-Selection Committee or Selection Committee will recommend the candidate/panel of candidates, in order of merit, for appointment.

General Information / Instructions

  • The COO shall report to STPI Jurisdictional Director.
  • The IM shall report to COO or STPI Jurisdictional Director as decided by the STPI Jurisdictional Director.
  • The Finance Executive shall report to the Head of CoE-EA or STPI Jurisdictional Director as decided by the STPI Jurisdictional Director.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Any candidate found canvassing for his/her candidature, will be summarily disqualified.
  • Experience in the relevant field shall be calculated after attaining the minimum essential qualification(s).
  • Mere submission of application does not entitle candidates to be called for test and/or interview.
  • Certificate w.r.t. educational qualifications, experience, age etc. will be uploaded by the candidates while submitting online application.
  • If any candidate is found ineligible on any ground post his/her appointment in the company, his/her services will be liable to be terminated without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Submission of any false/misleading information, defective or fabricated document etc. by the candidate in the application form would not only lead for rejection of application of the candidate but other legal action, as deem appropriate, may also be taken by the Company against such candidate.
  • The maximum age shall be as on the last date of receipt of the applications. Screening of applications will be based on qualifications, age, academic record and relevant experience.
  • No TA/DA will be given for appearing in the interview.
  • Contract may be renewed based on performance. Work location can change based on mutual agreement.
  • Any litigation will be subject to the jurisdiction of Delhi courts.
  • STPI reserves the right to fill all or some or none of the positions advertised without assigning any reason as it deems fit.

How to Apply

  • Applications shall be invited Online.

Selection Process for CSIR-NPL Recruitment 2026

The selection for CSIR-NPL vacancy 2026 will be conducted through following stages:

Stage 1 - Screening by Committee

  • Applications will be scrutinized by duly constituted Screening Committee
  • Committee will adopt its own criteria for shortlisting candidates
  • Only shortlisted candidates called for Trade Test

Stage 2 - Trade Test (Qualifying Nature)

  • Trade test in relevant trade/discipline
  • Schedule: May/June 2026
  • Nature: Qualifying test
  • Minimum threshold marks to be determined by Selection Committee
  • Only candidates qualifying in Trade Test will be called for Written Examination

Stage 3 - Competitive Written Examination

Mode: OMR Based or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination

Medium: Questions in both English and Hindi (except English Language questions)

Standard: Diploma/Graduation Level

Total Questions: 200

Total Time: 3 hours

Examination Pattern:

Paper-I (Mental Ability Test) - 1 Hour, Qualifying

  • Questions: 50
  • Maximum Marks: 100 (2 marks per correct answer)
  • Negative Marking: None
  • Topics: General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, Problem Solving, Situational Judgement

Paper-II - 30 Minutes

  • General Awareness: 25 questions, 75 marks (3 marks each), 1 negative mark per wrong answer
  • English Language: 25 questions, 75 marks (3 marks each), 1 negative mark per wrong answer
  • Total: 50 questions, 150 marks

Paper-III (Concerned Subject) - 90 Minutes

  • Questions: 100
  • Maximum Marks: 300 (3 marks per correct answer)
  • Negative Marking: 1 mark per wrong answer
  • Topics: Concerned subject as per post code applied

Merit List Preparation:

  • Paper-I is qualifying in nature
  • Paper-II and Paper-III evaluated only for candidates securing minimum threshold marks in Paper-I
  • Final merit based on performance in Paper-II and Paper-III combined
  • Minimum threshold marks (Cut-off) will be notified before written exam

Tie Resolution (in order of precedence):

  1. Higher marks in concerned subject/trade papers
  2. Lesser negative marks in concerned subject/trade
  3. Lesser negative marks in all evaluated papers
  4. Older candidate (Date of Birth)
  5. Earlier acquisition of Essential Degree
  6. Alphabetical order of first names

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only those candidates who are possessing a University degree are eligible to apply for the advertised posts.
  • Candidates must have their name appearing in the list of non-recommended candidates of Civil Services Examination 2024 (CSE-2024) conducted by the Union Public Service Commission.
  • Candidates who do not fulfill these eligibility conditions need not apply against this advertisement.

Salary/Stipend

  • All Section Officer posts are classified as Group B (Gazetted).
  • The Pay Level is 8, Cell – 1 in the Pay Matrix, with a pay scale of Rs. 47,600 – Rs. 1,51,100.
  • The posts carry usual allowances such as Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA) at Central Government rates as applicable at the place of posting.
  • Council employees are also eligible for benefits like reimbursement of medical expenses, Leave Travel Concession, House Building Advance and other benefits as applicable.
  • The posts will be governed by the New Pension System applicable from 01.01.2004 as notified by Government of India and adopted by CSIR, subject to rules for those coming from other Government Departments/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/Central Universities.

Age Limit 

  • Maximum age: Not exceeding 33 years (as on the closing date of online application).
  • Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe (SC/ST): Relaxation of 5 years beyond the upper age limit.
  • Other Backward Classes OBC (NCL): Relaxation of 3 years beyond the upper age limit.
  • PwBD (Unreserved): Relaxation of 10 years beyond the upper age limit.
  • PwBD (SC/ST): Relaxation of 15 years beyond the upper age limit.
  • PwBD (OBC): Relaxation of 13 years beyond the upper age limit.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Relaxation of 3 years after deduction of the actual military service rendered from actual age as on closing date.
  • CSIR Departmental candidates: Relaxation of 5 years.
  • Any other category: No age relaxation.

Application Fee

Category Application Fee
Unreserved (UR), OBC (NCL) and EWS Categories Rs. 500.00
Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen NIL

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Start Date for Registration for Online Application 15.01.2026 (10:00 AM)
Last Date for Registration & Submission of Online Application 04.02.2026 (05:00 PM)
Last date for Online Payment of Application Fee 04.02.2026 (05:00 PM)

Selection Process

  • Applications received in response to the advertisement shall be screened to shortlist candidates to be called for interview in the ratio of minimum 1:2.5 (i.e. 2.5 times of total vacancies of Section Officer, subject to minimum three).
  • Shortlisting will be based on total marks (Mains plus Personality Test) obtained by the candidate in UPSC’s CSE-2024 as mentioned in their mark sheet.
  • Final selection will be made on the basis of total marks (Mains plus Personality Test) obtained in UPSC’s CSE-2024 and marks obtained in Interview to be conducted by CSIR.
  • The Interview will carry a maximum of 350 marks.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be required to appear for Interview-cum-Document Verification at Delhi only.

General Information/Instructions

  • The applicant must be a citizen of India and must fulfill the essential requirements and other conditions stipulated in the advertisement.
  • The prescribed educational qualifications must have been obtained from a University/Institution/Board recognised by Government of India/approved by Government Regulatory Bodies, with the final result declared on or before the last date of receipt of online application.
  • Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria will not entitle candidates to be called for Interview/Document Verification; the decision of CSIR regarding eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications and mode of selection shall be final.
  • Applicants working in Government Departments must produce a ‘No Objection Certificate’ from their employer at the time of document verification, failing which their candidature will not be considered.
  • Incomplete applications and lack of required certificates/documents are liable to be rejected; any discrepancy between application information and original documents will make the candidate ineligible.
  • If any declaration or information is found false or material information is willfully suppressed, candidature may be cancelled at any stage and the person may be liable to removal from service after joining.
  • The date for determining upper age limit and qualification shall be the closing date of the online application.
  • Officers recruited shall be placed on probation for a period of two years from the date of joining, which may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Appointing Authority.
  • Officers holding posts under CSIR shall be liable to serve anywhere in India and may be transferred to any of the laboratories or institutes of CSIR or its units/extension centres or CSIR Headquarters.
  • CSIR reserves the right to modify, alter, restrict, enlarge or cancel the recruitment process, if necessary, without further notice or assigning any reason.

How to Apply

  • Candidates have to apply online only through the official website of CSIR HQRS: https://www.csir.res.in or https://recruitment.csir.res.in from 15 January 2026 (Thursday) at 10:00 AM to 04 February 2026 (Wednesday) till 05:00 PM.
  • No other means/mode of application will be accepted and candidates should have a valid email ID kept active till final selection.
  • Candidates must scan and upload their photograph, signature, proof of date of birth, educational qualifications (10th onwards), CSE-2024 mark sheets, experience certificates, caste/community and disability certificates (if applicable) and any other supporting documents in prescribed formats.
  • Candidates must first register using their UPSC Roll Number, email address and mobile number to obtain a User ID and password, then complete their profile and fill all sections of the online application form.
  • After filling all details and uploading documents, candidates should preview and verify the entire application form before final submission, as details cannot be changed after submission.
  • Candidates required to pay the application fee must make payment through SBI Collect, select the appropriate payment category, enter details correctly, and upload the e-Receipt in the online application before the last date.
  • The physical/hard copy (print-out) of the online application form along with enclosures shall be produced as and when required by the office.
  • To avoid last minute rush, candidates are advised to apply online at the earliest; CSIR HQRS will not be responsible for inability to submit applications due to any reason.

  • To determine the equivalency of required pay scales with pay scales in other Government Organizations, the minimum basic pay of the NCRTC pay scale will be compared with the minimum basic pay of pay scale in question. In such cases, if the minimum basic pay of the pay scale being compared is equal to or higher than the minimum basic pay of the NCRTC pay scale in which recruitment is being carried out, the candidate will be treated as working in equivalent pay scale. As an extension, if the minimum basic pay of the pay scale being compared is lower than the minimum basic pay of the NCRTC pay scale in which recruitment is being carried out, the candidate will be treated as working in the lower pay scale, irrespective of maximum basic pay of such a pay scale (only for the purpose of eligibility in scrutiny).
  • The candidature of the registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of the recruitment process or after recruitment or joining, if any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or is not found in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned above.
  • NCRTC reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards. NCRTC also reserves the right to fill or not to fill all or any of the above positions and cancel/ restrict/ enlarge/ modify/ alter the recruitment/ selection process without any further notice or assigning any reasons whatsoever.
  • The prescribed qualification/ experience criteria are minimum and mere possession of the same does not entitle a candidate for participating in the Selection Process. NCRTC’s decision shall be final in this regard.
  • Experience on a post/ level shall be counted from the date of assumption of charge.
  • Teaching or freelancing experience shall not be considered as qualifying experience.
  • Candidates once selected but did not join for any reason shall be debarred to apply for any positions in NCRTC for a period of two (02) years from the date of Offer of Appointment issued to them.
  • No person shall be eligible for appointment who has previously been dismissed, removed, or compulsorily retired from the service of the Corporation or from a department of a state or the Central Government or a local authority or from public sector undertaking, or from an autonomous corporation.
  • No person shall be eligible for appointment who has been convicted in a Court of Law for any offence involving moral turpitude.
  • In case none of the candidates are found suitable against the advertised vacancy, the Selection Committee may recommend candidate(s) for a lower post, if suitable, subject to meeting the reservation requirements if any, in view of exigency of work.
  • In case of dispute arising on account of interpretation in versions of language other than English, the English version shall prevail.
  • Candidates working with Government entities/ CPSEs/ SPSEs in regular capacity are only eligible for immediate absorption. Hence candidates working in contract/ad-hoc basis are not eligible.
  • No correspondence from applicants regarding their eligibility to apply for the above post will be entertained.
  • Any revision, clarification, addendum, corrigendum, time extension etc., to the above Vacancy Notice will be hosted on ‘Career’ section of NCRTC (www.ncrtc.in) only and no separate notification shall be issued in the press. Candidates are requested to visit the website regularly to keep themselves updated.
  • Canvassing by the applicant, directly or indirectly will result in disqualification of his/ her candidature. Any dispute with regards to recruitment against this Vacancy Notice will be settled within the jurisdiction of Delhi High Court only.
  • In case of any query, candidates may write to [email protected], mentioning “POST– ASSISTANT MANAGER - 01/2026” in the Subject Line. Candidates are advised to add this e-mail ID to their address book. NCRTC will not be responsible for non-delivery of e- mail/ delivery of e-mail to junk or spam folder. Contact No. 011-24666700 (10:00 AM to 4:30 PM).

How to Apply

Valid E-mail ID and Mobile Number. ii. Scanned Copy of self-attested recent passport size coloured photograph (3.5. X 4.5 cm) of the candidate (File Size upto 100 kb, in .jpg/ .jpeg format only). iii. Scanned copy of signature (signed on white paper with blue/ black pen) of the candidate (File Size upto 100 kb, in .jpg/ .jpeg format only)
  • While applying online, candidates need to upload copies of the following self-attested documents: i. 10th Certificate/ Birth Certificate. ii. Degree Certificate of Graduation and PG. iii. Appointment letter, Joining Order and latest salary slip of present organization. iv. Experience Certificate/ (s) & Duty allocation orders. v. Copies of the APARs (Last Three Years). vi. Office Orders indicating promotions. vii. Experience/ Service Certificate/ Relieving order issued by previous organizations. viii. Form-16/ ITR. ix. Last 6 months’ bank statement. x. Last 3 months’ salary slips.
  • Applications without supporting certificates/ documents as mentioned above, shall be summarily rejected.

  • The envelope containing the print-out of application and supporting documents, should be superscribed as ‘APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASSISTANT MANAGER ON IMMEDIATE ABSORPTION BASIS – 01/2026’.

Registration Number, Password and all other important communication will be sent on the same registered e-mail ID (Please ensure that email sent to this mailbox is not redirected to junk/ spam folder).

ESIC IMO Recruitment 2026 - Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) invites applications offline for 225 Insurance Medical Officer Grade-II (IMO Gr. II) posts across India. The recruitment is based on Combined Medical Services Examination (CMSE)-2024 marks from UPSC via the Pratibha Setu Portal, targeting MBBS graduates with compulsory rotating internship completion, registration with National/State Medical Council, and consent for sharing CMSE-2024 marks. ESIC Insurance Medical Officer Grade-II (IMO Gr. II) Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Total
Insurance Medical Officer Grade-II (IMO Gr. II) 225

Note: Total vacancies include 62 positions broken down as: 9+24 (backlog from 2024 roster) + 29 (backlog carried forward from last two recruitment cycles). The vacancies may undergo changes depending upon actual requirement. Candidates selected under PwBD category will be adjusted against their main category of UR, SC, ST, OBC and EWS.

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • A recognised MBBS degree qualification included in the First Schedule or Second Schedule or Part-II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956).
  • Holders of educational qualifications included in Part-II of the Third Schedule should also fulfill the conditions specified in sub-section (3) of section 13 of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956).
  • Completion of Compulsory rotating internship. Candidates who may not have completed rotating internships shall be eligible to apply provided that, if selected, they shall have satisfactorily completed the compulsory internship before appointment.

Desirable

  • Candidates whose names appear in the details of candidates of CMSE-2024 on the Pratibha Setu Portal of UPSC, as on closing date i.e. 17.02.2026 are eligible to apply.
  • Registration with National Medical Council or State Medical Council is mandatory.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Level-10 in the Pay Matrix Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500 per month
  • Non-Practicing Allowance: As admissible to analogous post in the Central Government
  • Additional Benefits: DA (Dearness Allowance), NPA (Non-Practicing Allowance), HRA (House Rent Allowance) and Transport Allowance as per rules of Government of India in force from time to time

Age Limit (as on 01.08.2024)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 35 years as on 01.08.2024
  • Age Relaxation: Relaxable up to five years for employees of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation and Government servants in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government from time to time
  • Upper Age Relaxation: Upper age limit is also relaxable to SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Ex-Servicemen and other categories of persons as per rules/instructions of Government of India
  • SC/ST/OBC/Ex-Serviceman Relaxation: As per DOPT OM No. 15012/2/2010-Estt(D) dated 27.03.2012

Application Fee

  • No application fee mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 13/01/2026
Closing Date of Submission of Applications 17/02/2026
Last Date for candidates from Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Lahaul and Spiti district, Pangi Sub-Division of Chamba district of Himachal Pradesh, and Union territories of Ladakh, Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep 24/02/2026
Cutoff Date for Eligibility (CMSE 2024 closing date) 30/04/2024
Age Limit Reference Date 01/08/2024

Selection Process

  • Based on the details of candidates of CMSE-2024 available on the Pratibha Setu Portal of UPSC, as on closing date i.e. 17.02.2026, a communication will be sent to the candidates, inviting applications, on the given email id and on the communication address.
  • Minimum qualifying standard for the respective category of the candidate will be considered for considering the candidates of reserved category as mentioned in the UPSC application form.
  • It is mandatory for the candidates to give their consent for sharing their marks of CMSE 2024 by UPSC with ESIC as per the declaration provided in the application form.
  • Based on the applications received, a merit list will be prepared based on the marks of the respective candidates obtained in CMSE-2024, conducted by UPSC.
  • Applications received without the consent regarding sharing of marks of CMSE 2024 by UPSC with ESIC shall be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates selected will be posted in ESIC Hospitals/Dispensaries anywhere in India as per requirement of ESIC.

General Information/Instructions

Nationality/Citizenship

  • A candidate must be either: (a) a citizen of India, or (b) a subject of Nepal, or (c) a subject of Bhutan
  • A Tibetan refugee who came over to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African Countries with the intention of permanently settling in India
  • Candidates belonging to categories (b), (c), (d) and (e) shall require a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India

Person with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) Eligibility

  • Category C: Locomotor Disability (One Arm, One Leg, Both Leg, One Arm and One Leg), Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims (Non-Surgical Jobs)
  • Category D: Specific Learning Disability (SLD)
  • Category E: Multiple Disabilities (MD) from amongst persons under categories C and D above
  • Physical Requirements: Sitting, Standing, Walking, Reading & Writing, Seeing, Hearing, Communication

Important Instructions

  • Incomplete or unsigned applications or applications not in the prescribed proforma shall be rejected.
  • Applications received without self-attested copies of mark sheets/certificates in support of educational qualification, proof of age, caste certificate, photographs may be rejected.
  • Applications received after last date shall be rejected without any communication to the candidate.
  • Wrong declarations/submission of false information shall lead to cancellation of the candidature at any stage.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.
  • All candidates whether in Government service or in private employment should submit their applications directly to the ESI Corporation.
  • Persons already in Regular Government service are required to submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department about applying for the selection.
  • They have to submit the NOC from the present employer at the time of document verification.
  • The decision of ESIC in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, and posting will be final and binding.

Disqualification

  • No person who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having spouse living shall be eligible for appointment.
  • No person who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person shall be eligible for appointment.
  • The Director General of ESIC may grant exemption if such marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable to such person.

How to Apply

  • The duly filled and signed Application Form in the prescribed Performa along with self-attested copies of certificates is to be sent in a cover super-scribed "Application for the post of IMO Gr. II in ESIC" by Speed Post.
  • Address to send application: The Joint Director (Recruitment), ESI Corporation, Panchdeep Bhawan, CIG Marg, New Delhi-110002
  • Applications must reach by 17.02.2026
  • Candidates are advised to submit the application well in advance without waiting upto the closing date.
  • Applications received after the last date by any mode will not be accepted.
  • ESI Corporation will not be responsible for postal delays.
  • Application forwarded through email will not be accepted.
  • Applications submitted by candidates whose names do not appear in the details of candidates of CMSE-2024 on the Pratibha Setu Portal of UPSC, as on closing date i.e. 17.02.2026 shall be summarily rejected.

Documents/Certificates to be Submitted

  • One recent self-attested passport size photograph firmly pasted on the application form
  • Matriculation/10th Standard or equivalent certificate indicating date of birth
  • Degree certificate along with marksheets pertaining to all academic years as proof of educational qualification (provisional certificate acceptable in absence of degree certificate)
  • Caste certificate by candidate seeking reservation as SC/ST/OBC/EWS from competent authority
  • Declaration by OBC candidate that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer on the closing date i.e. 17.02.2026
  • Certificate of Disability in prescribed proforma for PwBD candidates
  • Documentary support for any other claims made
  • Documents for name change after matriculation (if applicable)
  • Certificate/Document in respect of Age relaxation for Ex-Servicemen and other categories
  • MBBS registration certificate with National Medical Council or State Medical Council
  • Certificate of completion of compulsory rotating internship
  • UPSC CMSE 2024 Roll Number and Final Marks details
  • Consent declaration for sharing CMSE 2024 marks by UPSC with ESIC

The total number of vacancies for HPRCA English and Mathematics Teacher Recruitment 2026 is 624 posts. Category-wise vacancy distribution for each post is as follows:

Note: The number of posts is tentative and may increase or decrease. Vacancies and reservation are liable to be altered without notice as per requisitions and R&P Rules.

Eligibility Criteria for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026

1. Educational Qualification

English Teacher (Post Code 26002)

  • M.A. English with 50% marks in Graduation with B.Ed and teaching of English as compulsory subject in B.Ed (B.A B.Ed/B.Com B.Ed/B.Sc B.Ed will be eligible).
  • The applicant must have passed Graduation (including B.Ed) with a minimum of 50% marks and 55% marks in English at Graduation level.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates should have at least 45% marks in Graduation (and 45% marks in B.Ed) and 50% marks in English at Graduation level.

Mathematics Teacher (Post Code 26003)

  • M.A/M.Sc. Mathematics with 50% marks in Graduation with B.Ed and teaching of Mathematics as compulsory subject in B.Ed (B.A-B.Ed/B.Com-B.Ed/B.Sc-B.Ed will be eligible).
  • The applicant must have passed Graduation (including B.Ed) with a minimum of 50% marks and 55% marks in Mathematics at Graduation level.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates should have at least 45% marks in Graduation and 45% marks in B.Ed and 50% marks in Mathematics at Graduation level.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for HPRCA English and Mathematics Teacher Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Minimum Age: 25 years
  • Maximum Age: 45 years
  • Age Calculation Date: As on 21.02.2026 (closing date of ORA)
  • Age Relaxation: There will be no age relaxation to any of the categories.

3. Nationality

Candidates from Himachal Pradesh and other states can apply; however, candidates of reserved categories from other States will be treated as General (UR) category for reservation and fee purposes as per instructions.

Selection Process for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Objective Screening Test of 120 marks of 1½ hours duration or as decided by HPRCA.
  • Objective type screening test with 120 multiple-choice questions (1 mark each).
  • Syllabus:
    • Subject/field up to the level of prescribed essential qualifications.
    • General Knowledge including Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs, Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi (Matric level).
  • Normalization of scores using Z-Score Method in case of multiple shifts.
  • Document verification for shortlisted candidates.

Note: Minimum qualifying marks: 45% for General category and 40% for SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters, with possible relaxation by 5% if required as per notification.

Application Fee for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026

  • Processing Fee: ₹700 for all categories.
  • Total Fee: ₹800 per application.
  • Correction Fee: ₹100 (for corrections during the correction window).
  • Payment Mode: Online Payment Gateway using Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking (no other mode accepted).

How to Apply for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: https://hprca.hp.gov.in

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on One Stage Competitive Written Examination
  • Examination will be conducted through MCQ (Multiple Choice Questions) in CBRT/OMR (Computer Based Response Test/Optical Mark Recognition) mode
  • The examination will consist of one question paper divided into Part-A and Part-B
  • Part-A (Total 90 Marks): Logical Reasoning & Data Interpretation (30 marks), Mathematical Aptitude (30 marks), Indian Constitution, Current Affairs, Gujarati & English Comprehension (30 marks)
  • Part-B (Total 120 Marks): Questions related to the subject and its applications (120 marks). Subject syllabus will be as per the prescribed educational qualification
  • Total Questions: 210 questions (Part-A: 90 questions + Part-B: 120 questions)
  • Total Time: 3 hours (180 minutes) for both parts combined
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer
  • Minimum Qualifying Standard: 40% marks in Part-A and 40% marks in Part-B separately
  • Final merit list will be prepared based on total marks obtained (or normalized marks) in the examination

  • Reserved category posts are reserved only for candidates who are originally from Gujarat
  • For SEBC category candidates, Non-Creamy Layer certificate for financial year 2022-23/2023-24/2024-25 is mandatory
  • Widow women candidates will get 5% additional marks in the competitive examination
  • Sports quota candidates who have represented in National/International or Inter-University or All India School Federation competitions will get 5% additional marks
  • Computer basic knowledge certificate is mandatory for appointment
  • Candidates appearing in the examination must comply with all instructions given in the admit card
  • Any unfair means adopted during examination will lead to disqualification and legal action under Gujarat Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2023
  • The Board reserves the right to cancel/modify the advertisement or recruitment process at any stage
  • For any guidance regarding educational qualification, age limit, online application or fee payment, contact GSSSB office at phone number: 079-23258916

  • Click on "Online Application" and select GSSSB
  • Select Advertisement No. 372/202526, Occupational Therapist, Class-3 and click on "Apply"
  • Click on "Apply now" option
  • Fill all mandatory fields marked with red asterisk (*) in "Personal Details"
  • Fill "Educational Details" section
  • Accept the terms and conditions in "Assurance" section by selecting "Yes" and click "Save"

IITGN IPDF 2026 Vacancy & Project Details

The advertisement is for an Institute Postdoctoral Fellow (IPDF) position at IIT Gandhinagar for the project titled “Thermodynamic Framework Development and Fabrication of Stable Lubricant Infused Micropatterned Slippery Non-Wetting Surfaces for Underwater Applications”. The candidate will contribute to the development and validation of a thermodynamic framework for designing and fabricating liquid-based slippery hydrophobic micropatterned surfaces for underwater applications.

Experimental techniques such as spin coating, dip coating, lithography, electron microscopy, contact angle goniometry and drop adhesion tests will be used, and the durability of slippery surfaces for underwater applications will be investigated.

Eligibility Criteria for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must fulfill the following essential requirements:

  • Ph.D. degree in one of the following or allied fields with relevant background:
    Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ceramic Engineering, Food Engineering, Chemistry, Physics.
  • The percentage/grade points should be a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards.
  • At least 55% marks or equivalent in classes 10th and 12th is required.
  • Candidates who have submitted Ph.D. thesis are also eligible to apply.

2. Age Limit

The advertisement does not specify an age limit for the Institute Postdoctoral Fellow position.

3. Project-related Skills

Given the project description, candidates are expected to have relevant research background and interest in:

  • Thermodynamic framework development for liquid-based slippery hydrophobic surfaces.
  • Experimental techniques such as spin coating, dip coating, lithography, electron microscopy, contact angle goniometry and drop adhesion tests.
  • Investigation of durability of slippery surfaces for underwater applications.

Selection Process for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026

The selection process will involve:

  • Shortlisting of candidates based on eligibility, academic performance and relevant research background.
  • Interview conducted in online mode.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed regarding the date and time of the interview via email.

Application Fee for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026

  • The advertisement does not mention any application fee.

How to Apply for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Prepare your academic and research details, including information required for an online application form.
  2. Visit the application link provided in the advertisement:
    https://forms.gle/5XnvkjJ5x4nNQVP18
  3. Fill the Google Form application carefully with all required details.
  4. Submit the online application form on or before 10 February 2026.
  5. For any queries, candidates may email Dr. Sriharitha Rowthu at [email protected].

Instructions for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026
