Eligibility Criteria

Chief Manager - Boiler Operation

  • Full time B.E. / B.Tech (Mechanical / Chemical) with First Class from recognized Institute/University. Candidate must have passed Boiler Operation Engineer Certificate.
  • Around 20 Years of Post-Qualification Experience in Boiler Operation & Maintenance of large industrial organization.

Chief Manager - Maintenance

  • Full time B.E. / B.Tech (Mechanical) with First Class from recognized Institute/University.
  • Around 20 Years of Post-Qualification Experience in Plant Maintenance of large industrial organization.

Engineer - Instrumentation (On Contract)

  • Full time B.E. / B.Tech (Instrumentation & Control) with First Class from a reputed and recognized Institute/University.
  • Minimum 4 years of Post Qualification experience in instrumentation department in process industries with focus on plant data integration, sensor checks, operations of DCS / APC etc.

Engineer - IT (On Contract)

  • Full time B.E. / B.Tech (Computer Science / Information Technology) with First Class from a reputed and recognized Institute/University.
  • Minimum 4 years of Post Qualification experience in managing IT Infrastructure, IT databases etc.

Data Scientist (On Contract)

  • Full time B.E. / B.Tech (Computer Science / Information Technology) with First Class from a reputed and recognized Institute/University.
  • Minimum 4 years of Post Qualification experience in machine learning based analytics, implementation of digital initiatives, analytics model development etc.

Chief Manager - Training Centre

  • full-time MBA(HR) / MHRM /MSW / MLW other equivalent qualification from reputed Institute/University.
  • Around 20 Years of Post-Qualification Experience in training & development of large industrial organization.

Chief Manager - Administration

  • full-time MBA(HR) / MHRM /MSW / MLW other equivalent qualification from reputed Institute/University.
  • Around 20 Years of Post-Qualification Experience in Administration Department of large industrial organization.

Chief Manager - Electrical

  • B.E. / B.Tech (Electrical) with First Class from recognized Institute/University.
  • Around 20 Years of Post-Qualification Experience in Electrical Maintenance of large industrial organization.

 Age Limit

  • Maximum Age limit for Chief Manager: Around 45 Years
  • Maximum Age limit for Data Scientist and Engineer: Around 28 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 28-01-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 03-02-2026

Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee the operation of all boiler units to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient steam generation in line with production requirements and statutory norms.

  • Monitor boiler performance parameters (pressure, temperature, efficiency, fuel consumption, heat rate) and implement corrective actions to optimize efficiency and reduce energy losses.

  • Plan, coordinate, and supervise preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of boilers and auxiliaries to minimize downtime and extend equipment life.

  • Ensure strict compliance with boiler safety regulations, factory acts, pollution control norms, and other statutory requirements, including inspections, certifications, and audits.

  • Manage fuel procurement, handling, storage, and consumption efficiently; evaluate alternative fuels and implement cost-effective fuel utilization strategies.

  • Lead, mentor, and train boiler operation and maintenance staff; ensure proper shift management, competency development, and adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • Identify root-cause analysis of boiler failures, trips, or abnormal operations; implement corrective and preventive measures to avoid recurrence.

Remuneration

Chief Manager:

  •  The selected candidate will be taken on Company’s Regular Grade GREO-04 and the existing CTC of Grade GREO-04 is Approx. Rs. 26.16 Lacs per annum. The CTC revision is due in July – 2026.

Engineer:

  • During 1st Year of Contract CTC will be 8.50 LPA (Approx.) and During 2nd Year of Contract CTC will be 9.00 LPA (Approx.). Regular Absorption upon successful completion of Contract Period. The current CTC of Regular Grade GREO-08 is Approx. Rs. 17.15 Lacs per annum. The CTC revision is due in July – 2026.

Data Scientist:

  • During 1st Year of Contract CTC will be 8.50 LPA (Approx.) and During 2nd Year of Contract CTC will be 9.00 LPA (Approx.). Regular Absorption upon successful completion of Contract Period. The current CTC of Regular Grade GREO-08 is Approx. Rs. 17.15 Lacs per annum. The CTC revision is due in July – 2026.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates may fill-up the application form online through mentioned link as well as upload the detailed resume latest by 03/02/2026

2. Candidates seeking reservation benefits under SC/ST/OBC/EWS category must produce original certificate in prescribed format of Govt. of India in support of their claim.
1. This is a rolling advertisement, applicable for filling the vacancies declared above as well as any unfilled and/or newly created posts through subsequent amendment notifications (issued as short notices) to be published only on the official websites, i.e., www.esic.gov.in/recruitments and www.bapunagarhospital.esic.gov.in/recruitments.
2. Walk-in interviews shall be conducted for vacancies that remain unfilled and/or as per the operational requirements of the Hospital as on the date of interview. The number of vacancies available shall be published on the ESIC website (www.esic.gov.in/recruitments and www.bapunagarhospital.esic.gov.in/recruitments) at least 5-7 days prior to the scheduled Walk-in Interview, proposed to be held on the 1st of every month, or on the next working day in case of a holiday, subject to change due to administrative exigencies.
3. Eligible and interested candidates who fulfill the prescribed eligibility criteria in all respects may appear for the Walk-in Interview on the notified date.
4. Applicants applying in response to this advertisement are advised to satisfy themselves regarding their eligibility for the post applied for. They must fulfill the eligibility criteria in all respects as on the date of the Walk-in Interview.
1. The candidate should report at 09:30 AM for verification of documents at Conference hall (2nd Floor) of ESIC Model Hospital, Bapunagar, Ahmedabad. Only candidates clear the document verification will be allowed to appear before the interview panel.

The appointment will be initially for a period of one year, which is extendable for a period of 03 years on an annual basis, subject to satisfactory performance to be reviewed every year.
4. Tenure of Contractual Part/Full time Super Specialist will be for one year (which is extendable only for full time super specialist for a period of 03 years on an annual basis, subject to satisfactory performance to be reviewed every year and requirement), or till faculty is posted in the concerned Super Specialty, whichever is earlier.
5. Candidates claiming reservation/age relaxation on ground of belonging to the OBC should submit the community certificate as prescribed by GOI, DOPT OM No. 36012/12/22/93-ESTT. (SCT) dated 08/09/93 which is modified by GOI DOPT OM No. 36033/3/2004(Res.) dated 09/03/2004 and time to time failing which the benefit of reservation/relaxation will not be given or their application shall be rejected. The OBC-NCL Certificate should be valid.
6. Candidates seeking reservation benefits under SC/ST/OBC/EWS category must produce original certificates in the prescribed format of Govt. of India.

8. No claim of any service benefit like PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical allowance, Seniority, Promotion and leave etc., will be admissible.
9. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview and joining purpose.
10. Private Practice of any kind will not be allowed.
11. Candidates working in Govt./ Private Hospital / Institute should produce NOC from their department at the time of Interview.
12. Applicants having completed 3 years of Senior Residency period in any government hospital, are not eligible for applying under residency scheme.
13. The service of SR will be governed by Residency Scheme and terms & conditions of the agreement.
14. Resignation from service will require 01 month of notice period or pay in lieu thereof in case of SR Scheme (03 Year), Specialist and Super Specialist.
15. Vacancies can change depending upon actual requirement at the time of interview.
16. Hostel accommodation / quarters will not be provided.
17. The Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model Hospital Bapunagar Ahmedabad reserves the right to fill up all post / partial post / not to fill up any post without assigning any reason, whatsoever.

How to Apply

  • The eligible and desirous candidates with duly filled in application form (Annexure-A) should appear for walk-in-interview with their application along with original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopy of the relevant documents in support of age, qualifications, attempt, Mark Sheet, Degree, MCI/State Registration, Category & Experience certificate etc. and two recent passport size photographs.

Eligibility Criteria for Income Tax Gujarat Sports Quota 2025

Educational Qualification (as on 01.01.2026):

For Tax Assistant:

  • Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university or equivalent, AND
  • Data entry speed of 8,000 key depressions per hour
  • Note: Candidates will be required to qualify Data Entry Skill Test @8000 key depressions per hour as per recruitment rules

For Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS):

  • Matriculation or equivalent pass from a recognized Board/Council

Sports Eligibility Criteria (Any One):

Category 1:

  • Sportspersons who have represented State or Country in National or International competition, OR
  • Medal winners in Junior National Championships, OR
  • Medal winners in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years), OR
  • Medal winners in Khelo India Winter Games, OR
  • Medal winners in Khelo India Para Games, OR
  • Medal winners in Khelo India University Games, OR
  • Medal winners in School Games Federation of India (SGFI)

Category 2:

  • Sportspersons who have represented their University in Inter-University Tournaments conducted by Inter-University Sports Boards

Category 3:

  • Sportspersons who have represented State School Teams in National Sports/Games for Schools conducted by All India School Games Federation

Important Note: Candidates must be eligible in all respects (age, educational qualifications, experience) as per Recruitment Rules, except to the extent of relaxations permitted for sports quota.

Age Limit for Income Tax Gujarat Sports Quota 2025 (as on 01.01.2026)

For Tax Assistant:

  • Age Range: 18 to 27 years
  • Born Between: Not before 02.01.1999 and not later than 01.01.2008

For Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS):

  • Age Range: 18 to 25 years
  • Born Between: Not before 02.01.2001 and not later than 01.01.2008

Age Relaxation:

Category Upper Age Limit Relaxation
General/OBC Meritorious Sportspersons Maximum 5 years
SC/ST Meritorious Sportspersons Maximum 10 years
Departmental Candidates (3 years continuous Central Govt. service) Up to 40 years
Departmental Candidates (SC/ST with 3 years service) Up to 45 years

Important: Candidates seeking relaxation must ensure they are entitled to such relaxation as per eligibility prescribed on 01.01.2026.

Order of Preference for Selection (as per DoPT OM dated 04.05.1995 & 04.03.2024)

Sportspersons will be selected based on the following order of preference:

1st Preference:

  • Candidates who have represented the country in International Competition with clearance of Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

2nd Preference:

  • Represented State/UT in Senior or Junior National Championships organized by National Sports Federations (recognized by Dept. of Sports) OR National Games organized by Indian Olympics Association
  • Must have won medals or positions up to 3rd place
  • Between Senior and Junior participants, Senior National Championship medal winners get preference

3rd Preference:

  • Represented University in Inter-University competition conducted by Association of Indian Universities/Inter University Sports Board OR Khelo India University Games
  • Must have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals

4th Preference:

  • Represented State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years) OR Khelo India Winter Games OR Khelo India Para Games
  • Must have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals

5th Preference:

  • Represented State Schools in National sports/games for Schools conducted by All-India School Games Federation
  • Must have won medals or positions up to 3rd place

6th Preference:

  • Represented State/UT/University/State Schools Teams at levels mentioned in categories (2) to (5) but could not win medal/position
  • Same order of preference applies

Tie-Breaking Rules:

  • Candidates who secured higher position given preference
  • Candidates who won more than one medal may be given preference
  • Individual and team events given same preference
  • No preference for winning more than one medal/position

Required Sports Achievement Certificates

Only certificates from the following authorities will be accepted as evidence (as per DoPT OM F. No. 14034/01/2013-Estt(D) dated 03.10.2013):

Competition Authority Issuing Certificate Form
International Secretary of the National Federation of the game concerned Form-1
National Secretary of the National Federation OR Secretary of the State Association of the game concerned Form-2
Inter-University Tournament Dean of Sports or other officer in overall charge of Sports of the University concerned Form-3
National/Sports/Games for School Director/Additional/Joint/Deputy Director in overall charge of Sports/games for schools in the Directorate of Public Instructions/Education of the State Form-4
Khelo India University Games/Youth Games/Winter Games/Para Games Officer designated/Officer in charge from Sports Authority of India (SAI) for respective Khelo India Games Form-5

Important Notes:

  • Sports certificates must be in specified forms (Form 1 to Form 5) as per DoPT OM
  • Certificates must be certified by a Gazetted Officer
  • Forms available at: DoPT Circular
  • Certificates in any other form or from non-competent authorities will be ignored and applications rejected
  • Candidate who cannot upload at least one certificate from competent authority need not apply

Selection Process for Income Tax Gujarat Sports Quota 2025

Stage 1: Scrutiny of Applications

  • All applications received within prescribed time will be scrutinized
  • Scrutiny based on eligibility criteria/qualification/instructions as per advertisement
  • Scrutiny as per eligibility fixed by Sports Recruitment Committee
  • Candidates will be shortlisted as per order of preference (DoPT guidelines)

Stage 2: Written Examination

  • Shortlisted candidates required to appear in written examination
  • Success in written exam does NOT confer right to appointment
  • Appointment subject to Department's satisfaction after necessary enquiry

Stage 3: Data Entry Skill Test (For Tax Assistant only)

  • Candidates must qualify Data Entry Skill Test
  • Requirement: 8,000 key depressions per hour
  • As per relevant recruitment rules

Stage 4: Document Verification

  • Selected candidates required to produce original certificates
  • All documents will be verified

Stage 5: Medical Examination

  • Medical fitness ascertained by O/o Pr. CCIT, Gujarat Region before formal appointment
  • Candidates must be clear in all Doping tests by WADA/NADA or relevant authorities
  • No ongoing investigation regarding doping or unfair means required
  • Declaration to this effect mandatory

Stage 6: Police Verification

  • Appointment subject to clearance from Police authorities
  • Verification of current place of residence

Final Appointment

  • Based on: Eligibility, Order of Preference, Written Exam, Skill Test (for Tax Assistant), Document Verification, Medical Fitness, Police Clearance
  • Probation period: 2 years
  • Posting: Anywhere in Gujarat region

How to Apply for Income Tax Gujarat Sports Quota 2025

Application Process (Online Only):

Step 1: Visit Official Website

  • Go to https://incometaxgujarat.gov.in
  • Click on Sports Quota Recruitment 2025 link
  • Read complete advertisement and instructions carefully
  • Download certificate formats (Form 1 to Form 5) from DoPT OM link provided

Step 2: Fill Online Application Form

  • Click on "Apply Online" link (available from 31.01.2026 to 21.02.2026)
  • Fill all required details:
    • Personal Information (Name, Father's Name, DOB, Gender, Category, Contact details)
    • Educational Qualifications (with percentage and year)
    • Post Applied For: Indicate preference (1st preference: Tax Assistant/MTS, 2nd preference if applying for both)
    • Sports/Game details (Sport name, Level of competition, Achievement, Certificate details)
    • Employment details (if already employed - NOC required)
  • IMPORTANT: Clearly indicate post preference. Failure to indicate post makes application liable for rejection

Step 3: Upload Documents

  • Upload self-attested copies of all required documents (see list below)
  • All documents must be clear and legible
  • File format and size as per instructions on website

Step 4: Pay Application Fee

  • Pay Rs. 200/- through online mode
  • Save payment receipt
  • Upload proof of payment

Step 5: Submit Application

  • Review all details carefully
  • Submit the application
  • Take printout of submitted application for future reference
  • Save Application Number/Registration Number

Documents Required to Upload (Self-attested copies):

  1. Age Proof: Matriculation/SSC or equivalent certificate
  2. Educational Qualification Certificates:
    • For Tax Assistant: Bachelor's Degree certificate and marksheets
    • For MTS: Matriculation or equivalent certificate
  3. Sports/Games Certificates: In prescribed format (Form 1/2/3/4/5) certified by competent authority and attested by Gazetted Officer
  4. Caste/Community Certificate: SC/ST/OBC certificate in prescribed format for appointment under Government of India (if applicable)
  5. EWS Certificate: Income & Asset Certificate (if applicable)
  6. Age Relaxation Certificate: For Departmental Candidates (if claiming relaxation)
  7. Aadhaar Card: Copy of Aadhaar Card
  8. NOC: From present employer (for candidates already employed in Central/State Govt/PSU)
  9. Recent Passport-sized Photograph
  10. Signature
  11. Proof of Fee Payment

Important Application Instructions:

  • Only ONE application should be submitted per candidate
  • If more than one application submitted: ALL applications will be summarily rejected
  • Candidate can apply for more than one post (Tax Assistant & MTS) in SINGLE application
  • Must clearly indicate preference of posts (1st preference, 2nd preference)
  • Application period: 31.01.2026 to 21.02.2026
  • All communications will be via Email ID mentioned in application
  • Ensure Email ID is active and checked regularly
  • Visit https://incometaxgujarat.gov.in regularly for updates

Important Terms & Conditions

Service Conditions for Selected Candidates:

  • Probation: 2 years or as per Government of India instructions
  • Representation Requirement: Must represent Income Tax Department, Gujarat region in tournaments/meets for at least 10 years from joining
  • Undertaking Required: Not to apply for:
    • Deputation to other departments/regions
    • Inter-charge transfer on loan basis
    • Any other inter-charge transfer arrangement
    • Minimum period: 10 years
  • Leave Management: Strictly subject to DOPT O.M No. 6/1/85-Estt.(Pay-I) dated 16.07.1985
  • Posting: Liable for posting anywhere in Gujarat region
  • Declaration Required: To work at any place under Pr. CCIT, Gujarat Region (during pre-appointment process)

Anti-Doping Compliance:

  • Must be clear in all doping tests done by WADA/NADA or relevant authorities
  • No ongoing investigation regarding doping or unfair means
  • Mandatory declaration required

Medical Fitness:

  • Medical examination by O/o Pr. CCIT, Gujarat before appointment
  • Must meet prescribed medical standards

Background Verification:

  • Appointment subject to police clearance
  • Verification from current place of residence

General Warnings:

  • Any form of canvassing renders candidature liable for summary rejection at any stage
  • Furnishing wrong information/false declaration/misrepresentation: Candidature/appointment will be cancelled
  • Failure to comply with instructions/conditions: Application rejected without intimation
  • No travelling allowance for journey to Ahmedabad for joining after selection
  • Pr. CCIT, Gujarat may cancel recruitment process at any stage without assigning reason
  • Decision of Pr. CCIT, Gujarat is final in unforeseen situations not covered by DoPT OMs

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: 10+2 (with 50% marks) or Graduation and ‘O’ Level or One year Computer Course. Or Three years Diploma in any stream/BCA/B.Sc.(Comp/Sc./IT) Or Matric (50% marks) with Two years Diploma in Office Management and Computer Applications. Or Post Matric One Year ITI Course in Stenography/ NCVT in stenography (with 60% marks).

Salary/Stipend

  • 23400/- per month

Important Dates

Online Application Start Date 27.12.2025
Extended Online Application Last Date 03.02.2026
Admit Card Download Date 10.01.2026 onwards

Selection Process

  • The test will be held at IDDC, Ambala only.
  • The candidate after qualifying the test may be further required to undergo screening through an interview/skill test by the indenting deptt. As per specific requirement of the job.

General Information/Instructions

  • Benefit of reservation to the persons of reserved category will be as per Haryana Government instructions contained in letter No. 22/10/2013-1GS-III, dated 15.07.2014 and thereafter issued from time to time upto the date of advertisement shall be applicable.
  • The short listing of candidates shall be done on the basis of particulars and reservation category filled in online application form for which the candidate has the supporting documents as on last date of submission of application. In absence of documentary evidence or mismatch in claimed category, candidature of candidate shall be considered under General category/Parent category, subject to his/her fulfilling eligibility in General category/Parent category.
  • The benefit of reservation will be given only to those SC/BCA/BCB/EWS/PwD and ESM candidates who are bonafide resident of Haryana State and submit the application against reserved category posts and have the documents in support thereof as on last date of submission of application.
  • The SC/BCA/BCB/EWS/ESM/ESP and PwD (Person with Disabilities) candidates are required to submit SC/BCA/BCB/EWS/ESP and PwD (Person with Disabilities) Certificate duly issued by the competent authority (before the last date of submission of application) when called upon to do so by the Corporation.
  • EWS certificate which is as per the conditions laid down by Haryana Government and applicable for jobs in Haryana Government issued on or before cut-off date shall only be considered. EWS certificate issued for jobs in Central Govt. will not be considered irrespective of income mentioned in certificate.
  • Qualifications and other term and conditions of eligibility will be determined with regard to the last date fixed for receipt of online applications also termed as closing date.
  • If on verification at any stage, it is found that any candidate does not fulfill any of the eligibility condition or it is found that the information furnished is false or incorrect, his/her candidature will be cancelled and he/she will also be liable to be criminally prosecuted. This is irrespective of whether the candidate was benefitted in his/her application from that particular eligibility condition or not.
  • No Individual information at any stage shall be sent and hence all candidates should regularly visit the Hartron’s Website & Public Notices in different Newspapers.
  • Benefit of reservation to Ex-Serviceman & their family members will be as per Government Instructions bearing No. 12/15/2019-4GS-II dated 09.03.2022 and 13.04.2022 or as amended from time to time upto the date of advertisement.
  • An ex-serviceman who himself/herself or his/her family member has already secured employment in civil service on regular basis in any Department/Board/Corporation/University etc. under the State Government with availing the benefit of reservation – i. he/she himself/herself shall not be entitled to avail the benefit of reservation in civil service for any subsequent appointment in any Department/Board/Corporation/University etc. under the State Government. However, the benefit of age relaxation for securing another employment in a higher pay scale or post shall remain continue and ii. his/her family member shall also not be entitled to avail the benefit of reservation against the posts reserved for ex-servicemen.
  • An ex-serviceman who himself/herself has already secured employment in civil service on regular basis in any Department/Board/Corporation/University etc. under the State Government without availing the benefit of reservation in such case he/she himself/herself or one of his/her family members (son, daughter or spouse) will be entitled to avail the benefit of reservation: i. where an ex-serviceman who himself/herself is eligible to avail the benefit of reservation under these instructions but he/she does not want re-employment in civil service in such case one of his/her family members (son, daughter or spouse) will be entitled to avail the benefit of reservation.
  • If an ex-serviceman applies for various vacancies before joining any civil employment, he/she can avail the benefit of reservation as ex-serviceman for any one of the subsequent employments. However, to avail of this benefit, an ex-serviceman as soon as he/she joins any civil employment should give self-declaration/undertaking to the concerned employer about the date-wise details of applications for various vacancies for which he/she had applied for before joining the initial civil employment. Further, this benefit would be admissible only in respect of vacancies which are filled by direct recruitment and wherever reservation is applicable to the ex-servicemen.
  • The family members of martyr military personnel shall be entitled to exercise an option either – i. to avail the benefit of reservation up to two family members; or ii. to avail the benefit of compassionate appointment to one of the family members under the Ex-gratia Policy namely Compassionate Appointment to family member of Martyr Armed Forces Personnel Policy notified by Government from time to time.
  • The priority list for recruiting agency for preparation of final list of selection/appointment of ex-servicemen or their family members against the posts reserved for ex-servicemen shall be as under:- i. disabled ex-servicemen, the post(s) for which they are physically fit; ii. failing (i), family member of disabled ex-servicemen; iii. failing (ii), other ex-servicemen who are eligible to get the benefit of reservation under these instructions; iv. failing (iii), family member of other ex-servicemen who are eligible to get the benefit of reservation under these instructions.
  • Disabled ex-serviceman means a person who has been released from military service due to disability attributable or aggravated due to military service. An exserviceman shall not be treated disabled one who has been released from military service not on account of his/her disability but has been released in the normal course after the completion of his/her term or retired from military service voluntarily.
  • Both the reservations are horizontal, therefore, a disabled ex-serviceman who is selected against the post reserved for ex-serviceman will not be counted against the post reserved for PwD.
  • In all circumstances the benefit of reservation against the posts reserved for Exservicemen shall be admissible at the time of final selection list only and not at the time of preliminary test, main test or interview.
  • An ex-serviceman who have been discharged from military service by way of dismissal, misconduct or inefficiency neither he/she himself/herself nor his/her family members shall be entitled to avail the benefit of reservation in civil service.
  • As per Instruction No.12/15/2019-4GS-II dated 13 April 2022 of Haryana Government Human Resource Department (General Services-II Branch), if an Ex-servicemen applies for various vacancies before joining any civil employment, he/she can avail the benefit of reservation as ex-serviceman for any one of the subsequent employments. However, to avail of this benefit, an ex-serviceman as soon as he/she joins any civil employment should give self-declaration/undertaking to the concerned employer about the date-wise details of applications for various vacancies for which he/she had applied for before joining the initial civil employment. Further, this benefit would be admissible only in respect of vacancies which are filled by direct recruitment and wherever reservation is applicable to the ex-servicemen. In the above said instructions the benefit of reservation has been allowed either to the Ex-serviceman himself/herself or one of his family members (son/daughter/spouse) therefore the provision of selection of any one post out of the posts for which application(s) was/were submitted before joining service shall also be applicable to the family members where they are eligible to avail the benefit of reservation under the above said instructions. In other words, above shall also be applicable to the family members of Ex-servicemen also.
  • Family member of ESM candidates of Haryana claiming benefit must have valid eligibility certificate on last date of submission of online application and shall produce the valid Eligibility Certificate from the concerned Zila Sainik Board at the time of test. ESM candidates should also produce attested photo copy of Identity Card issued by concerned Zila Sainik Board & Discharge certificate/Book. Disabled ESM shall produce disability certificate and family member of Martyr produce relevant certificate/Battle Casualty certificate which proves the Martyr status.
  • Benefit of reservation to the children/grandchildren of Freedom Fighters will be as per Government Instruction No. 22/49/2021-1GS-III dated 27.10.21 and 26.04.2022. Children/Grand Children of Freedom Fighter shall be required to have the Certificate duly issued by the respective competent authority.
  • Hartron can direct the ESM candidates to provide suitable information along with the affidavit to avail the benefits.
  • If for any post, reserved category of post is not advertised then the candidate of reserved category can apply for general category post and he/she will be shortlisted in General category only on the basis of merit.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates can apply online from 27.12.2025 to 03.02.2026 on Hartron's website.
  • Candidates may download the e-admit card from the website from 10.01.2026 onwards. No communication will be sent to individuals separately.

VC No. Post Name Total

Eligibility Criteria

Team Leader (Safety) - CP/01/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise buildings/KWA projects/Irrigation/shore protection/Harbour projects with experience of managing and working in the field of health and safety
  • Essential: Candidates should hold OSHA or NEBOSH certification

Team Leader (Civil) - CP/02/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise buildings/KWA Projects with experience in handling engineering aspects including interface coordination

Team Leader (MEP) - CP/03/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise building projects/KWA projects with experience in handling engineering and overall coordination
  • Essential: Should have a good knowledge in Electrical/HVAC/Fire fighting ELV & Plumbing system including interface coordination

Team Leader (QC) - CP/04/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise building projects/KWA projects with experience in the field of quality control
  • Essential: Shall possess experience in quality assurance/control, auditing design projects, developing QMS, and inspection/testing/product conformity. The concerned should be a Certified Quality Auditor (CQA)

Project Engineer (Civil) - CP/05/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience in Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour, etc.

Project Engineer (MEP) - CP/06/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience in Electrical/HVAC/Fire fighting ELV & Plumbing system including interface coordination

Junior Engineer (Civil) - CL/01/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering OR Full Time Diploma in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience for diploma holders and 05 years for degree holders, with specific experience in relevant project category (Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour)

Junior Engineer (MEP) - CL/02/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full Time Diploma in Engineering in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience for diploma holders and 05 years for degree holders, in electrical Engineering with specific experience in relevant project category (Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour Electrical/HVAC/Fire Fighting, ELV & Plumbing systems)

Important Notes on Qualification

  • The period of training/internship/teaching/academic/fellowship/PhD research experience shall not be counted towards post qualification experience
  • The candidate should possess Degree recognized by AICTE; from a University incorporated by an Act of Central or State legislature in India or other Educational Institutions established by an Act of Parliament or declared to be Deemed as University under Section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956
  • Sections A & B examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India), with enrolment on or before 31.05.2013, which is treated as equivalent to Degree by the Government of India and recognized by AICTE shall be accepted
  • Experience shall be calculated as on 26.02.2026

Salary/Stipend

For Team Leaders (CP/01/26 to CP/04/26)

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 70,000 - Rs. 2,00,000
  • Approximate CTC: Rs. 19.85 Lakhs Per Annum
  • Components: Basic pay and DA, fixed/variable allowances 23% of Basic Pay, HRA/Lease, Contribution to PF, Gratuity as per Payment of Gratuity Act

For Project Engineers (CP/05/26 to CP/06/26)

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 50,000 – Rs. 1,60,000
  • Approximate CTC: Rs. 14.22 Lakhs Per Annum
  • Components: Basic pay and DA, fixed/variable allowances 23% of Basic Pay, HRA/Lease, Contribution to PF, Gratuity as per Payment of Gratuity Act

For Junior Engineers - Degree Holders (CL/01/26 & CL/02/26)

  • For 5 years minimum experience:
    • Monthly Basic Pay: Rs. 25,504
    • Gross Monthly Pay: Rs. 46,417
    • Yearly CTC: Rs. 5,57,008

For Junior Engineers - Diploma Holders (CL/01/26 & CL/02/26)

  • For 7 years minimum experience:
    • Monthly Basic Pay: Rs. 18,940
    • Gross Monthly Pay: Rs. 34,471
    • Yearly CTC: Rs. 4,13,651

Other Benefits (As per company rules applicable to contract employees)

  • Leaves
  • Maternity Leave
  • Medical facility
  • Accident/Death Insurance
  • Leave Encashment

Note: Remuneration mentioned above is only indicative. Actual remuneration shall depend upon place of posting and other terms & conditions of appointment.

Age Limit (as on 26.02.2026)

  • Maximum Age Limit: 55 years as on the last date of application i.e. 26.02.2026
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC-NCL: 3 years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: 10 years; in addition to the age relaxation permissible for SC/ST/OBC-NCL category candidates, subject to the post being identified suitable for PWD
  • Note: Relaxation in upper age limit shall be applicable for PwBD candidates irrespective of the fact whether the post is reserved or not, provided the post is identified suitable for PwBDs
  • PWD candidates suffering from not less than 40% of the relevant disability shall only be eligible for the benefit of PWD

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
General/OBC Candidates NIL
EWS/SC/ST/PWD Candidates NIL

No application fee is required for any category.

Important Dates

Event Date
Commencement of submission of online application 22.01.2026
Last date of submission of online application 26.02.2026
Walk-in Interview for CP/01/26 to CP/06/26 23.02.2026 & 24.02.2026
Walk-in Interview for CL/01/26 & CL/02/26 25.02.2026 to 27.02.2026
Reporting Time for Walk-in Interview 09:30 AM to 12:30 PM

Selection Process

  • All candidates who successfully submitted their online application form shall be provisionally allowed to appear for Document Scrutiny/verification process
  • The eligibility of the candidates with respect to the post applied will be verified during document scrutiny
  • Thereafter, the shortlisted/eligible candidates shall be allowed to appear for Interview
  • RITES Ltd. reserves the right to shortlist the number of candidates for selection out of eligible candidates
  • Weightage Distribution: Interview - 100%
    • Technical & Professional proficiency - 65%
    • Personality, Communication & Competency - 35%
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • 60% marks for UR/EWS in interview
    • 50% marks for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PWD against reserved posts in interview
  • There will be no minimum qualifying marks required in the aggregate
  • Interviews will be conducted on first come first served basis
  • Candidates can appear for Walk-in Interview at any one of the mentioned venues
  • Candidates have the option to appear for interview either in Hindi or English
  • Based on the requirement and discretion of RITES, the selection process may be conducted from RITES' Regional Offices

General Information/Instructions

  • The appointment shall be purely on contract basis initially for a period of one year, extendable until completion of the assignment subject to mutual consent and satisfactory performance
  • Selected candidates shall be liable for posting anywhere in India as per Company requirements
  • Instant recruitment is being done for deployment of personnel at client's site in the state of Kerala
  • Issuance of offer letter of engagement to the selected candidates shall be subject to approval of CV by the client
  • Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to their being found medically fit in the Medical Examination to be conducted as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness for the relevant post
  • Reservation/relaxation/concessions to EWS/SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PWD/Ex-SM/J&K Domicile would be provided against reserved posts (where applicable) as per extant Govt. orders
  • Before applying, candidates should ensure that they satisfy the necessary conditions and requirements of the position
  • Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC) should be in the format prescribed by Government of India only
  • OBC candidates included in the Central List with certificate not more than 12 months old (with clear mention of candidate not belonging to "Creamy Layer") in the GOI prescribed format only will be considered
  • EWS certificate should also be as per Gov. of India format and must be for 2024-25 i.e. issued on or after 01.04.2024
  • Departmental candidates of RITES and candidates working in Government Departments/PSU shall be allowed to join RITES only after being properly relieved from their parent organization
  • If it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/her candidature is liable for cancellation
  • Management reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify/alter the selection/recruitment process at any stage, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereafter
  • The number of vacancies may vary
  • No train/bus fare/TA/DA shall be payable
  • Legal jurisdiction will be Delhi in case of any dispute
  • Any corrigendum/addendum to this advertisement will be displayed only on the Company's website www.rites.com

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria are required to apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website, http://www.rites.com
  • While submitting the online application, the system would generate 'Registration No.' on top of online form. Note down this "Registration No." and quote it for all further communication with RITES Ltd.
  • While filling up the required details, candidates are advised to carefully and correctly fill the details of "Identity Proof"
  • After filling up the required details under the "Fill/Modify Application Form", candidate should submit the application
  • Keep a copy of Application Form submitted and carry the same at the time of the selection
  • A copy of online APPLICATION FORM containing the registration number is to be printed, signed, and retained
  • The same is to be submitted at the time of Scrutiny of Documents/Interview along with SELF-ATTESTED PHOTO COPIES of the following documents strictly in the following order:
    • 1 recent passport size colour photograph
    • A copy of updated CV/Resume
    • High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth
    • Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications and statements of marks of all the qualifications for all semesters/years
    • EWS/SC/ST/OBC Certificate in the prescribed format by Govt. of India (if applicable)
    • Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving license, Aadhaar Card etc)
    • PAN Card
    • Proof of different periods of experience as claimed in the Application Form
    • Any other document in support of your candidature
    • PWD Certificate as per latest format (if applicable)
  • No documents are to be submitted while submitting online application
  • Hard copies of documents are not to be sent to this office through post/courier
  • The original testimonials/documents along with one self-attested copy will have to be produced at the time of selection
  • Candidates should submit only one application for one vacancy and application once submitted cannot be altered
  • A valid e-mail ID is essential for submission of the online application
  • Candidate has to bring duly filled two copies of Annexure A, documents in chronological order and submit at the time of Document verification/Selection process
  • Queries should be sent to [email protected] with VC No., Registration/Roll No., Name of Candidate, and valid email address

Walk-in Interview Venues

  • Venue 1: RITES Ltd., Shikhar, Plot No. 1, Sector – 29, Near IFFCO Chowk Metro Station, Gurugram – 122001, Haryana
  • Venue 2: RITES LTD, Ground floor, Calsar Heather Punnen Road, Opposite Hilton Hotel, Statue, Thiruvananthapuram- 695001, Kerala
  • Reporting Time: Between 09:30 AM to 12:30 PM

Eligibility Criteria 

1. ICTC Counselor - Educational Qualification and Experience

  • Essential Qualification:
    • Graduate degree holder in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Human development/Nursing with 3 years of experience in counselling/educating under National Health programme
    • OR
    • Post-graduate in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Human development/Nursing
  • For PLHIV candidates: Graduate degree holder in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Human development/Nursing with 1 years of experience in counseling/educating under National Health Programmes

2. FIART Counselor - Educational Qualification and Experience

  • Essential Qualification: Graduate degree holder in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Human development/Nursing with 1 years of experience in counseling/educating under National Health Programmes
  • Desirable: Experience of working under National AIDS and STD Control Programme(NACP) facility or community settings
  • Knowledge and Skill:
    • Computer literate with working knowledge of MS Office, usage of internet and electronic mail
    • Familiarity with government health policies and related programmes
    • Ability to work in teams, and flexible ways of working as per the need of programme

3. ICTC Lab Technician - Educational Qualification and Experience

  • Essential Qualification: B.SC in Medical Laboratory Technology(BMLT) or BMLS, Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology(DMLT) or DMLS with the course duration of at least 2 years recognised by State Government/Central Government
  • Essential Experience:
    • Two years of experience of working in diagnostic laboratory for those with B.Sc/Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (course duration of 2 years)
    • One year experience for those working in diagnostic laboratory for candidates having M.Sc in Medical Laboratory Technology
    • Candidates with experience of working in accredited labs or those labs who have applied for accreditation will be preferred
  • Desirable: M.Sc In Medical Laboratory Technology/MMLS

Selection Process

Candidates will be selected based on the following criteria:

  • Essential basic qualifications: 30 marks (30x Percentage/100)
  • Post qualification relevant work experience in same field: 10 marks (02 marks for each completed year, maximum 10 marks)
    • In State Govt./Semi Govt./UT/any Govt. Board/Corporation/NHM /SACS shall be considered
    • OR
    • In private hospitals/Labs, which are JSI/NABH/NABL accredited /ISO certified and any other nationally accredited Health Institution only will be considered/admissible at par with Govt. Facilities
  • Local area Weightage: 10 marks
    • For Haryana applicants: 10 marks for the candidate be a bonafide resident of Haryana (Haryana resident certificate/Domicile)
    • For out of the State applicants: Zero (0) marks
  • Total Marks: 50
  • Document Verification: Candidates must produce all original testimonials at the time of document verification

How to Apply 

Eligible candidates can apply offline for HSACS Bhiwani ICTC Counselor, FIART Counselor, ICTC Lab Technician 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: www.nhmharyana.gov.in
  2. Download the application form from the website
  3. Fill the application form in your own handwriting in capital letters with self-attested one set of all the testimonials
  4. Attach all required documents (Educational certificates, Experience certificates, Caste certificate, Address proof, etc.)
  5. Submit the application form in person only in offline mode by 10.02.2026 till 04.00PM in room no. 224 O/o Civil Surgeon, Bhiwani
  6. Applicants must have to produce all original testimonials before the document verification committee at the time of document verification
  7. If any candidate fails to produce their original documents at the time of Document Verification, their candidature will be cancelled immediately and no any other chance will be provided to candidate for Document Verification

Instructions

  • Interested candidates are advised to visit website www.nhmharyana.gov.in for details of post, eligibility and selection criteria, important instructions (corrigendum/result etc) and the application form
  • No individual correspondence (By Phone Call, message, email, letter etc) will be made by District Authorities
  • Applicant should have passed Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric
  • Applicant must be permanent resident of Haryana (Bonafide domicile certificate from Executive Magistrate should be furnished)
  • Age as per Haryana Govt. Policy
  • These posts are district specific and non transferable
  • Reservation Policy as per Haryana Govt. Reservation Policy and Advertisement is as per backlog of reservation in District Bhiwani
  • Candidates should submit latest Caste/Category certificate as per Haryana Government Reservation Policy
  • NHM Bye-laws are not applicable to this post
  • The applications received through post/courier/mail or by any other mode will not be entertained
  • Selected candidate shall disclose to this Haryana State AIDS Control Society any business or professional employment or activity in which he may be engaged prior to or at any time in the course of present agreement. These activities shall not be incompatible with the performance of the services
  • Waiting list of three candidates per post will be kept so that post need not to be re-advertised again & again and posts may not remain vacant. This waiting list will be valid for one year
  • UDID card is compulsory to claim the benefit of Person with Disability(Pwd) reservation. No reservation benefit will be granted in absence of UDID card
  • Experience Certificate should be supported with proper dispatch number, stamp and sign of issuing authority with salary mentioned in experience certificate. Candidate to produce last month Salary slip (if salary is not mentioned in Experience Certificate) with Relevant Post qualification Experience and terms and conditions. Post qualification relevant work experience in same field in any State Govt./Semi Govt./UT/any Govt. Board/Corporation/NHM /SACS shall be considered
  • Post Qualification relevant work experience in same field in private hospitals/Labs, which are JSI/NABH/NABL accredited /ISO certified and any other nationally accredited Health Institution only will be considered/admissible at par with Govt. Facilities

  • The work and conduct will be assessed and in case of unsatisfactory performance the contract shall be terminated by the appointing authority without any notice
  • Applications are invited to fill up the post under National AIDS Control Programme purely on contractual basis on behalf of Haryana State AIDS Control Society District Bhiwani initially up to 31/03/2026 which may be renewed on year to year basis on assessment of performance

Selection Process for HPSC HCS & Allied Services Recruitment 2026

  • Paper-II is qualifying with minimum 33% marks required

Stage 2: Main Written Examination

Paper Subject Marks Duration

  • Natural, directed, and purposive conversation (not strict cross-examination)

Final Merit & Selection

  • Total Marks: 675 (Main Written: 600 + Viva-voce: 75)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification for Clerk: No candidate for direct recruitment shall be eligible to apply for the post of Clerk unless he holds a degree of Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science or equivalent thereto from a recognized university and has passed matriculation examination with Hindi as one of the subject.
  • Qualification for Stenographer Grade-III: Candidates, who possess a degree of Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science or equivalent thereto from a recognized university and pass a test at a speed of 80 w.p.m. in English Shorthand and 20 w.p.m. in Transcription of the same and have proficiency in computers (Word Processing and Spread Sheets).

Salary/ Stipend

  • Consolidated pay Rs. 25,500/- per month i.e. minimum pay scale of the posts, for a period of six months or till regular appointments are made by the Hon'ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana, Chandigarh, whichever is earlier.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • No person shall be recruited to the service if he/she is less than 18 years or is more than 42 years of age as on 01.01.2026, provided that relaxation in upper age limit is admissible to the reserved categories as per instructions of the Hon'ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh and/or Haryana Government issued from time to time.

Important Dates

Last Date for Receipt of Applications 18 February 2026

Selection Process

  • For Clerk: Candidates shall have to take a written examination in English Composition (50 marks, 33% qualifying) and General Knowledge (50 marks, 33% qualifying). No candidate shall be considered for appointment unless he/she obtains 40% marks in aggregate in the written examination and having proficiency in operation of computers (Word and spread sheet). The candidates have to qualify Computer Typing Test at the speed of 30 w.p.m.
  • For Stenographer Grade-III: Pass a test at a speed of 80 w.p.m. in English Shorthand and 20 w.p.m. in Transcription of the same and have proficiency in computers (Word Processing and Spread Sheets). However, Computer Proficiency Test would only be qualifying in nature and its marks would not be counted towards the final merit.
  • The selection for the aforesaid posts shall be made strictly in accordance with amended Rule 7 of the Haryana Subordinate Courts Establishment (Recruitment and General Conditions of Service) Rules, 1997 and as per explanation to Rule 7 (iii) of the Haryana Subordinate Courts Establishment (Recruitment and General Conditions of Services), Rules 1997 Volume-I, Chapter 18-B, "Where no candidate of reserved category is available then appointment be made from general category".

General Information/ Instructions

  • The total number of vacancies may decrease due to withdrawal of courts, adjustment of surplus staff or otherwise, during the selection process and no intimation in this regard will be issued separately.
  • Candidates are advised to visit the website regularly after 18.02.2026, for updates related to further process of recruitment.
  • If the candidate submits one application for both the posts, the same will be deemed to be rejected. The candidate shall submit separate application for each post.
  • One latest passport size colored photograph must be affixed on the application form in the given space and self attested photocopies of the educational documents and certificates regarding category, experience etc. must be attached with the application form.
  • The candidates are required to bring their proof of identity at the time of written test/skill test, failing which, he/she will not be allowed for test.
  • The applicants should disclose all their educational qualifications and other declaration/certificate in the application form. Non-disclosure thereof may disqualify the concerned candidate for appointment and may also render him/her liable for prosecution under relevant provisions of law.
  • Incomplete applications or applications received without requisite documents shall be rejected straightway without assigning any reason whatsoever. No correspondence, whatsoever shall be entertained in respect of incomplete applications or those which are refused by this office for receipt after expiry of the last date i.e. 18.02.2026.
  • Unsigned applications will be deemed to be rejected. The applications for the candidates, who are underage and overage will also be deemed to be rejected. Category mentioned in the application by a candidate once made will not be allowed to be changed. However, rejection list would be uploaded on the website of this office.
  • The decision of the Selection Committee in all matters relating to acceptance or rejection of an application, eligibility/suitability of the applicants, mode/criteria for selection etc. shall be final and binding on the applicants.
  • No TA/DA is admissible to any candidate appearing in the test(s) for the posts mentioned above.
  • No separate call letters for the written test/interview shall be issued.
  • The schedule of written test/interview shall be uploaded in due course on the official website i.e. https://rohtak.dcourts.gov.in.

How to Apply

  • Application Forms can be downloaded from the website of District Courts Rohtak i.e. https://rohtak.dcourts.gov.in/notice-category/recruitments/.
  • The last date for receipt of the applications for both the posts either by post or by hand in the office of the undersigned i.e. The District and Sessions Judge, Sessions Court, Rohtak is 18.02.2026 upto 05:00 pm.
  • Delay on the part of the postal or other authorities shall be no ground for entertaining the applications received after due date.
  • Applications received after due date shall not be entertained in any manner and shall be refused straightway, without any further correspondence.
  • Similarly, applications, if any, received before the date of issuance of public notice shall not be entertained, in any manner.
  • Applications received through email shall not be entertained in any manner.

  • Before applying, the candidate should read carefully all the terms and conditions of the advertisement including essential qualifications, age limit, nature of experience required and other conditions.

  • The prescribed essential qualifications are the minimum and mere possession of the same does not entitle candidates to be called for interview/viva-voce, and candidates are advised to mention all their qualifications in the application form over and above the basic qualifications required.
  • Only documents/certificates submitted/uploaded along with the application form will be taken into consideration; any document issued or submitted after the closing date will not be considered at any stage of the selection process.
  • The candidate should read all instructions before filling in the online application form, check all particulars carefully, sign and upload the application form along with all relevant documents; incomplete or defective applications will be summarily rejected.
  • The use of mobile phones, pagers, electronic equipment, programmable devices, storage media like pen drive, smart watches, camera, Bluetooth devices or any such equipment capable of being used as a communication device during the examination is strictly prohibited and may entail disciplinary action including ban from future examinations.
  • Candidates must ensure that information provided by them is true; if at any stage any information or claim is found false, their candidature will be liable to be rejected and they may be debarred by the Commission.
  • The decision of the Commission in all matters relating to acceptance or rejection of an application, eligibility/suitability of the candidates, mode and criteria for selection etc. will be final and binding on the candidates, and no inquiry or correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • No request for withdrawal of candidature received from a candidate after submission of application will be entertained under any circumstances.

How to Apply

  • Candidates will have to compulsorily register online by visiting http://hpsc.gov.in for submitting their online application form. Detailed instructions for filling up online applications are available on the website, and no other means/mode of submission of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates can register online by using their Mobile Number and Aadhar Number; in case the data in Aadhar card is not updated, the candidate should apply through Mobile Number.
  • After registration, a login ID will be created, and candidates can apply against the advertisement as per their qualifications by using their login ID.
  • After filling up the application form, candidates must submit the same by making payment of the requisite fee and then take a printout of the application form and upload the same after duly checking and signing it.
  • If a candidate does not upload a signed copy of the downloaded application form, his/her application will be considered incomplete and candidature will be automatically rejected.
  • The candidate should carefully enter all particulars and details in the online application form, as after submission no change in any particular/detail will be allowed.
  • After successful submission of application, candidates should again take print out of the signed application form which has been uploaded and bring the hard copy along with all uploaded documents when called upon by the Commission.
  • Candidates are advised to submit only a single application; if multiple applications are submitted, only the application with highest/latest application number complete in all respects will be entertained, and fee paid against one application number will not be adjusted against any other application number.

Persons employed in Government/Semi Government Organizations/Autonomous Bodies/ PSU etc. should process their application through proper channel and submit No Objection Certificate (NOC) with vigilance clearance.   10. The online applications received in response to this advertisement shall be scrutinized as per the eligibility criteria detailed in the advertisement. Merely fulfilling the eligibility criteria does not entitle an applicants to be called for selection process. In case the number of applications received is large, Institute reserves to formulate additional criteria for shortlisting, based on academic performance and/ or levels/area/years of experience of the applicants or any other criteria as deemed fit. Only shortlisted applicants will be called for selection process. The decision of the Institute in this regard shall be final.

  12. Relaxation up to a maximum of 57 years of age shall be given for applicants working in the Institute on a non-regular/contract basis, provided they have served the Institute for at least 05 years.

Selection Process for GSSC Primary School Teacher 2026

The selection process consists of THREE stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test - I (CBT-I) - Screening/Shortlisting

For Marathi Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks

Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language 10
Test of Marathi Language 10
TOTAL 60 Marks

For Konkani Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 20
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language 20
TOTAL 60 Marks

Duration: 75 minutes (100 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time)

Minimum Passing Marks (CBT-I):

  • Unreserved (UR) candidates: 45%
  • OBC/PwD candidates: 40%
  • SC/ST candidates: 35%

Konkani Language Test (Mandatory):

  • Marathi Medium: Minimum 4 marks out of 10 required in Konkani test (mandatory for merit consideration)
  • Konkani Medium: Minimum 8 marks out of 20 required in Konkani test (mandatory for merit consideration)
  • Konkani language questions will appear in the first 10/20 questions
  • Only candidates securing minimum qualifying marks in Konkani will be evaluated for merit list

Shortlisting for CBT-II: 3.5 times the number of posts in each category/sub-category based on CBT-I merit

Stage 2: Computer Based Test - II (CBT-II)

For Marathi Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 10
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Marathi Language (including basic grammar) 40
Test of Methodology/Education Pedagogy 10
TOTAL 80 Marks

Duration: 100 minutes (135 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time of 35 minutes)

For Konkani Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 10
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language (including basic grammar) 40
Test of Methodology/Education Pedagogy 10
TOTAL 80 Marks

Duration: 100 minutes (135 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time of 35 minutes)

Shortlisting for Class Demonstration: Twice the number of candidates in each category/sub-category based on CBT-II merit

Stage 3: Class Demonstration - 10 Marks

  • Candidates will be asked to demonstrate on a particular concept of the post for which they have been shortlisted
  • Shortlisted based on CBT-II performance
  • Carries 10 marks

Final Merit & Selection

  • Combined Score: CBT-II marks + Class Demonstration marks
  • Common merit list prepared in descending order of Combined Score
  • Selection process as per Government of Goa O.M. No.1/6/83-PER(Vol.II)Pt.(a)/143 dated 14.01.2019
  • In case of tie (equal marks): Candidate born earlier gets precedence
  • Wait list will also be prepared for each post in descending order of merit

Selection Process (Category-wise):

  1. First: PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Meritorious Sportspersons candidates shortlisted on merit and adjusted against their vertical category (UR/ST/SC/OBC/EWS)
  2. Second: Unreserved (UR) category candidates shortlisted in descending order
  3. Third: Reserved category candidates (who didn't avail age relaxation/concessions except fee) adjusted against UR if eligible on merit
  4. Fourth: Reserved category candidates (OBC/SC/ST/EWS) shortlisted separately in descending order

Important Selection Notes:

  • No Negative Marking in CBT examinations
  • CBT-I is only for screening/shortlisting (marks not counted for final merit)
  • Question type: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
  • Compensatory time for PwD: 25 minutes for CBT-I (60 marks), 35 minutes for CBT-II (80 marks)
  • If PwD/Meritorious Sportspersons not available in their reserved category, vacancies deducted from unreserved
  • If Ex-Servicemen not available, vacancies filled by meritorious candidates
  • If reserved category candidates not available, vacancies remain unfilled
