Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

For ST Category Posts:

  • Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial): Bachelors of Business Administration (BBA) OR Graduate in any discipline with Diploma in Commercial/Supply Chain Management/Materials management/Logistics management/other relevant qualification equivalent to 01-year Diploma in Material Management from a recognized University/Institute.
  • Structural Fitter: ITI & NCTVT (National Apprenticeship Certificate) in Structural Fitter/Fitter/Fitter General/Sheet Metal Worker trade.
  • Welder: ITI in the trade of Welder.
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Minimum 03 years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Shipwright Fitter: SSC with Training Certificate from Deck/Engine department.

For OBC Category Posts:

  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Graduate having passed Intermediate examination from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India OR MBA Finance.
  • Junior Supervisor (Mechanical - Safety): Minimum 03 years' full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering and one-year full time Diploma in Industrial Safety awarded by Board of Technical Education of any State Government/Union territory or CLI, RLI (Ministry of Labour).

Essential Qualifications

  • For Technical Assistant (Mechanical) and Junior Supervisor (Mechanical-safety), diploma in Mechanical engineering is essential requirement. Candidates who have done B.E./B.Tech and do not possess Diploma will not be considered.
  • All qualifications must be from recognized Universities/Institutes/Boards as per UGC/AICTE/Government norms.

Desirable

  • Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial): 2 years Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Commercial/Supply Chain Management from a recognized University/Institute. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Structural Fitter: Preference will be given to those candidates who have undergone National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in Shipbuilding Industry or have relevant work experience in Public Sector/Private Shipyards/Naval Workshops. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Welder: Preference will be given to those candidates who have undergone National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in Shipbuilding Industry or have relevant work experience in Public Sector/Private Shipyards/Naval Workshops. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Ability to work on Auto CAD. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Shipwright Fitter: Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Finance recognized by Govt of India. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Junior Supervisor (Safety - Mechanical): Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.

Experience

  • Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial): Minimum 2 Years Post qualification relevant work experience.
  • Structural Fitter: Minimum 02 years' experience in the line.
  • Welder: Minimum 02 years' experience in the line.
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Minimum 02 years of experience in the line.
  • Shipwright Fitter: Minimum 02 years' experience in the line/trade from Shipbuilding Industry.
  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Minimum 2 years post qualification relevant work experience in Finance function.
  • Junior Supervisor (Safety - Mechanical): Minimum 2 years post qualification relevant work experience.

Salary/Stipend

  • Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial): Pay scale of Rs.21,000-3%-70,000 (S-1 Grade)
  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Pay scale of Rs.21,000-3%-70,000 (S-1 Grade)
  • Junior Supervisor (Mechanical - Safety): Pay scale of Rs.21,000-3%-70,000 (S-1 Grade)
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Pay scale of Rs.16,600-3%-63,500 (W-8 Grade)
  • Structural Fitter: Pay scale of Rs.15,100-3%-53,000 (W-5 Grade)
  • Welder: Pay scale of Rs.15,100-3%-53,000 (W-5 Grade)
  • Shipwright Fitter: Pay scale of Rs.15,100-3%-53,000 (W-5 Grade)
  • All positions are on regular basis with benefits as per company rules.

Age Limit

  • For ST Category Posts: Maximum upper age limit is 38 years as on 30.11.2025 (Including Age Relaxation)
  • For OBC Category Posts: Maximum upper age limit is 36 years as on 30.11.2025 (Including Age Relaxation)
  • Relaxation in age will be granted to Ex-Servicemen/Agniveer and PwBD candidates as per existing Government guidelines and as amended from time to time.
  • Internal candidates will get age relaxation as per GSL rules.
  • As on cut-off date, the maximum age after all age relaxations should not be more than 56 years.
  • For the candidates who has completed advance training from GSL, the period of training will be considered as experience for the relevant posts and weightage will be awarded as per the Advance Training Scheme.

Application Fee

  • General/OBC Candidates: Rs.200/- (Non-Refundable) to be paid online through SBI e-pay (by Debit card/Credit card/Net Banking, etc.)
  • ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen Candidates: Exempted from payment of application fee, as per Government of India rules
  • Internal Candidates: No fee is required to be paid by internal candidates who apply for the said posts
  • Application without prescribed fees shall be liable for rejection.
  • Application fee is non-refundable; therefore, candidates are requested to verify their eligibility thoroughly before making any payment.
  • The candidature of applicants submitting fee of lesser amount or depositing fee through any other mode other than the prescribed method, will be rejected.
  • After submitting payment information in the online application form, please wait for the intimation from the server. Do not press back or refresh button in order to avoid double charges.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, "Fee receipt" would be generated. Candidates have to download and take print of fee receipt.
  • Non-generation of 'Fee Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. In case of failure of payment, candidates are advised to login again and repeat the process payment.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Advertisement Date 30/12/2025
Online Application Opens 05/01/2026 (00:00 hrs)
Online Application Closes 04/02/2026 (17:00 hrs)
Upper Age Limit & Experience Considered As On 30/11/2025

Selection Process

  • The selection process shall consist of Written test, Document Verification and Skill/Trade test.
  • The written test may be conducted through Computer based Test (CBT) or Pen Paper based Test (PBT) internally/externally.
  • Written Test will normally consist of 25% General Aptitude and 75% subject/trade related questions.
  • Outstation candidates who clear the written test and qualify for the Skill/Trade Test after Document verification only will be paid to and fro sleeper class rail fare by shortest route from their nearest railway station to Goa Shipyard Limited only on production of proof of journey (Hard copy of Tickets) as per rules of the Company.
  • ST candidates on being eligible and appearing for written test will be reimbursed to and fro sleeper class rail fare by shortest route from their nearest railway station to GSL/exam venue only on production of proof of journey (Hard copy of Tickets) as per rules of the Company.
  • Payment of TA shall be made through ECS mode after completion of the selection process only.
  • Candidates having "Wait Listed" tickets for Rail journey are NOT entitled for TA Reimbursement.
  • Merely calling of the candidates for the written test/skill test does not confer any right that the candidate fulfils the eligibility criteria mentioned in the Advertisement.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates have to submit caste certificate, in the Prescribed Proforma meant for "Appointment to posts under the Government of India" from the designated authority indicating clearly the candidate's caste.
  • The OBC (NCL) certificate should not be more than 06 months old at the time of joining.
  • The candidates under PwBD category belonging to the reserved category will have to submit the disability certificate from the designated authority as stipulated in Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 indicating clearly the percentage of disability.
  • If the ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD certificate has been issued in a language other than English/Hindi, the candidates will be required to submit a self-certified translated copy of the same either in English or Hindi.
  • Ex-Servicemen/Ex-Agniveer belonging to the reserved category can also apply against the advertised posts subject to fulfilling the eligibility criteria.
  • Concessions & relaxations will be granted to PwBD candidates applying against the said posts as per Government guidelines in vogue.
  • PwBD candidates belonging to ST category are eligible to apply against Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial) and Welder posts.
  • PwBD candidates belonging to OBC category are eligible to apply against Assistant Superintendent (Finance) post.
  • The posting shall be at GSL/any other GSL units/project sites as desired by GSL. However, depending upon project requirements, the candidates are liable to be transferred within different units of GSL.
  • The appointment to the post carries with it the obligation to serve in any department of GSL or on-board ships or in any of the units/work sites/projects undertaken in any part of India or abroad as the case may be.
  • The candidates may note that the applications are to be made only through online application system as per the instructions given. Applications made in any other manner shall not be considered and shall be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates have to clearly declare the complete experience while filling the online application from initial appointment to the cutoff date.
  • Management reserves the right to fill or not to fill the posts and also to fill up future vacancies, if any from the valid panel of selected candidates as per the rules of the company.
  • At the sole discretion of GSL Management the number of vacancies notified may be increased or reduced.
  • Mere fulfillment of qualifications and other requirements as laid down does not entitle a candidate to be called for selection process.
  • Candidates working in Government/Quasi Government/Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or produce "No Objection Certificate" at the time of selection process.
  • Management reserves the right to transfer any selected candidate in any position as per requirement of Company, irrespective of position he has been originally selected for.
  • The candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post.
  • The Government directives on reservation will be strictly followed.
  • Interim enquiries will not be entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form may lead to disqualification of candidature.
  • Management reserves the right to call for any additional documentary evidence in support of qualification, experience, etc. of the applicants.
  • In case, at any time, it is found that the candidate is not meeting the eligibility criteria, the candidature will summarily be rejected forthwith.
  • Management reserves the right to raise the eligibility criteria for short listing the applications.
  • Management reserves the right to reject the candidature if it is found that false or fabricated information is furnished in the application.
  • Applications received without following the online process will not be entertained. Only ONLINE applications received through GSL recruitment portal will be considered.
  • Management reserves the right to cancel the advertisement and/or the selection process there under without assigning any reason.
  • Corrigendum, if any, will be uploaded on our website only. Candidates are requested to check our website regularly under the heading "Notice Board - Careers - Advertisement".
  • Call letters for selection process will be sent only through E-mail to shortlisted candidates' registered Email ID.
  • Information regarding names of shortlisted candidates, date of written test, names/roll number of selected candidates etc. will be hosted on the website.
  • Management will not be responsible for non-receipt of email and loss of their E-mail ID and password.
  • In the event of finding difficulty to apply online you may contact us through Email: [email protected]
  • Applications received contrary to instructions given shall be rejected.
  • For any dispute, the Jurisdiction shall be Goa only.

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website www.goashipyard.in
  • Under the link Notice Board - 'careers' click the link 'GSL Careers'.
  • Click on 'Apply Now' button and select the post you wish to apply for.
  • Go through the eligibility criteria and the Terms and Conditions of the advertisement before applying online.
  • Keep scanned copies ready before proceeding to fill up the Online Application:
    • Passport size color Photograph with light background (preferably white) - Size below 450 kb
    • Candidate's signature on plain white paper with black ink - Size below 450 kb
    • SSC certificate as proof of date of Birth - Not more than 500 kb
    • Educational qualification mark sheet & degree - Not more than 1 Mb
    • Caste/Disability certificate/Ex-Serviceman certificate - Not more than 500 kb
    • Experience certificates - Not more than 1 Mb
    • Aadhar Card - Not more than 500 kb
  • After completion of Personal information in online application form, fill the Payment details and make the online payment of application fees.
  • Pay application fee of Rs.200/- (Non-Refundable) online through SBI e-pay (by debit card/credit card/net banking etc.). ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from payment.
  • After submitting payment information, please wait for the intimation from the server. Do not press back or refresh button.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, "Fee receipt" would be generated. Download and take print of fee receipt.
  • After completing the Online application, SUBMIT the application form without which the form will be considered as incomplete.
  • Take print out of auto generated filled in Application Form as the same is required to be produced for subsequent Selection Process.
  • After completing the Online application, the candidate will not be allowed to edit his application details.
  • Candidates should ensure all uploaded documents are clear, legible and in the prescribed format and size.
  • Online Application opens from 00:00 hrs. on 05.01.2026 and closes at 17:00 hrs. on 04.02.2026.

Application Fee

  • Fee payable: Rs. 600/-(Rupees Six Hundred only). In case of candidates belonging to SC, ST-1, ST-2, EWS and PwBD category, the fee payable shall be Rs. 500/-(Rupees Five Hundred only).

Important Dates

Date of Commencement for submission of Online Applications: 24 February 2026
Cut-off/Last Date for submission of Online Application Forms 25 March 2026

Selection Process

  • The Examination will consist of Objective Type, Multiple choice Questions. The questions will be set in English Language only.
  • There will be Negative Marking for each wrong answer to the extent of one-fourth of marks assigned to that question.

General Information / Instructions

  • The Appointment and other service conditions in respect of the candidates selected through this selection process shall be governed as per extant rules/regulations of the Government of UT of J&K.
  • The candidate(s) seeking to apply for the advertised posts shall be Domicile(s) of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir and must possess a valid Domicile Certificate issued by the Competent Authority on the prescribed format on or before the cut-off date i.e. last date of submission of online application forms, which, unless otherwise extended, shall be 25.03.2026.
  • The details of posts advertised are given in Annexure-A to this Notification. However, the actual number of posts may undergo increase or decrease during or before the completion of the selection process and the JKSSB is not legally liable for any such variation in the total number of posts advertised for which the final selection list will be issued. The Advertisement Notification is also subject to the outcome of any writ petition/O.A. pending before the competent Court of law.
  • The Reservation for the posts under this Advertisement Notification shall be applicable as per the Category-wise break up of vacancies as conveyed by the Indenting Department and/or in accordance with the provisions of the Jammu & Kashmir Reservation Act/Rules, as amended from time to time.
  • A candidate seeking consideration under Reserved Categories must ensure that they possess a valid/ Category Certificate strictly as on the Cut Off Date and the same is required to be uploaded while submitting online application. It may be noted that no further opportunity to upload any document shall be provided hereafter and action under rules including rejection of application/candidature may be taken strictly as per the legal validity of the uploaded document w.r.t. the prescribed cut-off date.
  • Candidates may note that their candidature will remain provisional till the genuineness and validity of the Reserved Category Certificate is verified by the Appointing Authority.
  • Candidates are cautioned to note that in case a claim for reservation is made on the basis of Invalid/false/fake/fraudulent/forged certificate, they shall be debarred from the examination(s) conducted by the Board, besides penal action as may be deemed appropriate should be initiated against them.
  • Horizontal Reservation means the reservation which would cut across the vertical reservation and the persons selected shall have to be placed in the appropriate category by making necessary adjustments.
  • Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) candidates and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) shall be applicable to the extent as communicated by the Indenting Department(s) in accordance with the extant rules/regulations.
  • The suitability/type of Disabilities/eligibility of Persons with Benchmark Disabilities for these posts under Horizontal Reservation shall be governed by the extant regulations.
  • Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen candidates is applicable as per extant rules, for the posts which carry Pay of and up to the Level-6E (35900-113500).
  • In terms of S.O. 361 of 2021 dated 20.10.2021, an Ex-Servicemen on joining any post after having availed Horizontal Reservation, cannot avail the benefit of Horizontal Reservation as Ex-Servicemen for any subsequent Employment. A candidate seeking to apply under ESM category shall be required to submit an affidavit duly sworn before 1st Class Judicial Magistrate in this regard at the time of scrutiny of the documents.

How to Apply

  • The necessary instructions regarding filling up of online applications, including the details of the Online Portal in this regard shall be made available on the Board’s Website separately. Candidates will be required to fill the application form in online mode only and no other means/mode of application will be accepted.
  •  Before applying, candidates are advised to go through the instructions given in the notice of examination very carefully.
  • Candidates are advised to fill the application form carefully & diligently. Further they are advised to review the application form carefully before submitting. Once submitted and application number generated, no claims for making changes in any entry/field shall be entertained at any later stage.

Public Relations Officer (Level 10)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master degree in Mass Communication and Journalism or equivalent degree with 60% marks and above or equivalent grade 'B' in UGC seven-point scale OR Master Degree in any discipline with 60% marks and above with Post Graduate Diploma in Journalism and Mass Communications
  • Essential Experience: At least five years of experience in centre of any established English Newspaper, periodical, national news agency, radio or television or film media or equivalent experience as Public Relation Officer in recognized University
  • Desirable: Working knowledge of Computer applications, ability to communicate in local languages, preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, two years experience in writing reports/news/press release in print or electronic media, experience in handling social media

Assistant Registrar (Level 10)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master degree or equivalent in any discipline from recognized University with 60% marks and above or equivalent Grade B in UGC seven-point scale with consistently good academic record
  • Essential Experience: At least 05 years relevant administrative experience in supervisory capacity in Govt. office/university/technological institution or organization of repute in Pay Matrix Level 7/Level 8 as per 7th CPC
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, degree in Law/Management/Engineering/Actuarial Science, Chartered or Cost Accountant qualification, SAS qualified, experience in handling computerized administration/financial matters, proficiency in use of latest office automation tools

Sports Officer (Level 10)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master degree with 60% marks and above in Physical Education/Sports Science or equivalent with 5 years of relevant experience in pay level 7/8 in any recognized Institutions and should have represented University/Institute at State/National level OR Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or equivalent with 60% marks and above with 7 years of relevant experience
  • Essential: Should have specialization in at least one sport such as Hockey, Athletics, Swimming, Football, Basketball, Badminton, etc.
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination

Fire and Safety Officer (Level 8)

  • Essential Qualifications: Bachelor Degree with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA from recognized University/Institute
  • Essential Certification: A diploma/certification for at least one year duration in Fire and Safety Management/Fire Technology & Industrial Safety Management/Safety and Disasters management or equivalent
  • Essential Experience: 05 years experience in capacity of Supervisor or equivalent safety professional in Fire Fighting in Civil/Defence Fire Service department/Public Undertaking/CFTIs or in reputed private organisation
  • Essential: Must be able to handle fire arms with sound health and active habits
  • Desirable: Post Graduate Degree/Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety with 5 years relevant experience, valid driving license for LMVs

Senior Laboratory Officer (Level 8)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in Engineering/Science or equivalent in appropriate field with minimum 60% marks with 05 year relevant experience in Pay Matrix Level 6 OR Bachelor Degree (four years) in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 07 years relevant experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Science (Three years) with minimum 60% marks with 08 years relevant experience OR Three years Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 08 year relevant experience
  • Desirable: Proficiency in use of latest office automation tools and applications

Laboratory Officer (Level 6)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in Engineering/Science or equivalent in appropriate field with minimum 60% marks with 03 year relevant experience in Pay Matrix Level 4 OR Bachelor Degree (four years) in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 05 year relevant experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Science (Three years) with minimum 60% marks with 06 year relevant experience OR Three years Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 06 year relevant experience
  • Desirable: Proficiency in use of latest office automation tools and applications

Junior Section Officer (Level 6)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in any discipline from recognized university with 60% marks and above with 03 year experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc. as Senior Assistant or equivalent in Pay Matrix Level 4 OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with 60% marks and above with 05 years experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc as Senior Assistant or equivalent
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, Higher Degree/PG Diploma in relevant discipline like HR, Labor Laws, Financial Management, inter ICWA/CA, proficiency in use of latest office automation tools

Assistant Sports Officer (Level 6)

  • Essential Qualifications: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or equivalent with 60% marks and above with 3 years of relevant experience in any recognized Institutions and should have represented University/Institute at State/National level
  • Essential: Should have specialization in at least one sport such as Hockey, Athletics, Swimming, Football, Basketball, Badminton, etc.
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, N.I.S Coaching Diploma holders and medal winners in inter University/national games, representation at international level, certificate from national/international federation recognized by GoI, at least 02 years experience in coaching at University level

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Indian Nationals holding Graduate or Post Graduate degree in Law from recognized Universities, Colleges and Institutions of National and International repute, and/or Chartered Accountant.
  • Candidates should have obtained at least 50% marks in:
    • 3-year LLB, or
    • 5-year integrated LLB degree programme, or
    • Post Graduation degree programme, or
    • as a qualified Chartered Accountant.

Preferred Qualification

  • Chartered Accountants who have completed their articleship in taxation.
  • Law graduates/post graduates who have been engaged in research work/projects in taxation.
  • Candidates having skills in Information & Communication Technology (ICT) with good communication and interpersonal skills.

Age Limit

  • Candidates should not exceed 35 years of age as on the date of advertisement (27/01/2026).

Job Description

  • Young Professionals will be attached with the office of the CIT(DR) or Sr. DR in the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal.
  • They will study paper books of listed cases, analyse judgements relied upon by the assessee and find judgements in favour of the department.
  • They will identify distinguishing facts where applicable and prepare briefing notes and written submissions.
  • They will undertake research/study on specific points as briefed by the CIT(DR)/Sr. DR.
  • The Mentor (CIT(DR)) will provide orientation on deliverables at the time of joining.

Selection Process

  • The selection process will involve two stages:
    • Screening, and
    • Interview.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email or speed-post for personal interview.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
  • Shortlisted candidates must produce their bio-data and original certificates for verification at the time of interview.

How To Apply

  • Eligible and willing candidates must apply in the prescribed format (Annexure-II).
  • Applications should be addressed to:
    Commissioner of Income Tax (Admin & TPS),
    [Attention: ITO (Technical)-1],
    1st Floor, Central Revenue Building,
    Beer Chand Patel Path, Patna-800001, Bihar.
  • Mode of submission: By Speed-post or by hand.
  • The envelope containing the application should be superscribed as:
    “Application For Engagement Of Young Professional As Per Young Professional Scheme, 2023”.
  • Incomplete applications and/or applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected without correspondence.

Important Dates

Event Date/Time
Date of Advertisement 27/01/2026
Last Date of Receipt of Applications 17/02/2026 up to 06:00 PM

Application Fee

No specific application fee or processing charge is mentioned in the notification for this Young Professional engagement.

Salary/Stipend

  • Remuneration: Rs. 60,000/- per month (lump sum).
  • No DA, accommodation, phone/conveyance/transport, foreign travel, personal staff, medical reimbursement, CGHS or similar facilities will be admissible.

Instructions

  • Deployment is full-time for one year, extendable by another year based on satisfactory performance.
  • Young Professionals are eligible for 8 days leave in a calendar year, accrued on a pro-rata basis; unavailed leave cannot be carried forward.
  • No remuneration is payable for absence beyond 8 days in a year.
  • The engagement does not confer any right to regular job/appointment or employer–employee relationship with the Income Tax Department.
  • Young Professionals are bound by the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 and must sign a Declaration of Secrecy and Non-Disclosure Agreement.
  • They must not publish articles, books or participate in media activities using information obtained during engagement without prior sanction of the Pr. CCIT Region.
  • Engagement may be discontinued at any time by the Department without assigning reasons; normally one month notice will be given.
  • Young Professionals may resign by giving one month’s notice to the competent authority.
  • Continuous absence for 8 days without information or valid reason will lead to automatic termination.
  • The provisions of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition & Redressal) Act, 2013 will apply.

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting of candidates by a Committee constituted by the Director, CSIR-NML, based on fulfillment of qualification, terms and conditions of the advertisement; only shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear in the Competitive Written Examination.
  • Selection will be made on the basis of merit list of Competitive Written Examination.
  • Competitive Written Examination will be Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination, with questions in English and Hindi (except English language section), standard of Class X, total 150 questions and total time of 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for candidates eligible for scribe).
  • The paper will have four parts: Part I General Intelligence (25 questions, 75 marks), Part II Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions, 75 marks), Part III General Awareness (50 questions, 150 marks), Part IV English Language (50 questions, 150 marks), with three marks for every correct answer and one negative mark for every wrong answer.
  • Merit list will be prepared on the basis of performance in Competitive Written Examination, with tie resolved by lesser negative marks, older age, earlier acquisition of minimum educational qualification, and alphabetical order of first name.

General Information / Instructions

  • The applicant must be a citizen of India and must possess the essential qualification and fulfill all conditions stipulated in the advertisement; minimum essential qualification is compulsory even if higher qualification is possessed.
  • The age limit for Multi Tasking Staff is 18-25 years with relaxations as per Government/CSIR rules; crucial date for determining age, qualifications, experience and reserved category status is the closing date for receipt of online applications.
  • All new entrants will be governed by the New Pension Scheme as adopted by CSIR; the post carries usual allowances (DA, HRA, TA) and benefits such as medical reimbursement, LTC, advances, and CSIR residence allotment as per rules.
  • Normal place of posting is CSIR-NML, Jamshedpur, including centres at Chennai and Digha (West Bengal), but appointees can be posted in any CSIR Lab/Institute or its centres in India at the discretion of competent authority.
  • Candidates will not be paid any TA/DA for appearing in Competitive Written Examination and canvassing in any form or bringing political/other influence will be treated as disqualification.
  • The Director, CSIR-NML reserves the right to cancel the advertisement or not to fill the posts and the number of vacancies may increase or decrease at the time of selection.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for two years, which may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the competent authority.
  • Any further information, addendum/corrigendum, and details regarding tests will be provided only on CSIR-NML website https://www.nml.res.in, and candidates are advised to visit the website regularly.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are advised to go through the instructions for applying online available in the online application portal on CSIR-NML website https://nml.res.in.
  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online only through CSIR-NML website; the online application link will be available from 05.01.2026 (11.00 AM) to 06.02.2026 (05:00 PM), and no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates are required to submit only one application against any given post code; two or more applications against one post code may lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates desirous to apply for more than one post code should submit separate applications for each post code with requisite application fee for each, wherever applicable.
  • Candidates should submit the online application form well in advance without waiting for the last date/time; CSIR-NML will not be responsible for non-submission of application or payment of fee for any reason.
  • Candidates must have a valid and active personal email ID to be kept active till completion of the recruitment process and must upload latest passport size colour photograph and signature as per specified size and format.
  • Application fee of Rs.500/- (if applicable) must be paid through SBI Collect link provided in the online application; fee once paid will not be refunded or kept in reserve for any other recruitment.
  • Candidates working in Government Departments/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs must attach NOC or proof of having applied for NOC and must produce NOC with vigilance clearance when asked, failing which candidature will be terminated.
  • Required certificates (educational, category, PwBD, Ex-servicemen, NOC, etc.) and a handwritten declaration must be scanned and uploaded as separate PDF files (each not more than 4 MB) along with the online application.
  • Applications without proper signature, photograph, applicable fee or clear documents will be summarily rejected, and no interim enquiry or correspondence will be entertained.

CSIR-CIMFR Security Officer 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for CSIR-CIMFR Security Officer Recruitment 2026 is 01 post.

Post Name Total Posts
Security Officer 01

Note: CSIR-CIMFR strives to have a workforce that reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification & Experience

Candidates must possess the following essential qualification and experience for the Security Officer post:

  • Ex-Servicemen JCO (Subedar or higher rank) OR equivalent rank in other Para-military forces with minimum of 10 years’ experience in security.
  • For Short Service Commissioned Officers and incumbents holding the position of Assistant Commandant in CRPF/BSF/ITBP etc. in pay scale Rs. 8000–13500 (Pre-revised) – minimum 05 years’ experience in security.
  • For Inspector from Para-Military Forces – minimum 10 years’ experience in security.

2. Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Maximum Age: 35 years as on 02-02-2026 (last date of receipt of application).
  • The date for determining age limit, experience and qualifications is 02-02-2026 up to 5:30 PM.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against UR vacancy are not eligible for age relaxation.
  • Relaxation in age limit is available only for eligible Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules under Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979 as amended.
  • Not applicable to serving Armed Forces personnel (except those being released after earning pension) and Paramilitary Forces personnel.

3. Nationality

The applicant must be a citizen of India. All applicants must fulfill the essential requirements and conditions as on 02-02-2026.

Job Description

The Security Officer will be responsible for overall security management of CSIR-CIMFR campus and its units, including supervision of security measures, record maintenance, and handling security-related emergencies.

  • Supervising security measures for safety of CSIR-CIMFR properties and units.
  • Maintaining records related to movement of men and materials, deployment of security personnel in all shifts, handling visitors, security cameras, and enforcement of security rules and procedures.
  • Working round the clock (24x7) as required and attending in person to security-related emergencies.
  • Conducting investigations into theft, pilferage, accidents, sabotage or subversive activities and coordinating with local law and order authorities; knowledge of local language is an added advantage.
  • Use and maintenance of firearms.
  • Firefighting and combating fire in emergencies.
  • Any other duty assigned by the competent authority.

Age Limit

  • Upper age limit not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of submission of application (02-02-2026 at 5:30 PM).
  • Date for determining age limit, experience and qualifications is the closing date for receipt of applications.
  • No age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against UR vacancy.
  • Age relaxation available only for eligible Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules under Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979 as amended.

Application Fee

  • Candidates are required to pay a non-refundable Application Fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only).
  • Payment must be made through SBI payment gateway available at CSIR-CIMFR website (www.cimfr.nic.in) via SBI Collect.
  • Web generated e-receipt of SBI payment must be enclosed with the application form.
  • No other mode of payment is accepted.
  • SC/ST/Women candidates are exempted from payment of application fee (as mentioned in the “How to apply” section).

Selection Process

Candidates will be selected through the following stages:

  • Physical and Personality Assessment Test (qualifying in nature).
  • Written Test (for candidates who qualify the physical and personality assessment test).
  • Final merit list based on performance in competitive written examination (primarily Paper-II as per syllabus).
  • Tie cases will be resolved as per CSIR Letter No. 5-1(211)/2014-PD dated 30.05.2023 and any subsequent amendments.

Long Jump 3.65 m in 3 chances 2.70 m in 3 chances

Written Test Pattern

Candidates who qualify the physical test will be allowed to appear for the written test, consisting of two papers:

  • Paper-I: OMR-based or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Test.
  • Paper-II: Subjective type.
  • Paper-I (Mental Ability and Personality Assessment Test): 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes, no negative marking.
  • Threshold marks for Paper-I: 30%. Only candidates securing at least 30% in Paper-I will have Paper-II evaluated.
  • Paper-II: Total 100 marks, 2 hours duration – Comprehension (25), Report Writing (25), Security Regulations & Firefighting (25), General Awareness (25).
  • Minimum threshold marks for Paper-II shall not be less than 35% (to be notified before test).
  • Final merit list based on Paper-II marks only for candidates who secure more than minimum threshold marks.
  • Medium of exam: English and Hindi (bilingual question papers; exam can be taken in either language).
  • Standard of exam: Graduation level.

Salary / Stipend

  • Scale of Pay: Level-7 as per 7th CPC, Rs. 44,900–1,42,400.
  • Approximate total emoluments: Rs. 78,000/- per month at minimum of scale, including House Rent Allowance as admissible in Dhanbad.
  • Benefits include DA, HRA (if accommodation not provided), Transport Allowance and other allowances as per CSIR/GoI norms.
  • New entrants governed by New Pension Scheme (NPS) 2004 as adopted by CSIR; those from Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs with Govt. pattern pension continue under CCS (Pension) Rules 1972 (now 2021), as applicable.

How To Apply

Candidates must submit applications only in offline mode using the prescribed format.

  1. Visit CSIR-CIMFR website: www.cimfr.nic.in.
  2. Go to “Vacancies” section (http://cimfr.nic.in/vacancies.html) and download the prescribed Application Form (A4 size).
  3. Read the advertisement completely before filling the form. All columns are mandatory; write “Not Applicable (NA)” where not relevant.
  4. Fill the application form in English/Hindi, affix recent self-attested passport size colour photograph and sign the form.
  5. Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- (if applicable) through SBI Collect via SBI payment gateway available at CIMFR website and take a print-out of the e-receipt.
  6. Attach self-attested copies of required documents (age proof, educational qualifications, experience, discharge certificate, caste certificate, NOC if applicable, etc.) along with web generated SBI e-receipt.
  7. Place the application and enclosures in an envelope superscribed:
    “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF __________ (Post Code: _______), Advt. No. _______”
  8. Send the envelope by Registered/Speed Post only to:
    The Controller of Administration, Central Institute of Mining & Fuel Research, Barwa Road, Dhanbad – 826001 (JHARKHAND)
  9. Ensure that the application reaches on or before 02-02-2026 by 5:30 PM. Applications received after the closing date/time will not be entertained.
  10. Applications without photograph, signature, application fee (if applicable), or required enclosures will be summarily rejected.

  • Possession of higher qualification other than the essential qualification does not entitle eligibility for the post

Experience

  • Shift Manager (CE-07): Minimum 07 years post qualification work experience in Coal Mining. Must have 03 years of experience after obtaining 1st class Mines Manager Certificate (Coal)
  • Welfare Officer (CE-06): Minimum 04 years post qualification work experience in Mining sector
  • Assistant Shift In charge (CE-06): Minimum 04 years post qualification work experience in open cast coal mines
  • Assistant Colliery Engineer (Electrical) (CE-06): Minimum 04 years of post-qualification work experience in repair/maintenance/commissioning of electrical equipment in large open cast mines. Work experience in electrical substation shall be desirable
  • Assistant Colliery Engineer (Mechanical) (CE-06): Minimum 04 years of post-qualification work experience in repair and maintenance of Heavy Earth Moving Machinery. Work experience in large opencast mines is desirable
  • Assistant Safety Officer (CE-06): Minimum 04 years post qualification experience in open cast coal mines. Candidates who have served in a statutory capacity as Safety Officer in opencast coal mines will be desirable
  • Overman Coal (Safety) (CE-04): Minimum 05 years post qualification work experience in Open cast coal Mine. Candidates with experience as Workmen's Inspector will be considered an added advantage
  • Overman Coal (Production) (CE-04): Minimum 05 years post qualification work experience in Open cast coal Mine in statutory capacity as Overman. Experience in greenfield coal mining projects in India shall be considered an added advantage
  • Overman Coal (Blasting) (CE-04): Minimum 05 years post qualification work experience in Open cast coal Mine in statutory capacity as Blasting Overman. Experience in greenfield coal mining projects in India shall be considered an added advantage
  • Overman Coal (Shift) (CE-04): Minimum 05 years post qualification work experience in Open cast coal Mine in statutory capacity as Overman. Experience in greenfield coal mining projects in India shall be considered an added advantage
  • Wherever applicable, candidates have to produce experience certificate as per DGMS approved format

Desirable

  • Work experience in electrical substation for Assistant Colliery Engineer (Electrical)
  • Work experience in large opencast mines for Assistant Colliery Engineer (Mechanical)
  • Candidates who have served in a statutory capacity as Safety Officer in opencast coal mines for Assistant Safety Officer post
  • Experience as Workmen's Inspector for Overman Coal (Safety)
  • Experience in greenfield coal mining projects in India for Overman Coal (Production, Blasting, Shift) positions

Salary/Stipend

  • CE-07 Grade (Shift Manager): Rs. 1,00,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • CE-06 Grade (Welfare Officer, Assistant Shift In charge, Assistant Colliery Engineer, Assistant Safety Officer): Rs. 80,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • CE-04 Grade (Overman Coal - All Categories): Rs. 60,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • The consolidated remuneration can be increased up to maximum 5% annually in subsequent years based upon performance
  • The remuneration will be based on actual attendance and prorated deductions shall be made for absence
  • Outpatient expenses for self-treatment at Rs. 35,000/- per annum will also be paid
  • HRA will be paid as applicable
  • In case of official tour, candidates will be eligible for TA/DA as applicable
  • Covered by suitable Accidental Group Insurance for any accident occurred out of or in the course of employment during the period of contract
  • Statutory deductions as applicable shall be made as per applicable laws

Age Limit (as on 17/02/2026)

  • Maximum Age for CE-06 and CE-04 Grades: 50 Years
  • Maximum Age for CE-07 Grade: 60 Years (maximum contract period)
  • Age Relaxation: The upper age limit can be relaxed up to 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBCs (Non-Creamy Layer) and for PwBD/Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India Guidelines on the maximum age mentioned above
  • The cut-off date for reckoning eligibility for age will be the last date for submitting online application i.e., 17/02/2026
  • The date of birth as well as the name of the applicant will invariably be taken from Matriculation/10th class certificate issued by the recognized Board and no other proof of date of birth and name shall be accepted

Application Fee

  • General/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) - Non-refundable
  • SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen/Departmental Candidates: Exempted from paying application fee (proof for the exemption is to be attached)
  • The payment can be made by using UPI/credit card/online net banking through SBI Collect using Internet Banking integrated with online application
  • Transaction charges, if any, will be borne by the candidate
  • On successful completion of transaction, application form with Unique Transaction Number and Application number will be generated which is to be printed for record
  • For failed transaction, the amount will be automatically refunded to the same account from which payment was originally made, within 10 working days
  • Application fee once paid will not be refunded or adjusted against any further notifications in case of cancellation or any other circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 31/01/2026
Online Application Start Date 03/02/2026 (10:00 AM)
Online Application Last Date 17/02/2026 (11:59 PM)
Walk-in Drive (Document Verification & Interview) 1st week of March 2026
Walk-in Drive Location Ranchi, Jharkhand
Helpline Email Support Available 10:00 AM to 06:00 PM on all working days

Selection Process

  • The mode of selection would be through Walk-in drive consisting of document verification and interview
  • The Walk-in drive is planned to be conducted during 1st week of March 2026 at Ranchi, Jharkhand
  • Selection will be made by duly constituted Committee through Walk-in-Interview to assess the suitability of eligible candidates after Document Verification
  • Only those candidates will be permitted for Interview whose documents verification is found in order as per Notification
  • The candidates who have registered successfully will be intimated through email and SMS only for attending the Walk-in-drive
  • All successfully registered candidates will be issued admit card for attending walk in drive
  • Candidates called for Walk-in drive should produce original documents/testimonials, along with self-attested photo copies, in support of essential criterions for verification of their eligibility as per notification
  • In case the candidate is unable to produce/submit the required documents meeting eligible criterions, the candidate will not be permitted to attend the Interview and Travelling Allowance will not be reimbursed
  • All the candidates will be issued call letter/admit card based on their declaration in the Online application, upon successful registration, without any initial scrutiny
  • Mere issue of call letter/admit card does not indicate that the eligibility of the candidate has been confirmed
  • The eligibility of the candidate will be confirmed after Document Verification at the time of Interview on production of original certificates with respect to date of birth, qualification, experience, caste category etc.

General Information/Instructions

  • NMDC Limited is a Navaratna Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Steel, Government of India
  • The posts are for Tokisud North Coal Mine, Hazaribagh District, Jharkhand State on contractual basis
  • The period of contract/engagement will be maximum up to three years initially or till the age of 60 years, whichever is earlier
  • The initial agreed period can be extended based on performance and depending on the requirements
  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen will be as per Government of India Directives
  • The number of vacancies indicated is tentative and may vary depending upon the requirement
  • The selected candidates must be medically fit for their selected area and will be subject to medical fitness test at the Company's authorized medical hospital/centre
  • The engagement can be terminated by giving one month's notice on either side
  • Once engaged, the candidate will not be allowed to take up any other assignment outside during the period of their engagement
  • Candidates will be entitled for 12 days of Casual Leaves and 20 days of Medical Leave in a calendar year
  • The un-availed Casual Leave and Medical Leaves in a year cannot be carried forward
  • Encashment of Casual Leave and Medical Leaves are not permitted
  • Candidates will be eligible for weekly day of rest and public holidays as per rules of the Company
  • NMDC Management reserves the right to alter/fix the criteria for calling the candidates for Interview on the basis of qualification, experience, if any, etc. depending upon the number of applications received
  • During recruitment process, if any information provided by the candidate is found incorrect/incomplete or it is not in conformity with eligibility criteria, candidature will be cancelled at any stage
  • Mere fulfilling of the minimum criteria will not vest any right in candidates for being called for different stages of recruitment process
  • The selected candidate will be posted in any of the Mines/Units/Offices of the Company as per requirements at any stage during service
  • All Outstation candidates attended the Interview will be reimbursed Travelling Allowance of second AC Two Tier Rail/Bus fare on production of Railway/Bus tickets by shortest route as per rules
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EWS/PwBD/Ex-servicemen category should enclose a copy of caste/permanent Certificate as applicable in the prescribed proforma
  • The OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate submitted should be not older than 06 months as on the last date of application
  • Candidates seeking reservation under EWS will have to submit an Income and Asset Certificate issued by the Competent Authority valid for the year 2025-26
  • Category once filled in the application form will not be changed and no benefit of other category will be admissible later on
  • Ex-servicemen are required to produce equivalence certificate of qualification acquired by them issued by the Competent Authority at the time of Interview
  • Wherever CGPA/letter grade in a degree is awarded, equivalent percentage of marks should be indicated in the online application form as per the norms adopted by the University/Institute
  • No interim correspondence will be entertained on any account during recruitment process
  • Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Hyderabad
  • In case of any clarifications, typographical errors or omissions, Corrigendum etc. to the notification shall be issued in the NMDC Website only

How to Apply

  • Applicants must apply/register themselves in online mode only
  • Eligible candidates are required to apply online through NMDC website www.nmdc.co.in (link available on the "Careers" page of the website)
  • The site will be available/activated from 10:00 AM on 03/02/2026 to 11:59 PM on 17/02/2026
  • Helpline email [email protected] will be available between 10:00 AM to 06:00 PM on all working days to assist in technical aspect of online mode
  • Candidates are required to fill all the details online and upload all the relevant documents/certificates such as:
    • Recent passport size photograph
    • Matriculation/10th certificate
    • Certificates in support of Qualification and Experience
    • Caste/Category Certificate, SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/Disability/Ex-Serviceman Certificate etc. as applicable
    • Scanned signature
    • Mobile number
    • Valid email id etc. as per the requirement of notification
  • Before applying in online mode, candidates are advised to read the instructions of notification carefully and shall ensure that they fulfill all the essential requirements of the post and other conditions
  • For detailed notification along with its Annexures for the above posts, candidates are advised to visit careers page of NMDC website i.e. www.nmdc.co.in
  • After applying online, the candidate is required to download the hard copy of filled in application form and keep the printout of the Application/Registration form
  • Call letters/admit cards will be sent through email and can also be downloaded from Careers page on NMDC Limited Website
  • NMDC Limited will not be responsible for any loss of email sent due to invalid/wrong Email ID provided by the candidate
  • Only those candidates will be allowed to appear for Interview who will produce valid call letter/admit card
  • Candidates are required to mention their date of birth and name as per Matriculation/10th class certificate issued by the recognized Board
  • Candidates are advised to submit only one application. In case of multiple applications from a candidate, the latest one shall be considered as final and older applications shall be rejected
  • Candidates should retain printed copy of their application form as they can be asked to produce it for future reference
  • Information regarding Interview will be provided in the Admit Card/Call Letter which can be downloaded from Careers Page of NMDC website
  • Candidates are advised to visit NMDC Limited Website www.nmdc.co.in regularly for latest updates

General Information/Instructions

Management reserves the right to reject the application without assigning any reason and to raise standard of specifications to restrict the number of candidates to be called for engagement as Apprentices. The selection process can be cancelled/suspended/restricted/enlarged/modified without assigning any reasons. The decision of the Management will be final and no appeal will be entertained.
  • The candidature is liable for rejection at any stage of training process in case of suppression/furnishing of false information.
  • UCIL can place the candidate for training at any of its unit.
  • First preference shall be given to candidates belonging to Land Displaced Category. Second preference shall be given to local candidates (within 5 km) radius for project affected family [as per R&R Policy] of all the units of UCIL in Jharkhand region and Third preference shall be given to Employees [who are working in any unit of UCIL] Wards relevant documents shall be verified at the time of joining. Hard copy regarding Land Displaced and Employees Son may be sent to the Central Personnel Section of UCIL, Jaduguda for Jaduguda/Narwapahar and Turamdih on or before the last date of submission of application in this advertisement by post.
  • Those candidates awaiting their mark sheet/certificates are NOT eligible to apply for the above apprentice training.

  • No communication shall be done with the applicant regard to incomplete application. Incomplete application shall be summarily rejected.
  • Interested candidate can apply through NAPS portal & NATS portal.
  • No other method of application shall be considered except application received through NAPS portal & NATS portal.
  • Any other information not covered under this notice shall be applicable as per The Apprentice Act and The Apprenticeship Rules.
  • Any kind of arbitration shall be under the jurisdiction of Ranchi High Court [Jharkhand].
  • No previously posted applications prior to publication date of this advertisement shall be considered for apprenticeship under this advertisement.
  • Application shall not be received in offline mode.
  • The result shall be published on our UCIL website www.uraniumcorp.in. No correspondence in this regard shall be made. Candidates are requested to visit UCIL website for publication of result. The selected candidates shall be informed through their registered email ID.
  • Any change/amendment in the advertisement shall be published on UCIL website.
  • Screening and selection will be based on the details provided in the on-line application form, hence it is necessary that only accurate, full and correct information is furnished by the applicants. Furnishing of wrong/false information will be a reason for disqualification and UCIL will NOT be responsible for disqualification as a consequence of furnishing of such wrong/false information.
  • Provisional merit list shall be prepared based on the information entered in the portal. Physical verification of the original documents shall be done during joining.
  • Mail for further any communication: [email protected]

How to Apply

  • For registration visit Govt. portal website a) Trade Apprentice https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ b) Technician Apprentice – Diploma at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php c) Graduate Apprentice: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php

After registration a confirmation e-mail will be sent to the registered e-mail address of the candidate. The candidate has to click on the link provided in the e-mail for activation (example:- Registration Number-A000000000) and thereafter the candidate has to login and complete his profile for confirmation of registration. The applicant should apply in online mode through official website of apprenticeship portal with the following documents to be uploaded:- [a] Matriculation Cert. & All Mark Sheets [b] Caste Certificate [for SC/ST/OBC [NCL] only] [c] Certificate applicable for EWS candidates [d] Medical Certificate applicable for physically handicapped only [e] Photo and signature [f] Aadhaar Card & Pan Card [g] Aadhaar card linked bank account [h] Land Acquisition Certificate for Land Displaced Person /Adhaar Card for Project affected family and UCIL ID card of employee for Employee son.

Thereafter the candidate must also select one or more than one unit i.e. (Uranium Corporation of India Limited, Jaduguda / Narwapahar and Turamdih) in which he/she wishes to undergo Apprenticeship Training on or before 28.02.2026

    • Up to a maximum period of 5 years for UR
    • 8 years for OBC category candidates
    • 10 years for SC/ST category candidates
  • The date for determination of eligibility with regard to age will be the date on which the candidates appear in the interview/written test examination

EWS (Economically Weaker Sections) Rs. 1,000/-

  • Account Details: Account No. 41792595056, IFSC Code: SBIN0064014
  • No other mode of payment i.e., Cash/Cheques/Postal Order will be entertained

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 20.01.2026
Cutoff date for receiving soft copy 05.02.2026
Cutoff date for receiving hard copy 05.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Selection will be done through Interview/written test examination in the various departments of AIIMS Deoghar
  • Eligible candidates are requested to report at Registrar Office, Administrative Block, 4th floor, AIIMS Deoghar on the date of Interview (which will be notified later on AIIMS Deoghar website)
  • Candidates must bring originals, photocopies of relevant documents and one passport size colour photograph
  • No TA/DA will be permissible for appearing at the interview
  • The dates of Interview will be notified in due course through AIIMS Deoghar website www.aiimsdeoghar.edu.in

General Information/Instructions

  • The appointment is initially for a period of 1 year which is further extendable (depending upon concerned departmental assessment & availability of posts) for another 2 years (maximum period 3 years) as per Residency Scheme 1992, Govt. of India
  • The appointment is on full time basis and private practice of any kind is prohibited
  • Selected candidates may work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute as per discretion of the MS/Dean/Director
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify candidate
  • In case any information given or declaration by the candidate is found to be false or if the candidate has willfully suppressed any information relevant to this appointment, he/she will be liable to be removed from service
  • Person with disability are required to produce the physically handicapped certificate (with degree of disability) in original issued by the Competent Authority at the time of interview
  • Candidates are expected to abide by the rules of conduct and discipline as applicable to the Institute employees
  • All disputes will be subject to jurisdictions of High Court Jharkhand
  • Their engagement will be as per terms and conditions of Central Residency Scheme, their engagement is to be regulated as per the CCS (Temporary Service Rules)
  • This appointment will not vest any right to claim by the candidate for permanent absorption in the institute
  • If any candidate who joins the post and leave/resign/gets terminated before completion of the tenure, he/she may do so by giving one month's prior notice as per rules or by depositing pay and allowances in lieu thereof
  • All information pertaining to this advertisement including change in date of interview, notices, result etc. will be displayed on the AIIMS Deoghar website
  • As per EWS guidelines, if vacancy earmarked for EWS cannot be filled up due to non-availability of candidates belonging to EWS, such vacancies is not carried forward to next recruitment year as backlog
  • Candidate must submit the latest (FY 2025-26) OBC certificate issued by the competent authority which should not be older than one year as on last date of submission of offline application form
  • Valid EWS and OBC Certificate issued during the period from 01.04.2025 till the last date of Application will be considered valid
  • The EWS and OBC Certificate must be issued on or before last date of sending of Offline Application Form

How to Apply

  • Candidates have to fill the Offline Application Form available on AIIMS Deoghar website
  • Send the completed application form along with one set of self-attested photocopies of relevant documents, Demand Draft and one passport size colour photograph pasted in the application form
  • Send Application to: Registrar Office, 4th Floor, AIIMS, Devipur (Academic Block), Deoghar- 814152 (Jharkhand) by Speed Post

  • The Legal Assistant shall maintain devotion to duty, high moral standard, integrity and utmost secrecy; violation may attract penal action under the Indian Penal Code and the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 as applicable.

  • Candidate must write his/her name, date of birth and father’s name strictly as given in the Matriculation/10th Certificate; otherwise candidature will be rejected/cancelled.

  • Written Examination: The written examination will be objective type consisting of 5 papers of 200 marks each. Each paper will be of 2 hours duration. Total marks for written examination: 1000 marks.
  • Paper-I: Pharmaceutics for Degree in Pharmacy/Pharmaceutical Sciences; General Medicine for Degree in Medicine with specialization (200 marks)
  • Paper-II: Microbiology (200 marks)
  • Paper-III: Pharmacology (200 marks)
  • Paper-IV: Pharmaceutical Chemistry for Pharmacy degree holders; Biochemistry for Medicine degree holders (200 marks)
  • Paper-V: Pharmaceutical Jurisprudence & Ethics (200 marks)
  • Interview: 100 marks
  • Total Marks: 1100 (1000 Written + 100 Interview)
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • General Category: 40%
    • Backward Class: 36.5%
    • Backward Class (Category-I): 34%
    • SC/ST and Female Category: 32%
    • Primitive Tribal Group: 30%
    • EWS: 40%
  • Syllabus: The syllabus for written examination is available on the Commission's website www.jpsc.gov.in

General Information/Instructions

  • Post Type: Permanent position with 2 years probation period
  • Department: State Drug Control Directorate, Namkum, Ranchi under Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand
  • Reservation Benefit: Reservation benefit will be given only to permanent residents of Jharkhand State. All categories of candidates claiming reservation must submit Local Resident Certificate. Caste/income and asset certificates issued for educational purposes will not be acceptable for determining reservation category.
  • Caste Certificate: SC/ST candidates of Jharkhand State must submit caste certificate issued by competent authority in prescribed format (Form-5/Form-V for ST and Form-4/Form-IV for SC). Central Format caste certificates are not valid for state government services.
  • OBC Certificate: EBC-I and BC-II category candidates must submit caste certificate in prescribed Format-XI/Form-11 (Non-Creamy Layer) issued by competent authority of Jharkhand State. If the validity of Non-Creamy Layer certificate has expired, candidates must submit self-declaration in Form-XV.
  • EWS Certificate: Economically Weaker Section candidates must submit valid and updated Income & Asset Certificate issued by competent authority of Jharkhand State in prescribed format (Annexure-I).
  • Change of Category: Changes in reservation category claimed in online application cannot be made during the recruitment process.
  • Document Verification: Original certificates of all documents mentioned in application must be presented at the time of document verification before interview, otherwise reservation benefit will not be given.
  • NOC Requirement: Government servants must enter details of No Objection Certificate issued by controlling authority in online application, or if NOC is not issued at that time, must indicate "Applied for NOC" and submit original NOC at time of document verification.
  • Misconduct: Candidates found guilty of misconduct including providing false information, suppressing material information, impersonation, using unfair means, submitting fabricated documents, etc. may be disqualified and debarred from examinations as per Jharkhand Competitive Examination (Prevention and Prohibition of Unfair Means in Recruitment) Act, 2023.
  • Pre-examination Training: Information regarding pre-examination training syllabus is available on Commission's website.
  • Commission's Rights: The Commission reserves the right to postpone or cancel the selection process at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Canvassing: Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.
  • Final Authority: The decision of the Commission regarding eligibility and other matters will be final.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only through One Time Registration (OTR) System available on JPSC website www.jpsc.gov.in from 29.01.2026 to 18.02.2026 (05:00 PM).
  • Before filling online application, candidates must read "How to Register for OTR" available on Commission's website.
  • Candidates must have valid email ID and mobile number which should be kept active till final result declaration.
  • Upload clear colored passport size photograph and signature at designated places through OTR System. Application will be rejected if photograph and signature are not uploaded.
  • Fill application form in BLOCK LETTERS (except signature).
  • Write name and father's name spelling exactly as mentioned in Matriculation certificate/mark sheet.
  • Enter date of birth as mentioned in Matriculation certificate/mark sheet.
  • Pay examination fee through Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/Wallet/Bharat QR/UPI via Payment Gateway.
  • After successful submission, login to dashboard and download filled application from "Download Filled Application Section". Take two printouts.
  • Upload required documents in OTR and also send hard copy of online application along with self-attested copies of all required certificates by Registered Post/Speed Post/Hand Delivery to: Examination Controller, Jharkhand Public Service Commission, Circular Road, Ranchi, 834001 by 05.03.2026 (05:00 PM).
  • Write on envelope: Advertisement No. 12/2025, Post Name: Drug Inspector, OTR No., Registration No. in BOLD letters.
  • Applications received through any other medium or after last date will not be accepted.
  • Documents to be submitted (hard copy with original at time of document verification):
    • Matriculation certificate and mark sheet
    • Intermediate certificate and mark sheet
    • Degree certificate in Pharmacy/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Medicine with specialization
    • Experience certificate as per eligibility criteria
    • Caste certificate (where applicable)
    • Local Resident certificate (where applicable - mandatory for all categories of women and PwBD for horizontal reservation)
    • Disability certificate issued by Medical Board (where applicable)
    • No Objection Certificate (for Jharkhand Government permanent employees for age relaxation)

UCSL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 13 Manager & Executive Posts

Advertisement

Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited (UCSL), Malpe, Karnataka, a wholly owned subsidiary of Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) under Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, has released the official notification for UCSL Recruitment 2026. Candidates looking for UCSL jobs 2026 can apply online for 13 vacancies of Assistant General Manager, Senior Manager, Manager, and Deputy Manager posts on permanent rolls. This UCSL vacancy 2026 offers attractive monthly emoluments ranging from ₹1,03,400 to ₹1,65,440 for various executive positions. Interested Engineering graduates with relevant experience in Shipbuilding, Ship Repair, Offshore Fabrication, or related industries must check complete details about eligibility criteria, pay scale, and selection procedure before applying for UCSL Malpe recruitment 2026.

Educational Qualification for UCSL Vacancy 2026

Desirable:

  • Minimum 60% marks from recognized University

Desirable:

  • Proficiency in Computer Applications: AutoCAD, SAP, MS Project, MS Office etc.

3. Manager (Mechanical) - E3 Grade (2 Posts):

Essential:

  • Minimum 60% marks from recognized University

4. Manager (Electrical) - E3 Grade (1 Post):

  • Minimum 60% marks from recognized University

Desirable:

  • Proficiency in Computer Applications: AutoCAD, SAP, MS Project, MS Office etc.

6. Manager (QC) - E3 Grade (1 Post):

  • Minimum 60% marks from recognized University

  • AND
  • (b) Diploma in Industrial Safety OR Fire Safety recognized by State Government

IMPORTANT NOTES:

  • Industrial Safety/Fire Safety diploma NOT mandatory for Degree holders in Safety Engineering/Technology
  • Year of passing diploma in Industrial Safety/Fire Safety NOT factored for post-qualification experience calculation

Desirable:

  • Proficiency in Computer Applications: SAP, MS Project, MS Office etc.

    • Ship repair OR
    • Engineering companies OR

  • 5 years as team lead or section head of shipbuilding/offshore engineering related project

  • Electrical: Electrical Outfitting/Commissioning function
  • Materials: Materials Management/Material Procurement (indigenous & import)/Stores
  • QC: Quality Control of Outfitting/Machinery/Piping/Electrical functions

Desirable:

  • Experience in ERP/SAP/AutoCAD/computerized environment

  • HSE: 3 years as section head/team lead of safety team

  • Topic: Highlighting work experience
  • Work experience assessed by selection committee
  • Based on documents submitted + presentation
  • Further shortlisting for Group Discussion & Interview

Stage 3: Group Discussion

  • Only candidates meeting notified work experience and job requirements permitted

Stage 4: Personal Interview

  • Final assessment stage

  • Phase 1 - Online Examination: Online test will consist of Objective Tests for 120 marks and Descriptive Test for 50 marks. Candidates numbering up to 3 times (approx.) of the Circle wise and Category wise vacancies will be called for interview from the top of the merit list.
