Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

Admission of a candidate to the written examination and other tests shall be provisional and based on the information furnished by her/him in the Online Application Form.
  • Online applications submitted to OSSC found to be incomplete in any respect are liable for rejection without entertaining any correspondence with the applicants on that matter.
  • If at any stage of recruitment or thereafter, it is found that any information furnished by the candidate in her/his Online Application Form is false/incorrect or the candidate has suppressed any relevant information or the candidate otherwise does not satisfy the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post, her/his candidature for the posts shall be cancelled.   • The candidates are advised to submit the Online Application Form well in advance without waiting for the closing date to avoid the last-hour rush.
  • As regards the candidates applying for more than one post/ service as per their eligibility, the Commission will make the final allotment to a post/ service on the basis of merit-cum-preference of post/ service given by the candidate. Once a post is allotted, no change of posts will be made by the Commission due to non-fulfilment of any post-specific requirements of Physical/medical/educational standards, etc. Candidates thus must ensure that they fulfil all the requirements of the posts before giving their preference/options for any post/ service.
  • The candidate has to fill/confirm in the OMR answer sheet or CBRE Screen, as the case may be, correct Roll Number and other data as required in the place(s) indicated therein and darken the appropriate circles properly in Blue or Black Ball Point Pen only in case of OMR-based examination. If the information so furnished is incomplete or different from the application form or if appropriate circle is not darkened properly, then zero marks will be awarded.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation/ re-checking of scores in the Examination. No correspondence in this regard shall be entertained.
  • Sharing of marks with the candidates: Marks obtained by an applicant in Preliminary Examination and Main Examination are proposed to be shared with her/him after final merit list is published.
  • All the posts are State Cadre posts. The candidate, on selection, may be asked to serve anywhere in Odisha.
  • If a candidate scoring more than the last selection mark at any stage of the examination is not qualified for the subsequent stage/ final selection due to any reason, he must represent to the Commission within 05 days of the declaration of the said result through e-mail [email protected].
  • Applicants who are Government servants or working under PSUs of the State Govt. or Central Govt. should obtain a “No Objection Certificate” from their controlling authority and upload the same with the Online Application form. In case a standing order of NOC is issued by any Department of Govt the same should be uploaded. At the certificate verification stage they must produce the “No Objection certificate” or “Standing order of NOC issued by the concerned Department of Govt.”. Those who are not Government Servants/working in PSUs at the time of submission of application but became Government Servants subsequently should have to submit “No Objection Certificate” or “Standing order of NOC” at the stage of certificate verification. If any candidate hides her/ his Govt. servant/PSU Employees status, and found to be a Govt. servant or a PSU Employee during Certificate Verification may not be considered for recommendation.

How to Apply

  • The applicants should go through the detail advertisement before filling up the online application form.
  • The candidate may apply for the post as per her/his eligibility as per terms of the advertisement.
  • All eligible candidates have to register themselves by clicking on "APPLY ONLINE" button on the home page of the Commission's website www.ossc.gov.in.
  • Those candidates who are applying for the first time have to register for the post by clicking on "NEW USER" button shown on the screen. On submitting the registration form a User Id and Password will be generated.
  • On clicking "New user" or "Registered User", instruction for filling up the Online Registration/ Re-registration and Application Forms shall appear on the computer screen. These instructions should be read carefully before proceeding with filling up the Application Form.
  • Step-by-step procedure for registration/ re-registration can be viewed by clicking on "Instruction to fill up Online Application Form".

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Qualification of faculties prescribed by UGC guidelines for different categories shall be allowed for selection of faculties under this arrangement.

Further, the period of active service spent on pursuing research degree simultaneously with teaching assignment without taking any kind of leave, shall be counted as teaching experience.

  • NET: 07

General Information/ Instructions

  • The applicant will be solely responsible for the authenticity of the submitted information.
  • The details regarding qualifications, experience and screening guidelines are available on the University website https://rajendrauniversity.ac.in/ along with this advertisement. The applicants are required to read these details before filling up the form.
  • Applicants should possess the prescribed qualifications and experience as on the date of submission of application as prescribed by the University for the respective posts. The posts carry the honorarium as prescribed by the Govt. of Odisha in Higher Education Department.
  • Publication 'under submission' or submitted to referees shall not be considered towards calculation of marks for publication criteria. Further, all the items for which marks are claimed should be strictly in accordance with the screening guidelines attached with the advertisement.
  • The candidates should report along with all the testimonial / certificates in original along with valid photo ID (Aadhar/Voter ID/ Driving License/Passport) and a set of self-attested photocopy of certificates/testimonials in respect to the qualifications, experience and category as applicable.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to applicants for attending interview.
  • The university reserves the right to amend the number of posts or not to fill any of the posts mentioned in the advertisement without assigning any reason thereof. Any consequential vacancies arising at the time of interview may also be filled up from the available screened candidates.
  • The applicants must NOT furnish any particulars that are false, tampered or fabricated, or suppress any material / information while submitting the application and self-certified copies/testimonials.
  • In case of any advertent mistake in the process of selection, which may be detected at any stage even after the issuance of offer letter, the University reserves right to modify / withdraw / cancel any communication made to applicants.
  • In case of any dispute that may occur in the process of selection, the decision of the University shall be final. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification.
  • Addendum / corrigendum, if any, shall be posted only on the University website.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates may appear for the walk-in-interview for temporary engagement as Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor/Guest Faculty in different departments of Rajendra University, Balangir.
  • The candidates are advised to carry all necessary documents (i.e. Academic Certificates, Mark Sheets and Experience Certificates) in original and two sets of photo-copies along with updated resume as per the format (download from the University website) and report at Hall No. 57 from 09.00 AM to 11.30 AM on 18.02.2026 (Wednesday).

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • A pass in Matriculation or its equivalent from a recognized Board and having ITI Certificate may also apply to be posted as Tech-III/Level-2 GP Rs. 1900/-
  • A pass in Matriculation or its equivalent from a recognized Board may also apply to be posted as Tech-III/Level-2 GP Rs. 1900/- subject to completion of prescribed training as per Railway Board's guidelines
  • For Level-1 (GP Rs. 1800/-): 10th Pass or ITI or equivalent OR National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT
  • No relaxation in minimum educational qualification shall be permissible
  • Candidates must mandatorily submit photocopy of relevant documents in support of their educational qualification while filling up the application form and the original of educational qualification certificate must be produced on the day of Trials

Sports Achievements

  • Applicant should be currently an active player and should have fulfilled the sports achievements on or after 01.04.2023
  • Certificates in support of the sports achievements must be submitted along with the application form
  • All championships should have been conducted under the aegis of recognized International/National/State Sports Federations and also recognized by the Railway Sports Promotion Board

Minimum Sports Norms for Level-2/Level-3 (Rs. 1,900 or Rs. 2,000)

  • Represented the Country in any of the Category-B Championships/Events OR
  • At least 3rd Position in any of the Category-C Championships/Events OR
  • At least 3rd Position in Senior/Youth/Junior National Championships OR
  • At least 3rd Position in National Games organized under aegis of Indian Olympic Association OR
  • At least 3rd Position in All India Inter University Championship organized under the aegis of Association of Indian Universities OR
  • 1st Position in Federation Cup Championships (Senior Category)

Minimum Sports Norms for Level-1 (Rs. 1,800)

  • Represented the Country in any of the Category–C Championships/events OR
  • At least 3rd position in Federation Cup Championships (Senior Category) OR
  • Represented a state or equivalent Unit, except in Marathon and Cross Country with at least 8th position in Senior National Championships only

Categorization of International Championships

  • Category-A: Olympic Games (Senior)
  • Category-B: World Cup (Junior/Youth/Senior); World Championships (Junior/Senior); Asian Games (Senior); Commonwealth Games (Senior); Youth Olympics; Davis Cup (Tennis); Champions Trophy (Hockey); Thomas/Uber Cup (Badminton)
  • Category-C: Commonwealth Championships (Junior/Senior); Asian Championships/Asia Cup (Junior/Senior); South Asian Federations Games (Senior); USIC (World Railways) Championships (Senior); World University Games

Special Note for Athletics

  • Medal winning performance in National Inter State Senior Athletics Championship may also be considered for recruitment against the post having Grade Pay -1900/-
  • Gold Medal winner in Open National Championship (Senior), Inter-State Athletics Championship (Senior) and Asian Championship (Senior) may be considered in GP 2400/-/2800/-

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited from eligible Sportspersons who are Indian nationals for recruitment against Sports Quota (Open Advt.) for the year 2025-26 in East Coast Railway
  • There is no reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS communities. The candidates having the required performance in the particular sports discipline will be selected on the basis of overall merit secured irrespective of their communities
  • The notification with the application form are available in East Coast Railway website www.rrcbbs.org.in
  • Application Form should be made on a good quality white A-4 (210x297 mm) size paper using ONE SIDE ONLY
  • The candidate has to fill up required information in his/her own handwriting using blue/black ball point pen
  • The application should be filled either in English or Hindi but not in any other language
  • One recent passport size photograph (4cm x 5cm) should be affixed on the application form without fail
  • One loose extra photograph with name, date of birth, and signature of the candidate written on the backside should be attached along with the application form

How to Apply

  • Fill the application form carefully in your own handwriting using blue/black ball point pen
  • The application should be filled either in English or Hindi only
  • Affix one recent passport size photograph (4cm x 5cm) on the application form
  • Attach one loose extra photograph with name, date of birth, and signature written on the backside
  • Provide two marks of physical identification and two left thumb impressions (LTI) clearly in the application form

  • Write on the top of the envelope: "Application against Sports Quota (Open Advertisement) recruitment for the year 2025-26"

  • Selected candidates will have to undergo medical examination and found fit for the medical classification prescribed for the post for which, he/she is being considered.

General Information/Instructions

  • The above posts are open to all candidates in possession of the notified qualification of education, age etc. The candidates who belong to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen categories are extended relaxation in upper age limit as admissible in general open market recruitments.
  • The Administration reserves the right of allotment of posts in any cadre to the selected candidates according to its requirement irrespective of the qualification of the candidates.
  • The decision of the Administration is final and request for change of post /trade at a later date will not be entertained.
  • Educational Boards / Schools set up by the Council of Boards of School Education (COBSE) is not recognized one, as per Railway Board's letter No. RBE No.114/2017 dated 31.08.2017.
  • Further, the Certificates / Degrees issued from Jharkhand State Open School, Ranchi is also not recognized one for the purpose of employment / promotion in Railways, as per Railway Board's letter No.E(NG)II/2021/RR-1/41 dated 29.09.2021.
  • List of eligible candidates will be published in the website.
  • Candidates who qualify in the Written test will be called for Document Verification/Practical demonstration.
  • Document verification will be done one day prior to the date of Practical demonstration.
  • The candidates, who are recruited against Cultural Quota, shall perform Cultural programmes in Railways, for a minimum period of 10 years, for which, they shall execute a bond.
  • All SMS communications from ICF Administration will be from PB ICF.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly check the website https://pb.icf.gov.in for updates. In case of any clarification, candidates may raise issues in the helpdesk given at https://pb.icf.gov.in/cultural_26/HELPDESK_ENTRY.PHP. No other mode of communication will be entertained. Any violation will be viewed seriously.
  • All SMS communications from ICF Administration will be from PB ICF.
  • Candidates may note that submission of fake / forged documents or providing false information will lead to cancellation of candidature / termination of service without any notice at any stage i.e. Written test / Practical demonstration / Empanelment / after Appointment. Further, such candidates are liable for criminal prosecution.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification of the candidature.
  • Candidates must ensure that they must upload soft copies of the relevant Cultural, Educational Qualifications, photograph, LTI/RTI, Signature etc as required. Incomplete applications and applications uploaded without requisite documents / LTI/RTI will be summarily rejected and no correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • Mere calling for Written Test / Practical Demonstration will not be a guarantee for appointment.
  • ICF Administration has not appointed any agents or coaching centres for acting on its behalf. Beware of such persons/agencies. Recruitment is done strictly as per merit.
  • Legal issues, if any, shall fall within the territorial jurisdiction of the Central Administrative Tribunal Chennai under which this Administration is located.
  • The mobile number and E-Mail ID should not be changed by the candidates till completion of selection and administration will not be responsible for non-receipt of communication if mobile number and e-mail ID are changed in between.
  • The Railway Administration is not responsible for any delay in delivery /non-receipt of e-mail or SMS. Candidates should also check their spam e-mail folder.
  • Candidates, who are already in service of PSU/Government Organizations and are eligible for the above, should produce "No Objection Certificate" for the same from their employer at the time of Document Verification.
  • Application without paying or paying less examination fee than prescribed by this Notification will be rejected.

How to Apply

  • Facility for submission of online application will be available from 29/01/2026 to 28/02/2026 till 23:59 hrs on ICF website https://pb.icf.gov.in
  • Application will be accepted only through Online mode.
  • Candidates who wish to apply need to log on to the ICF web portal https://pb.icf.gov.in
  • Candidates should read the notification thoroughly and fill in the online application form carefully and correctly. No corrections in the application will be permitted once the application is submitted. Candidates can submit only one application, submission of multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Before filling the application form, candidates should keep ready all the relevant documents/certificates and image of recent passport size photograph (not more than 200 KB) in JPG format and to upload the photograph with clear front view of the candidate without cap and sunglasses.
  • The applicant has to sign and affix LTU/RTI (lines on finger should be clear/visible and should not be smudged) on white paper with Black Ink within a box of size 50 mm x 20 mm respectively and upload. The images should be in JPG format scanned with 100 dpi resolution, size of file should not be more than 200 KB. The scanned signature should be, either in English or Hindi, and in running hand and not in BLOCK/CAPITAL or disjointed letter.
  • System generated registration number is the candidate's individual Registration ID. The password to generate application printout is the Date of Birth. For login purpose, candidates should use this registration number generated. The password will be date of birth in "ddmmyyyy" format.
  • Candidates are advised to check whether the details fed by them are correct in the preview and make corrections, if any. Once application is submitted, no further corrections are permitted.
  • Candidates are NOT required to send / submit any documents including system generated application form to ICF through Post/e-mail/FAX/By hand.
  • After final submission, candidates can take a printout of the online application. They are advised to bring the printout of the online application at the time of Written Test.
  • Candidates are required to upload the following legible documents. Candidature will be rejected, in case of uploading of documents which are not clear. Decision of administration will be final. No communication will be entertained.
  • Scanned self-attested copy of Educational Qualification certificate, as prescribed in Para-2 of the notification.
  • Scanned self-attested copy of essential minimum prescribed Cultural qualification certificate, as prescribed in Para 3.1 to 3.3 of the notification. Candidates are advised to avoid uploading certificates other than specified norms.
  • Self-attested copy of caste / community certificate in prescribed format issued by the competent authority for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates.
  • Self-attested copy of discharge certificate for Ex-servicemen candidates.
  • Any certificate, photograph etc. sent separately after uploading of Application Form will not be entertained.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Secondary School Examination (SSE) pass certificate of 10th standard with passing marks in Mathematics and English conducted by any recognized Board of School Education by the Government of India, State Governments, or Union Territories in India.

Essential Qualifications

  • Knowledge of cycling
  • Adequate means of livelihood

Desirable

  • Candidates applying for BPM posts must be able to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • Ability to work in rural areas
  • Ability to use smartphones, laptops, or computer devices

Salary/Stipend

GDS are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carry an annual increase of 3 percent, subject to fulfillment of conditions. They are also entitled to Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time.

  • Branch Postmaster (BPM): Rs. 12,000 to Rs. 29,380 per month
  • Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM): Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month
  • Dak Sevak: Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month

Additional Benefits:

  • Dearness Allowance on TRCA
  • GDS Gratuity
  • Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to National Pension System)

  • Fee Exemption for: All female applicants, SC/ST applicants, PwBD applicants, and Transwomen applicants

Payment Mode: Online payment through Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or UPI

Important: Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are advised to ensure their eligibility before making fee payment.

Selection Process

  • Applicants will be shortlisted for engagement on the basis of a system-generated merit list.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in Secondary School Examination of 10th standard, aggregated to percentage to the accuracy of 4 decimals.
  • For applicants with grades/points only, subject-wise marks will be arrived at by applying a multiplication factor of 9.5.
  • Where Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) is provided, marks will be arrived at by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5.
  • In case of tie among applicants, priority will be decided based on: DOB (older in age), followed by category order: ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, OBC trans-woman, OBC female, EWS trans-woman, EWS female, UR trans-woman, UR female, and so on.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed through SMS and email on registered mobile number and email address.
  • Physical verification of documents will be conducted by the Divisional/Unit Head of the Division/Unit where the post is notified.
  • Upon successful verification, a system-generated 'Offer of provisional engagement' will be issued immediately.
  • Candidates must complete pre-engagement formalities within 30 days from the date of offer of provisional engagement, including prescribed basic training of 3 days and arrangement of accommodation (for BPM posts).
  • Final order of engagement will be issued after receipt of verification reports from issuing authorities and antecedent reports from Police Authorities.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate. Multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited.
  • Candidates are not required to attach/upload any documents along with the application form except recent photograph and signature.
  • Applications submitted without complete data will be rejected.
  • Applicants should enter all details such as name, date of birth, father's name, and mother's name strictly as per the SSC (Class X) marksheet.
  • Applications with blurred or illegible photographs/signatures will be rejected.
  • GDS are not regular employees of the Department/Central Government. Their service conditions are governed by GDS (Conduct and Engagement) Rules, 2020.
  • GDS are required to work for a minimum of four hours and a maximum of five hours a day.
  • GDS cannot be retained beyond 65 years of age.
  • A Sevak should have another source of income besides the allowances paid by the Government for adequate means of livelihood.
  • Candidates selected as BPM are required to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsory retired from Government service/Gramin Dak Sevak in the past as a measure of penalty are barred from applying.
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement.
  • The applicant selected as GDS shall not engage in any activity with any outside agency detrimental to the business or interest of the Post Office/IPPB.
  • Past experience or service of any kind will not be considered for selection.
  • The Department will verify the authenticity of Secondary Level Marksheets through API SETU Portal/Digi Locker if available online.

How to Apply

  • Applications must be submitted in online mode only at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  • Applications received through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • The application process consists of two parts: (A) One-Time Registration (OTR) and (B) Filling of Online Application
  • Candidates must have their own active email ID and mobile number for registration.
  • Once registered, the same mobile number and email ID will not be allowed for further registrations of any other applicant.
  • Before One-Time Registration, keep ready: Mobile Number (to be verified through OTP), Email ID (to be verified through OTP), and information about Board and Year of Passing Matriculation (10th) Examination.
  • For One-Time Registration, click on "Candidate Login/Register" button, then click on "New Candidate Registration".
  • After registration, a registration number will be generated and sent to registered mobile number and email ID.
  • For submitting the application, log in using Registration Number and password.
  • Fill all details in the online application form including Personal Details, Board/Educational Details, Division selection and Post preference.
  • Upload recent photograph (JPG/JPEG format, 30 KB to 100 KB, 320×400 pixels recommended) and signature (JPG/JPEG format, 20 KB to 100 KB, 300×120 pixels recommended).
  • Preview the application before final submission.
  • Make fee payment if applicable before final submission.
  • Candidates can apply for one or more vacant posts in only one selected Division.
  • On selecting the Division, give preferences for eligible posts based on community, age, PwD status, and local languages studied.
  • If shortlisted for more than one post, only the first post in order of preference will be offered and candidature for remaining posts will be forfeited.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application well before the closing date and time.
  • The cut-off time for submission is 17:00 hours on 16/02/2026.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

  • ECHS invites applications from Ex-servicemen and Civilians to be employed as contractual employees on various appointments tenable at Polyclinics under Station Headquarters, Chennai for vacancies from 01 Apr 2026 to 30 Sep 2026.
  • Medical Specialist: MD/MS in speciality concerned/DNB with minimum 3 years’ experience in the subject concerned after Post Graduation.
  • Radiologist: PG degree in the concerned speciality in section A or B of schedule VI of the Central Health Services Regulation 1996 or 5 years’ experience after obtaining Post Graduate Diploma; DMC Registration is a must.
  • Gynaecologist: MD/MS in speciality concerned/DNB with minimum 3 years’ experience in the subject concerned after Post Graduation.
  • Medical Officer: MBBS with minimum 3 years’ experience after Internship; preferable additional qualification in Medicine/Surgery.
  • Lab Assistant: Diploma in Medical Lab Technology (DMLT)/Class-1 Lab Technician course (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience in Medical Laboratory.
  • Pharmacist: B Pharmacy or 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry & Biology and Diploma in Pharmacy with minimum 3 years’ experience as a Pharmacist.
  • Radiographer: Diploma/Class-1 Radiographer Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience.
  • Physiotherapist: Diploma/Class-1 Physiotherapy Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience as a Physiotherapist.
  • Dental Asst/Tech/Hygienist: Diploma in Dental Hygienist Course/Class-1 DH/DORA Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 3 years’ experience as Dental Hygienist in recognised Dental Laboratory/Clinic/Hospital.
  • Officer-in-Charge: Reserved for Retired Defence Officers with minimum 5 years’ experience in health care institution or managerial positions.
  • Clerk & DEO/Clerk, DEO: Graduate/Class-1 Clerical trade (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience.
  • IT Network Technician: Diploma/Certificate/Equivalent in IT Networking, Computer application with minimum 2 years’ experience.
  • Driver: Minimum passed Class-8th/Class-1 Driver MT (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience as a driver and holding a civil driving license (LMV).
  • Female Attendant: Literate with minimum 5 years’ experience in civil/Army Health institutions.
  • Safaiwala: Literate with minimum 5 years’ service.
  • Chowkidar: Education Class 8th Std or GD Trade (Armed Forces).
  • Peon: Education Class 8th Std or GD Trade (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ service.

Salary/Stipend

  • Medical Specialist, Radiologist, Gynaecologist: Rs 1,30,000/- per month; part time may also apply with gross monthly part time Rs 4670/- per day (four hours), Rs 3500/- per day (three hours), Rs 2330/- per day (two hours).
  • Medical Officer: Rs 95,000/- per month; selected candidates will undergo 10 days On the Job Training (OJT) and obtain a certificate from OIC Polyclinic before signing the contract; OJT will be unpaid but mandatory.
  • Officer-in-Charge: Rs 95,000/- per month with similar OJT requirement as specified.
  • Lab Assistant, Pharmacist, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Dental Asst/Tech/Hygienist, IT Network Technician: Rs 36,500/- per month.
  • Clerk & DEO/Clerk, DEO: Rs 29,200/- per month; RC vacancy pay scale in lieu of Peon is Rs 21,800/-.
  • Driver: Rs 25,600/- per month.
  • Female Attendant, Safaiwala, Chowkidar, Peon: Rs 21,800/- per month.

  • Officer-in-Charge: Maximum age limit for employment – 63 years.
  • Lab Assistant, Pharmacist, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Dental Asst/Tech/Hygienist: Maximum age limit for employment – 56 years.
  • Clerk & DEO/Clerk, DEO, IT Network Technician, Driver, Female Attendant, Safaiwala, Chowkidar, Peon: Maximum age limit for employment – 53 years.

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the employment notice.

Date of publication (newspaper) 10 Jan 2026

Selection Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview through SMS/email; list will also be displayed on the Notice Board.
  • An objective type written test on the relevant subject and practical tests as applicable will be conducted before interview.
  • Only those candidates meeting eligibility criteria and with completed application form, shortlisted by the Board of Officers, will be considered for interview.
  • Candidates will bring all original documents as applicable at the time of interview; no TA/DA will be admissible for attending the interview.
  • Employment of all individuals will be at the discretion of the appointing authority; changes in terms and conditions arising out of unforeseen circumstances may be made without compensation at the discretion of the appointing authority.

General Information/Instructions

  • Employment period for Ex-Servicemen would be 12 months and for others it will be 11 months, renewable for an additional period of one year/till attaining the maximum age, subject to performance and other conditions.
  • Individual application for each post as per format attached and available on www.echs.gov.in (duly affixed with passport size photo) should be submitted along with all supporting documents.
  • The application must reach Station Headquarters ECHS, Fort Saint George, Chennai - 600009 on or before the specified last date duly mentioning “Application for the post of ____” on the top of envelope; incomplete applications will be rejected.
  • Only one application is required to be submitted for a particular post for all Polyclinics.
  • Candidates earlier employed in ECHS whose services were terminated or who had resigned or are blacklisted need not apply; such applications will be rejected.
  • Computer qualified candidates will be given preference.
  • Changes to this notice, if any, will be posted on ECHS website only.
  • Those who have worked in any Empanelled Hospital must have a clear gap of one year between relinquishment of appointment in Empanelled Hospital and joining any ECHS establishment.
  • Anybody found using unfair means or creating a ruckus at the time of interview will be dealt with as per Code of Criminal Procedure Act 1973.

How to Apply

  • Download the application format from www.echs.gov.in or use the format attached with the notice; affix passport size photograph.
  • Fill individual application for each post and attach self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents as listed in the notice.
  • Send the application in duplicate in a sealed envelope duly mentioning “Application for the post of ____” on the top to OIC ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters, Fort Saint George, Chennai - 600009.
  • Ensure that the application reaches on or before the last date mentioned; applications received after the cut-off date will not be accepted.
  • Keep email and mobile number active; eligible candidates will be informed of date and time of interview through email/SMS.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Secondary School Examination (SSE) pass certificate of 10th standard with passing marks in Mathematics and English conducted by any recognized Board of School Education by the Government of India, State Governments, or Union Territories in India.
  • The applicant should have studied the local language at least up to 10th Standard from a recognized board. Post-wise local language details are given in Annexure-III.
  • Special provisions apply for engagement in Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, and Sikkim regarding local language requirements.

Essential Qualifications

  • Knowledge of computers
  • Knowledge of cycling
  • Adequate means of livelihood

Desirable

  • Candidates applying for BPM posts must be able to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • Ability to work in rural areas
  • Ability to use smartphones, laptops, or computer devices

Salary/Stipend

GDS are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carry an annual increase of 3 percent, subject to fulfillment of conditions. They are also entitled to Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time.

  • Branch Postmaster (BPM): Rs. 12,000 to Rs. 29,380 per month
  • Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM): Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month
  • Dak Sevak: Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month

Additional Benefits:

  • Dearness Allowance on TRCA
  • GDS Gratuity
  • Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to National Pension System)

Age Limit (as on 16/02/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years

Age Relaxation

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST (Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe) 5 years
OBC (Other Backward Classes) 3 years
EWS (Economically Weaker Sections) No relaxation
PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) 10 years
PwBD + OBC 13 years
PwBD + SC/ST 15 years

Note: Age will be determined as on the last date of submission of applications (16/02/2026).

Application Fee

  • General/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 100 (Rupees One Hundred only)
  • Fee Exemption for: All female applicants, SC/ST applicants, PwBD applicants, and Transwomen applicants

Payment Mode: Online payment through Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or UPI

Important: Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are advised to ensure their eligibility before making fee payment.

Important Dates

Activity Start Date End Date
Notification Date 28/01/2026
Online One-Time Registration 31/01/2026 14/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Submission of Online Applications and Fee Payment 02/02/2026 16/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Corrections in Registration/Application Forms (Edit/Correction Window) 18/02/2026 19/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Physical Verification of Documents Within 15 days from date of shortlisting
Joining Formalities Within 30 days from offer of provisional engagement
Process of Engagement Closes 30/06/2026

Selection Process

  • Applicants will be shortlisted for engagement on the basis of a system-generated merit list.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in Secondary School Examination of 10th standard, aggregated to percentage to the accuracy of 4 decimals.
  • For applicants with grades/points only, subject-wise marks will be arrived at by applying a multiplication factor of 9.5.
  • Where Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) is provided, marks will be arrived at by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5.
  • In case of tie among applicants, priority will be decided based on: DOB (older in age), followed by category order: ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, OBC trans-woman, OBC female, EWS trans-woman, EWS female, UR trans-woman, UR female, and so on.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed through SMS and email on registered mobile number and email address.
  • Physical verification of documents will be conducted by the Divisional/Unit Head of the Division/Unit where the post is notified.
  • Upon successful verification, a system-generated 'Offer of provisional engagement' will be issued immediately.
  • Candidates must complete pre-engagement formalities within 30 days from the date of offer of provisional engagement, including prescribed basic training of 3 days and arrangement of accommodation (for BPM posts).
  • Final order of engagement will be issued after receipt of verification reports from issuing authorities and antecedent reports from Police Authorities.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate. Multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited.
  • Candidates are not required to attach/upload any documents along with the application form except recent photograph and signature.
  • Applications submitted without complete data will be rejected.
  • Applicants should enter all details such as name, date of birth, father's name, and mother's name strictly as per the SSC (Class X) marksheet.
  • Applications with blurred or illegible photographs/signatures will be rejected.
  • GDS are not regular employees of the Department/Central Government. Their service conditions are governed by GDS (Conduct and Engagement) Rules, 2020.
  • GDS are required to work for a minimum of four hours and a maximum of five hours a day.
  • GDS cannot be retained beyond 65 years of age.
  • A Sevak should have another source of income besides the allowances paid by the Government for adequate means of livelihood.
  • Candidates selected as BPM are required to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsory retired from Government service/Gramin Dak Sevak in the past as a measure of penalty are barred from applying.
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement.
  • The applicant selected as GDS shall not engage in any activity with any outside agency detrimental to the business or interest of the Post Office/IPPB.
  • Past experience or service of any kind will not be considered for selection.
  • The Department will verify the authenticity of Secondary Level Marksheets through API SETU Portal/Digi Locker if available online.

How to Apply

  • Applications must be submitted in online mode only at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  • Applications received through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • The application process consists of two parts: (A) One-Time Registration (OTR) and (B) Filling of Online Application
  • Candidates must have their own active email ID and mobile number for registration.
  • Once registered, the same mobile number and email ID will not be allowed for further registrations of any other applicant.
  • Before One-Time Registration, keep ready: Mobile Number (to be verified through OTP), Email ID (to be verified through OTP), and information about Board and Year of Passing Matriculation (10th) Examination.
  • For One-Time Registration, click on "Candidate Login/Register" button, then click on "New Candidate Registration".
  • After registration, a registration number will be generated and sent to registered mobile number and email ID.
  • For submitting the application, log in using Registration Number and password.
  • Fill all details in the online application form including Personal Details, Board/Educational Details, Division selection and Post preference.
  • Upload recent photograph (JPG/JPEG format, 30 KB to 100 KB, 320×400 pixels recommended) and signature (JPG/JPEG format, 20 KB to 100 KB, 300×120 pixels recommended).
  • Preview the application before final submission.
  • Make fee payment if applicable before final submission.
  • Candidates can apply for one or more vacant posts in only one selected Division.
  • On selecting the Division, give preferences for eligible posts based on community, age, PwD status, and local languages studied.
  • If shortlisted for more than one post, only the first post in order of preference will be offered and candidature for remaining posts will be forfeited.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application well before the closing date and time.
  • The cut-off time for submission is 17:00 hours on 16/02/2026.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Date of Opening of Online Application 28/01/2026
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 10/02/2026, 11:59 PM (IST)
Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification etc. 31/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited mentioned below:
    • Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) - NATS: EWBKOC000079, NAPS: E11181900005
    • Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) - NATS: WGJRAC000006, NAPS: E11182400087
    • Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) - NATS: NHRPPC000001, NAPS: E12180600006
    • Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) - NATS: STNCHC000040, NAPS: E12183300008
    • South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) - NATS: EORBBSC000001, NAPS: E02252100002
  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
  • Step 5: The candidate must use the same e-mail ID and Mobile Number used in respective NAPS/NATS Portal which must be valid for the entire apprenticeship period.
  • Step 6: There are two steps for Registration process (Part-I & Part-II) in Indian Oil Pipelines portal:
    • Part-I Registration: Candidate must fill their basic details like name, category etc. and must create their own password. After successful Part-I registration, system generated registration number is sent to their registered email id/SMS.
    • Part-II Registration: Candidates must upload their scanned photograph (Size: between 20-50 KB in JPG Format) and signature in black ink (Size: between 10-30 KB in JPG Format) and furnish educational qualification, experience details etc. and submit the same. This is the final submission process and after that candidates cannot change the details furnished.
  • Step 7: Candidates must complete the application process in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026.
  • Step 8: The candidate must mention the registration/enrolment number of NAPS/NATS Portal while applying for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Step 9: After successfully applying/registration of Online Application in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal, the candidate must take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
  • Important: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted other than what is mentioned above. Candidates to ensure that they have successfully applied for the relevant opportunity through respective NAPS/NATS Portal BEFORE applying/registration in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Applications/Registration which are incomplete or are received in any other mode/form or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria and/or those received after the last date of submission of application shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected".

General Information / Instructions

Candidates should ensure that they fill in the correct information. The candidate would be admitted to various stages of the recruitment process based on the information furnished by the candidate in his/her application. Only a summary scrutiny of the application would be made before the final stage of the recruitment process and detailed scrutiny of the eligibility of the candidate would be done only at the final stage of the recruitment process.
  • As such, the candidature of the applicant shall remain provisional till detailed scrutiny is undertaken and the candidate is found eligible in all respects. NITW would be at liberty to reject any application at any stage of the recruitment process, if the candidate is found ineligible for the post or if it comes to its notice at any stage. The decision of NITW with regard to eligibility of the candidate shall be final.
  • The mere fact that a call letter has been issued to the candidate and allowed to appear in the screening/written test/ trade test or offered the post or allowed to join, will not imply that his/her candidature has been finally cleared or that entries made by the candidate in his/her application have been accepted as true and correct. The scheme/pattern and indicative syllabus of the selection process for the posts, will be notified separately in due course of time.

All Certificates/diploma/degrees etc. in support of educational qualification mentioned in the application must be awarded by the Board/Institute/University recognized by the Government/other Statutory Bodies. All candidates, irrespective of their category may be considered against Unreserved positions, subject to fulfillment of parameters / conditions for Unreserved candidates.
