The candidate selected for the post will be on probation for one year from the date of joining as per NIT Statutes.

In case the Universities/Board, award grades/CGPA/OGPA, the same will have to be indicated in equivalent percentage of marks as per the norms adopted by that University/Board and a certificate to this effect issued by the University/Board should be submitted in the online application. In the absence of the same, the candidature will not be considered. Appointment to the post is subject to being found medically fit by the Competent Authority.
  • In addition to the Pay and allowances as applicable to the employees posted in the Institute, the incumbent would be entitled to the following facilities: a) Reimbursement of Children Education Allowance as per Central Government Rules b) Reimbursement of Medical expenses including referral to outside specialized and reputed hospitals for OP/IP for them and their dependent family members. c) Suitable institute residential accommodation in the campus, subject to availability. d) Leave Travel Concession as per Central Government Rules e) National Pension Scheme for all direct recruits, except those incumbents who are governed under the CCS (Pension) Rules, 1972, as on the date of appointment in the Institute.

The decision of the competent authority in all matters relating to the eligibility of the candidate, scaheme/mode of selection process,i.e., screening/skill/written test would be final and binding on all the candidates.

A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.

Certificate of proficiency should be submitted, wherever required, with respect to desirable qualifications.

  • 2% reservation for Outstanding Sports Person (horizontal reservation).
  • Reservation for specially abled persons is also horizontal reservation.

Important Points:

  • Candidates of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS of a State other than Rajasthan State/Union Territories shall be treated as candidates of General category.

  • No candidate having more than two children on or after 01.04.2007 shall be eligible for appointment to the service.

  • Before completing the registration, candidates should click on the Preview tab to preview and verify the entire application form.
  • After verifying all details, click on 'Complete Registration'.
  • Click on the 'Payment' tab and proceed for payment through online mode (Credit/Debit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets).

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances

Selection Process

  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview

  • The decision of the NCERT in all matters relating to selection and allotment of posts/organizations to selected candidates will be final and binding on the candidates

General Information/Instructions

  • National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) is an apex organization for Educational Research, Teacher Training and Development of Curriculum and Instructional material in school education

DRDO DLJ RA & JRF 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of fellowships for DRDO Defence Laboratory Jodhpur RA & JRF Recruitment 2026 is 12, distributed as follows:

Name of Fellowship Discipline Number of Fellowships

Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Chemistry 03
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Physics 02
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Electronics & Communication 06

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Research Associate (RA – Physics): Ph.D. in Physics or equivalent degree
    OR
    Postgraduate degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Physics with 03 years of Research/Teaching/Design & Development experience after post-graduation, with at least one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal.
  • JRF (Chemistry): Postgraduate degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Chemistry with first division and National Eligibility Test (NET) qualification conducted by CSIR-UGC (NET), MHRD (GATE) or JEST.
  • JRF (Physics): Postgraduate degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Physics with first division and National Eligibility Test (NET) qualification conducted by CSIR-UGC (NET), MHRD (GATE) or JEST.
  • JRF (Electronics & Communication): Graduate degree in professional course (B.E./B.Tech.) in Electronics & Communication in first division with NET/GATE qualification
    OR
    Postgraduate degree (M.E./M.Tech.) in professional courses in Electronics & Communication in first division at both graduate and postgraduate level.

Age Limit

  • RA: Age not exceeding 35 years as on the date of interview.
  • JRF: Age not exceeding 28 years as on the date of interview.
  • Relaxation: Up to 5 years for SC/ST/PH and 3 years for OBC candidates. Candidates must produce original caste certificate from competent authority; PH candidates must produce a medical certificate from Government Hospital/Medical Board.

Selection Process

  • Mode of selection is walk-in interview at Defence Laboratory, Jodhpur on the dates mentioned for each fellowship.
  • Candidates must report at 10:00 Hrs on the respective date of interview.
  • Candidates are required to produce original certificates/testimonials related to age, educational qualification, experience, and copies thereof at the time of interview.
  • Candidates must also produce copies of published research papers and thesis, if applicable.
  • Offer of fellowship does not confer any right for absorption in DRDO.
  • The Research Fellowship may be terminated at any time during the tenure with a prior notice of one month; fellows may also resign with one month prior notice.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the notification.

Salary/Stipend

  • Research Associate (RA): Rs. 67,000/- per month with HRA and medical facilities as per DRDO rules; duration of fellowship is 02 years.
  • Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Rs. 37,000/- per month with HRA and medical facilities as per DRDO rules; duration of fellowship is 02 years, which may be extended further and upgraded to SRF as per rules.
  • Fellowships are purely temporary and governed by DRDO guidelines; they do not guarantee any regular appointment.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Walk-in Interview – RA (Physics) & JRF (Chemistry, Physics) 25-02-2026 at 10:00 Hrs
Walk-in Interview – JRF (Electronics & Communication) 26-02-2026 at 10:00 Hrs
Reporting Venue Defence Laboratory, Dr DS Kothari Marg, Ratanada Palace, Ratanada, Jodhpur – 342011 (Rajasthan)

How To Apply

  • Eligible Indian nationals should appear directly for the walk-in interview at Defence Laboratory, Dr DS Kothari Marg, Ratanada Palace, Ratanada, Jodhpur – 342011, Rajasthan at 10:00 Hrs on the respective interview date.
  • Prepare a complete Bio-Data with a recent passport size photograph affixed on the top right corner of the first page.
  • Bring one set of self-attested copies and original documents of all degrees, academic qualification certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, and other relevant documents.
  • Carry copies of published research papers and thesis, if applicable.
  • Candidates working in Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Autonomous Bodies must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer at the time of interview.
  • No prior online application is prescribed; selection is purely through walk-in on the scheduled dates.

Instructions

  • Additional relaxations for Ex-Servicemen, Central Government Civilian Employees and existing contractual/outsourced employees of AIIMS Jodhpur as per detailed conditions in the advertisement.

Application Fee

  • Candidates (except Female/SC/ST/Persons with Benchmark Disability candidates) are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 100/- (Rupees One Hundred only).
  • Payment must be made through Online Mode only via the payment gateway of AIIMS Jodhpur; transaction/processing fee, if any, is payable to the bank by the candidate.
  • Applications without the prescribed fee will not be considered and will be summarily rejected.
  • Application fee, once remitted, shall not be refunded under any circumstances, even if the application is rejected due to ineligibility.

Start of Online Application 20 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Only Indian citizens are eligible for the posts.
  • Candidates must apply online; incomplete or late applications will not be considered.
  • Candidates shortlisted for interview on the basis of information provided in online applications will be required to send self-attested copies of documents in support of their claims when demanded.
  • The competent authority reserves the right to conduct a screening test depending upon the number of applications received for a particular post.
  • Original documents will be verified at the time of interview; candidature is liable to be cancelled if any information is found false or eligibility conditions are not met.
  • Success in the examination/selection process confers no right of appointment unless the Government is satisfied about the candidate’s suitability in all respects.
  • AIIMS Jodhpur reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process, increase or decrease vacancies and change selection criteria without assigning reasons.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications can be submitted only in online mode through the official website of AIIMS Jodhpur; candidates should keep a copy of the online application and proof of fee payment.
  • Applicants must ensure that their photograph and signature are clearly visible in the online application; unclear images will lead to rejection.
  • Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary Examination certificate will be accepted.
  • Reservation will be as per Government of India guidelines for SC, ST, OBC, EWS and PwBD candidates; valid certificates in prescribed format are mandatory.
  • OBC (NCL) certificates must be issued between 01.04.2025 and 31.03.2026 and must conform to DoPT formats; EWS certificates must be based on income of financial year 2024–2025 and issued between 01.04.2025 and 31.03.2026.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities must have disability of not less than 40% and produce disability certificate in prescribed format.
  • Candidates in Government/semi-Government/PSU service must produce No Objection Certificate at document verification and relieving certificate at the time of joining.
  • Canvassing of any kind will disqualify the candidate; candidates must not indulge in malpractices, tampering of documents or misbehavior during examinations/interviews.
  • The tenure of the contract shall be till March 2026 or until further extension as applicable; engagement is purely contractual and does not confer any right to regular appointment.
  • Either party may terminate the contract with one month’s notice or salary in lieu thereof; disciplinary violations, misconduct or non-performance may lead to termination without notice.
  • Contractual appointees must maintain confidentiality, avoid conflict of interest, and comply with CCS Conduct Rules and other institutional regulations.

How to Apply

  • Register and fill in the online application form carefully, ensuring that all eligibility conditions regarding age, qualification and experience are satisfied as on the closing date.
  • Upload recent photograph and signature in the prescribed format, ensuring they are clearly visible in the preview.
  • Pay the applicable application fee of Rs. 100/- (if not exempted) through the online payment gateway and retain the payment receipt/challan for record.
  • Submit the online application before the closing date and time; no physical copies of the application are to be sent to AIIMS Jodhpur at this stage.
  • Keep a printed copy of the online application and all supporting documents ready for submission/verification as and when called by AIIMS Jodhpur.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification for Project Research Scientist - III (Non- Medical) (Post 1): Postgraduate degree in Clinical Psychology/Cognitive & Neuroscience / Clinical Pharmacy / Psychology / Public Health / Psychiatric Social Work / Social Work / Sociology /Microbiology/Biochemistry / Chemistry with 5 years post-qualification experience. or Postgraduate degree in Clinical Psychology/Cognitive & Neuroscience / Clinical Pharmacy / Psychology / Public Health / Psychiatric Social Work / Social Work / Sociology /Microbiology/Biochemistry/ Chemistry with PhD + 2 years' post-qualification experience.
  • Desirable for Post 1: Experience in Public Health / Implementation Research with Publications in Peer-Reviewed Journals.
  • Qualification for Project Research Scientist - III (Non- Medical) (Post 2): Postgraduate degree in Clinical Psychology/Cognitive & Neuroscience / Clinical Pharmacy/Psychology/Public Health / Psychiatric Social Work/Social Work/Sociology/Microbiology / Biochemistry / Zoology /Chemistry with 3 years' post-qualification experience. or Postgraduate degree in Clinical Psychology/Cognitive & Neuroscience / Clinical Pharmacy / Psychology / Public Health/Psychiatric Social Work/Social Work / Sociology / Microbiology/ Biochemistry/Zoology/Chemistry with Ph.D.
  • Desirable for Post 2: Experience in Public Health/Implementation Research with Publications in Peer-Reviewed Journals related to Cognitive Behavioural Therapy /Depression/Anxiety
  • Qualification for Field Supervisor: Bachelor's degree in Public Health / Nursing / Life Sciences / Social Work / Allied Health Sciences. Minimum 2 years of experience in community-based health projects, preferably NCD or surveillance studies. Familiarity with field data collection using digital tools. Good communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. Willingness to travel extensively in field areas.
  • Qualification for Project Research Scientist – I (Medical): MBBS degree from a recognized university / institute.
  • Qualification for Project Technical Support – III (Post 5): A Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) degree with 3 years' post qualification experience. or A Master of Physiotherapy (MPT)
  • Desirable for Post 5: 2 Yrs Experience on Pulmonary rehabilitation of CRD patients/Community based health survey/ field work /laboratory work
  • Qualification for Project Technical Support – II: 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + 05 Years Experience in relevant subject/field Or Graduation degree in Science (BMLT/Nursing) with 2 years' experience in collection of biological samples, handling of analyzers, ELISA etc.
  • Desirable for Post 6: Community based health survey/ field work / laboratory work
  • Qualification for Project Research Scientist – II (Non-Medical): Post Graduate Degree in Public Health /Epidemiology /Biostatistics /Life Sciences/Health Sciences with three years post-qualification experience in the relevant subjects. OR Post Graduate Degree in Public Health /Epidemiology/Biostatistics/ Life Sciences/Health Sciences with a PhD in the relevant subject.
  • Desirable for Post 7: Prior experience in oral cancer / head & neck cancer / NCD research, preferably in screening or early detection programs. Experience working with Health & Wellness Centres (Ayushman Arogya Mandirs) or Community Health Officers (CHOs). Experience in training, capacity building, or IEC/BCC activities. Experience in community-based or implementation research, including field coordination and stakeholder engagement. Hands-on experience in data collection, management, and analysis using SPSS / STATA. Familiarity with public-health surveillance systems, program monitoring, and reporting. Ability to prepare technical reports, policy briefs, and scientific manuscripts.
  • Qualification for Project Technical Support- III (Post 7 ii): Graduate degree with Public Health /Epidemiology/Biostatistics/Life Sciences/Health Sciences with 3 years post-qualification experience. or Postgraduate in Public Health / Epidemiology / Biostatistics / Life Sciences/Health Sciences.
  • Desirable for Post 7 ii: Experience in oral cancer/head and neck cancer / NCD-related public-health research, preferably in screening or early detection programmes. Experience in community-based field work, including coordination with Health & Wellness Centres (Ayushman Arogya Mandirs) and Community Health Officers (CHOs). Experience in data collection, entry, and basic analysis using MS Excel / SPSS / STATA. Exposure to training, IEC/BCC activities, and community awareness programmes Familiarity with public-health reporting, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Qualification for Project Technical Support - I: Three-year Graduate degree in Life Science /Biotechnology /Microbiology / Biochemistry / Biomedical Sciences /Genetics/ Molecular Biology /Zoology/Botany with 1-year post-qualification experience in the relevant field. OR 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT or equivalent) + 2 years' experience in the relevant field.

Selection Process

  • Only eligible candidates will appear for Walk-in-interview / written test. In case of more than 30 candidates, a written test may be taken. The qualifying marks for the written test will be for SC / ST: 35% UR / OBC / EWS: 40%.
  • The candidates scoring qualifying marks may be interviewed, if written test is conducted. Generally, Up to Top 05 candidates will be shortlisted for interview appear for each position.
  • The candidates will be selected on the basis of their performance in the written test / interview subject to qualifying the skill test, wherever applicable.
  • The final merit shall be prepared on the basis of the marks of the written test and interview. In case of non-conductance of written test being less than 30 candidates, the merit shall be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the interview.

General Information/ Instructions

  • The above project positions are purely on temporary basis only.
  • Candidates, those who have rendered service in ICMR Projects / ICMR Institutes for more than three years are not eligible for this Walk-in.
  • The advertised positions are tentative without commitment for its filling. Recruitment will depend upon requirement of project and approval of the competent authority.
  • Emoluments: The rates of emoluments / stipend shown in this advertisement are project specific and may vary according to sanction of the funding agency of the Project. Payment of emoluments to the project person will depend on availability of funds from the funding agency.
  • The Director & Appointing Authority has the right to accept / reject any application without assigning any reason(s) and no correspondence in this matter will be entertained.
  • The selected candidate should work for a period of at least one month, failing which, the emoluments drawn by him / her will to be forfeited.
  • The engagement can be terminated with one-month notice from either side without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates already employed should submit a “No Objection Certificate” from their present Employer / PI at the time of Walk-in-interview / written test failing which he / she will not be allowed to appear for Interview / written test.
  • Since, the project position(s) is / are temporary; the incumbents selected will have no claim for regular appointment at ICMR-NIIRNCD or continuation of his / her services in any other project.
  • The results of the final selection will be placed on ICMR-NIIRNCD and ICMR web sites.
  • The recruited project person(s) is / are governed as per ICMR project staff recruitment guidelines and will have to give the undertakings before joining.
  • At the time of joining duty, the candidates should bring all original certificates of educational qualifications (from SSC onwards), No Objection Certificate from present employer if working in ICMR Projects (compulsory), SC / ST / OBC / EWS certificate, Experience, Aadhaar Card & PwBD Certificate (if applicable) for availing age relaxation, passport size photograph along with one set of photocopies of the certificates duly attested (can be self-attested) for verification.
  • Qualifications should be achieved from recognized Institutions / Universities only. Experience certificate should clearly state the nature of work during the period of employment with dates. Experience in the relevant discipline / field should be from a reputed institution / organization recognized by the relevant authority.
  • Age relaxation will be admissible in respect of SC / ST / OBC candidates, retrenched Government Employees, Departmental Candidates (including projects) and Ex-servicemen etc. in accordance with the instructions issued by the Central Government / DoPT / ICMR from time to time. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects will also be admissible for experienced and skilled persons. SC / ST / OBC will be given age relaxation in respect of the project positions reserved for them only and not for UR positions.
  • The conditions of reservations for EWS shall be governed by the norms of DoPT OM No. 336039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 19.01.2019 and 31.01.2019. Candidates applying in the EWS category should submit an “Income and Asset Certificate”.
  • The Director, ICMR-NIIRNCD reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of project positions or cancel the recruitment or re-advertise the project positions at any time, without assigning any reasons thereof. No correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • Date of Interview / written test may be changed due to administrative reasons. Hence, candidates are advised to check website before appearing for Interview / written test.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited from eligible candidates for project human resource positions under various projects at ICMR-NIIRNCD, Jodhpur. Applications will be received from the individuals by hand on the date of Walk-in-interview / written test as mentioned below.
  • The Candidates may download the application form from http://niirncd.icmr.org.in / https://www.icmr.gov.in.
  • Candidates are required to submit the application form duly filled along with one set of photocopies of all certificates. All the original certificates for verification must be brought failing which their candidature will not be considered.
  • After verification of the applications, the eligible candidates will attend Walk-in-interview / written test.
  • The applicants are advised to visit the websites https://www.icmr.gov.in and http://niirncd.icmr.org.in regularly for any updates and changes in the recruitment process.

17. Officers under the Central/State Governments/Universities/Recognized Research Institutes or Institute of national importance or Govt. laboratory or PSU are eligible to apply for the post through proper channel for appointment on Deputation (including Short Term Contract).

18. The print out of application duly signed in each page should be routed through proper channel and accompanied with required self attested documents and duly certified attested copies of Annual Confidential Report (ACR)/Annual Performance Assessment Report (APAR) for the last five years, Experience certificate, Vigilance Clearance Certificate from the Competent Authority. If the candidates anticipate unavoidable delay in their applications being forwarded through proper channel, they may submit advance copies of their applications alongwith self-attested copies of other credentials directly to The Deputy Registrar, Establishment Section, Prabha Bhawan, Malaviya National Institute of Technology, Jaipur, JLN Marg, Jaipur, Rajasthan-302017, India, which will be considered provisionally. Candidates will be allowed to appear for the selection process only if the applications are duly received being forwarded through proper channel by the employer. Institute shall not be responsible for any postal /courier delay.

19. Applications submitted online but not followed by sending complete hard copies will not be considered. Applications through any mode, without the online version of the application submitted through the online portal of the Institute, shall also be summarily rejected and no further correspondence will be entertained.

20. Any Vigilance/Disciplinary cases/Criminal cases should not be pending/ contemplated against the candidates working in any Government Organization. In such cases, application shall not be considered.

21. Canvassing in any form / bringing in any influence, political or otherwise will be treated as a disqualification for the post. Interim enquiries will not be entertained. If it is found at any stage that any information given in the application is incorrect / false, the candidature / appointment is liable to be cancelled / terminated.

22. The review of performance of incumbent appointed on the post of Registrar will be carried out by a Committee (to be constituted by the Board) upon completion of one year of service of the incumbent.

23. In case of any dispute/ambiguity that may occur in the process of selection, the decision of the Director MNIT Jaipur in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, conduct of examination/ interview will be final and no query or correspondence will be entertained in this connection from any individual.

24. In case of any mistake occurring inadvertently in the process of selection, which may be detected at any stage even after the issue of offer of appointment, the Institute reserves the right to withdraw /cancel / modify any communication made to the candidates.

25. Any Vigilance/ Disciplinary cases / Criminal cases should not be pending/ contemplated against the applicant in any Government Organization. In such cases, application shall not be considered. A Certificate in this regard is to be submitted by the applicant.

26. The pay and conditions of deputation of the Officer selected will be regulated in accordance with the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT), Govt. of India O.M. No.6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time and other instructions of the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India or Board of Governors of MNIT, Jaipur issued in this regard from time to time. For the meaning of deputation and short term contract, the DoPT, Govt. of India O.M. No.AB.14017/13/2013-Estt. (RR) (1349) shall be taken into reference.

27. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

28. No TA/DA or local conveyance shall be paid to the applicants called for Interview.

29. The candidates will be called for the interview on the basis of information furnished by them. The appointment will be solely subject to fulfillment of all the eligibility conditions for the advertised post.

30. All original documents will have to be produced at the time of interview for verification.

31. Pay of the selected candidate will be fixed as per the recommendations of the selection committee and subsequent approval of the Board of Governors (BoG) of the Institute. No request for higher pay/pay protection not recommended by the selection committee will be entertained before or after joining.

32. The decision of the Institute in all matters will be final. No correspondence, whatsoever, will be entertained from the candidates in connection with the process of selection/interview. Canvassing in any manner would entail disqualification of the candidature.

33. The applicants are required to visit the Institute website regularly as any subsequent corrigendum/addendum etc. shall be published on the Institute website only.

34. In case the last date of receiving the hard copy of applications falls on a holiday, then the next working day (till 5 PM only) shall be treated as last day.

35. Legal disputes, if any, with Malaviya National Institute of Technology, Jaipur will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Jaipur, Rajasthan only.

36. Helpline e-mail ID for any query related to online fee and form submission is [email protected]

  • The Assistant Registrar, Establishment Section – II, Prabha Bhawan, Malaviya National Institute of Technology, Jaipur JLN Marg, Jaipur, Rajasthan-302017, India Failing which their candidature will not be considered.
  • The envelope containing the application be super scribed as “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF REGISTRAR”.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Candidates must have passed Senior Secondary Examination (10+2) from Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer or Central Board of Secondary Education or equivalent board recognized by the Government
  • Knowledge of working in Hindi written in Devnagri script and knowledge of Rajasthan culture is required
  • Candidates who have appeared or are appearing in the final year examination of the qualifying educational qualification are also eligible to apply
  • However, they must acquire the required educational qualification before the examination date of Forester recruitment
  • Ex-servicemen with 15 years of military service holding equivalent certificate to graduation can apply by filling 'Not Applicable' in roll number field and selecting 'N' grade in result

Essential Qualifications

  • Indian citizenship or citizenship of Nepal or Bhutan
  • Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01-01-1962 with intention of permanently settling in India
  • Person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries for permanent settlement in India
  • For categories (b), (c), (d), (e) mentioned above, eligibility certificate from Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India must be submitted

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Level-8 of Pay Matrix as per 7th Pay Commission - ₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500 per month
  • During Probation Period: Monthly fixed remuneration will be paid as per Government orders
  • Probation Duration: 2 years for direct recruitment candidates
  • During probation period, only fixed remuneration will be paid, no other allowances like HRA, DA, City Compensatory Allowance, Special Pay etc. will be payable
  • After successful completion of probation, training, passing post-training examination, and being found suitable for confirmation, regular pay scale and other allowances will be payable as per rules
  • Other benefits like leave etc. during probation will be as per amended provisions of Rajasthan Service Rules

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2027)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (as on 01-01-2027)
  • Maximum Age: 40 years (as on 01-01-2027)
  • Special Relaxation: Additional relaxation of 03 years is granted to all candidates as Forester recruitment has not been conducted in the past 03 years

Age Relaxation in Maximum Age Limit

  • SC/ST/OBC/MBC Male candidates (Original residents of Rajasthan): 5 years relaxation
  • General Category Female candidates: 5 years relaxation
  • SC/ST/OBC/MBC Female candidates (Original residents of Rajasthan): 10 years relaxation
  • Ex-servicemen: 15 years relaxation as per Rajasthan Civil Services (Absorption of Ex-Servicemen) Rules, 1988. However, after relaxation, if the permissible age exceeds 50 years, the upper age limit will be 50 years. In case of direct recruitment where lower post experience is mandatory, the maximum upper age limit will be 55 years
  • NCC Cadet Instructors: Service period in NCC will be deducted from actual age, provided resultant age does not exceed prescribed maximum age limit by more than 3 years
  • Widows and Divorced Women: No age limit, subject to being less than retirement age fixed by State Government
  • Emergency Commission Officers and Short Service Commission Officers: Considered within age limit even if they have crossed prescribed age limit when appearing before Selection Board
  • Persons who returned to India from Pakistan during 1971 India-Pakistan war: No age limit
  • Age relaxations mentioned above are non-cumulative, meaning candidates can avail benefit of only one provision for age relaxation

  • After OTR completion, enter your CET (Senior Secondary) 2024 application number

  • Fill all required details carefully in the application form
  • Upload live photograph, scanned signature (in Hindi and English), and thumb impression as per guidelines
  • Upload required documents (educational certificates, category certificates, etc.) in Document Details section

  • After verification, click on Final Submit button
  • Online application number will be generated after successful submission

  • Note down application number and keep it safely

    • Master's degree from a recognized university in Hindi with English as compulsory/optional subject at graduation level (or equivalent combinations where Hindi/English is medium/compulsory/optional at graduation/post-graduation).
    • Plus 3 years experience in terminology work (translation of technical/scientific literature English ↔ Hindi) or teaching/research in Hindi/English in Central/State Govt, Autonomous bodies, Universities, or recognized institutions.
  • Desirable Qualification: Experience in conducting Hindi classes/workshops; administrative experience.
  • Job Responsibilities: Ensure compliance with Official Language Policy/Rajbhasha Act 1963 and related rules/orders in CSIR-CDRI; any other duties assigned by superiors.

Multi Tasking Staff (Post Code - B)

  • Essential Qualification: Matriculation (10th) or equivalent pass OR ITI pass (specific requirements may apply as per post).
  • Desirable Qualification: Intermediate (12th) pass.
  • Job Responsibilities (Multi-faceted non-technical duties):
    1. Office upkeep and assistance: Physical maintenance of records/files/registers, general cleaning, arranging furniture/equipment, opening/closing office on time.
    2. Filing and document handling: Moving files/documents between sections, assisting in filing, photocopying, faxing, scanning.
    3. Distribution and correspondence: Distributing internal/external dak/mail, sending parcels/letters as directed, assisting at reception.
    4. Equipment/utility tasks: Operating simple machines (photocopier/fax), assisting in equipment maintenance, proper use/storage of stationery.
    5. Assistance to officers/staff: Serving water/tea during meetings/office hours, helping seniors with daily tasks, assisting in official meetings/workshops/conferences.
    6. Other assigned duties: Any tasks within the general nature of MTS role.
  • General duties: Filing, photocopying, data entry, record maintenance/updation, handling mail/documents, general cleaning, carrying files within building, non-clerical tasks.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Hindi Officer (Group A, Gazetted): Pay Level-10 (Cell-1), Pay Scale ₹56,100 – 1,77,500; Approx. gross emoluments ₹97,452/- (including HRA, TA, DA for Class 'Y' city).
  • Multi Tasking Staff (Non-Technical Group 'C'): Pay Level-1 (Cell-1), Pay Scale ₹18,000 – 56,900; Approx. gross emoluments ₹35,393/- (including allowances).

Age Limit (as on 16 February 2026)

  • Hindi Officer: Not exceeding 35 years.
  • Multi Tasking Staff: Not exceeding 25 years.
  • Relaxations:
    • SC/ST: 5 years (where posts reserved).
    • OBC: 3 years (where posts reserved).
    • PwBD (UR): 10 years; PwBD (SC/ST): 15 years; PwBD (OBC): 13 years.
    • Ex-Servicemen: Service rendered + 3 years.
    • Widows/Divorced women/judicially separated women (not remarried): Up to 35 years (higher for reserved categories).
    • CSIR/Govt employees: Up to 40 years (general); 45 years (SC/ST).
    • Other relaxations as per GoI/DoPT/CSIR rules.
  • Minimum age to apply: 18 years.

Application Fee

  • Unreserved (UR), EWS, OBC: ₹500/- (online via Debit/Credit Card/Net Banking).
  • Women / SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen / CSIR Departmental Candidates: Exempted (Nil).

Important Dates

  • Online application start date and time: 12 January 2026, 10:00 AM
  • Last date and time for online submission: 16 February 2026, 05:30 PM (website link deactivates thereafter)

Selection Process

Hindi Officer

  • Written Examination (Objective, 300 marks, 2 hours, Hindi medium, 1/3 negative marking for wrong answers) + Interview (100 marks); Weightage 75:25.
  • Top 12 unreserved candidates (minimum 50% in written) called for interview in Lucknow.
  • Syllabus: Official Language Policy, Constitutional provisions, Presidential Orders-1960, Rajbhasha Sankalp-1968, Hindi literature/history/development, grammar/spelling, translation (Hindi↔English, technical/scientific), IT tools in Hindi, e-Governance in Hindi, general knowledge related to Hindi.

Multi Tasking Staff

  • Trade Test (qualifying) → Competitive Written Examination (CWE) – OMR/CBT based, objective, 150 questions, 450 marks (3 marks per correct), 2 hours, Class X level, bilingual (except English section), 1 mark negative for wrong answers.
  • Subjects:
    • General Intelligence & Reasoning: 25 questions (75 marks)
    • Numerical Aptitude: 25 questions (75 marks)
    • General Awareness: 50 questions (150 marks)
    • English Language: 50 questions (150 marks)
  • Final merit list based on CWE marks.

General Information / Instructions

  • Women candidates are encouraged to apply (focus on gender balance).
  • Age/qualification/category claims as on 16 February 2026.
  • Upload scanned photo, signature, certificates (caste/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD in prescribed format).
  • False claims lead to disqualification/legal action.
  • No hard copy of application to be sent.

How to Apply

  • Apply online only via the link: https://cdri.res.in (access provided in advertisement).
  • Fill form, upload documents, pay fee (if applicable).
  • Submit before deadline; keep printout for reference.

If any of these shortcoming(s) is/are detected even after the appointment, his/her services will be summarily terminated.

RLBCAU Various Positions Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Category Position/Post Total
Statutory Positions Registrar 01
Dean, College of Veterinary & Animal Science 01
Non-Teaching Assistant Registrar (Academic/Establishment) 01
Teaching – Associate Professor Associate Professor 29
Teaching – Assistant Professor Assistant Professor  43

Eligibility Criteria

  • The candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • Applicants must apply separately for each Position/Post with applicable form fee, using the prescribed online application form on the University website.
  • Qualifications for each post (Registrar, Dean, Assistant Registrar, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) are specified under “Qualifications” and “Teaching Positions” sections, including required degrees, marks, experience and, where applicable, veterinary registration.
  • For Assistant Professor (non-Veterinary disciplines): Master’s degree in relevant discipline with at least 60% marks or equivalent, with evidence of NET (ICAR-ASRB/UGC-CSIR), or Doctorate degree in relevant subject with two published research papers (NAAS rating above 4.0).
  • For Assistant Professor (Veterinary disciplines): Recognized veterinary qualification under Indian Veterinary Council Act 1984, B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks, Master’s degree in relevant Veterinary discipline with at least 60% marks and NET, or Doctorate degree with two NAAS-rated research papers.
  • Associate Professor (non-Veterinary): Doctoral degree in relevant subject including relevant basic sciences, eight years’ experience in relevant subject in specified pay bands, and contributions to research / teaching / extension evidenced by publications and innovations.
  • Associate Professor (Veterinary): Recognized veterinary qualification, B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks, Master’s in relevant Veterinary discipline with at least 55% marks, and other qualifications similar to non-veterinary disciplines (doctorate, experience, publications).
  • Registrar: Master’s degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent; at least 15 years of teaching or administrative experience in specified cadres, or 15 years of administrative experience with eight years as Deputy Registrar or equivalent.
  • Dean, College of Veterinary & Animal Science: Recognized veterinary qualification; B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks; Master’s and Doctorate degrees in relevant Veterinary disciplines; minimum 15 years of teaching/research experience with at least 5 years as Professor or equivalent; outstanding research contributions.
  • Assistant Registrar: Master’s degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade and good academic record; experience as per desirable condition for service in administration/establishment in specified grades is preferred.

Salary/Stipend

  • Statutory Positions (Registrar, Dean): Level 14 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Associate Professor: Level 13A as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Assistant Professor: Level 10A as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Assistant Registrar (Non-Teaching): Level 10 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Higher initial pay may be considered for exceptionally qualified and deserving candidates if recommended by the Selection Committee.

Age Limit 

  • Registrar: Preferably below 57 years as on last date of advertisement; tenure of 5 years or till attaining age of 62 years, whichever is earlier.
  • Dean, College of Veterinary & Animal Science: Preferably below 57 years as on last date of advertisement; tenure of 5 years or till attaining age of superannuation (65 years), whichever is earlier.
  • Assistant Registrar: Preferably below 40 years as on last date of advertisement.
  • Associate Professor (all disciplines): Preferably below 47 years as on last date of advertisement.
  • Assistant Professor (all disciplines): Preferably below 40 years as on last date of advertisement (age may be relaxed as per Section 10 of Recruitment Rules for Teaching Employees).
  • Relaxation of age and experience is available for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD and other categories as per UGC/Government of India norms and Section 10 of Recruitment Rules, with possible additional relaxation for women candidates and employees of specified institutions.

Application Fee

  • Application fee is non-refundable and must be paid through online mode only.
  • General and other candidates: Rs. 1000/- (per application form).
  • SC / ST / PwBD candidates: Rs. 500/-.
  • Women candidates are exempted from payment of prescribed fee.
  • No other means of payment (IPO/money order/DD etc.) will be accepted.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Notification (Advertisement Dated) 21.01.2026
Date of commencement of online application 22.01.2026, 10.00 AM
Last date for submission of online application 21.02.2026 till 5.00 PM
Last date for receiving printout (hard copy) of online application form with enclosures 28.02.2026 till 5.00 PM

Selection Process

  • Direct recruitment to Statutory, Teaching and Non-Teaching posts will be on the basis of merit through all India advertisement and selection by duly constituted Selection Committees.
  • Screening of applications will be done using post-wise Score-Card Guidelines (Dean, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) and/or additional criteria decided by the Screening Committee.
  • The ratio of candidates called for interview will generally not exceed 1:20 and not be less than 1:3 for each post, subject to candidates securing at least 60% marks in screening.
  • Weightage of score card and interview will be in the ratio of 70:30 for Associate Professor and above, and 80:20 for Assistant Professor.
  • The University may adopt short-listing criteria such as higher qualifications, experience or desirable qualifications to restrict the number of candidates called for interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants must apply online through the University website and additionally send hard copies (signed, with all enclosures already uploaded) by Indian postal service to the Registrar within the stipulated time.
  • The envelope of the hard copy must clearly mention “Application for the post ……………….” and “Post Code………”; applications received in any other manner will be rejected.
  • Candidates must pay the non-refundable application fee online and ensure correct contact details (phone number and email) for all communications.
  • In-service applicants and candidates on deputation/Foreign Service must submit applications through proper channel and upload/send No Objection Certificate in the prescribed format within the stipulated time.
  • The crucial date for determining age limit for each Position/Post is the last date of advertisement.
  • The University reserves the right to withdraw, increase or decrease advertised posts; to fix screening criteria; to relax age/qualifications/experience; and to draw reserve panels for future vacancies.
  • Any addendum / corrigendum / updates regarding the recruitment will be posted only on the University website; no separate postal communication will be issued.
  • Reservations and relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/EWS candidates will be as per Government of India/UGC rules, subject to submission of valid certificates in prescribed formats and dates.

How to Apply

  • Applicants must fill the online application form available on the University website: www.rlbcau.ac.in.
  • After completing the online application and uploading all required documents, candidates must take a printout of the hard copy, sign all pages and enclosures, and send it by Indian postal service to the Registrar, Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University, Gwalior Road, Jhansi – 284003.
  • The subject on the envelope should read “Application for the post ……………….” and “Post Code………” failing which the application form will be rejected.
  • Non-refundable application fee must be paid online only; proof of payment and all supporting documents (qualification, experience, category certificates, NOC where applicable) must be uploaded and enclosed.
  • Applications complete in all respects must be submitted online by 21.02.2026 (5.00 PM) and hard copies must reach the University by 28.02.2026 (5.00 PM); late applications will not be entertained.
  • Applicants are advised to read General Instructions, Special Instructions, Essential Information, Qualification details, Score-Card guidelines and all conditions carefully before filling the application form.

Post Name No of Posts Location

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Bachelor Degree in Electrical Engineering with Rolling Stock and/ or Traction background, from Government recognized University/ Institute.
  • Essential Qualification: Bachelor Degree in Electrical Engineering with Rolling Stock and/ or Traction background, from Government recognized University/ Institute.
  • Experience: Pay Scale of CDA: Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in SAG Pay scale of Rs 1,44,200-2,18,200 (Revised/level-14)/ Rs. 37400-67000+Grade Pay Rs. 10,000(Pre-revised) or higher with a total of 17 years of post qualification work experience at Group- A Gazetted/Executive Level including services put in on deputation. OR Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in Selection Grade Pay scale Rs 1,23,100-2,15,900(Revised/level-13)/ (Rs. 37400-67000+Grade Pay Rs.8,700/-) (Pre-revised) or higher for at least 03 years, with a total of 17 years of post qualification work experience at Group- A Gazetted/ Executive Level, including services put in on deputation. Pay Scale of IDA: Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in IDA pay scale of Rs.1,20,000- 2,80,000 (Revised)/Rs.51300 - 73000/- (Pre-revised) or higher with a total of 17 years of post qualification work experience at Group- A Gazetted/Executive Level including services put in on deputation. OR Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in IDA pay scale of Rs. 90,000-2,40,000/-(Revised)/ Rs. 36,600-62,000/- (Pre- Revised) or higher for at least 03 years, with a total of 17 years post qualification work experience at Group- A Gazetted/ Executive Level including services put in on deputation.
  • Essential Work Experience: The candidate should have varied experience of working in Design/Manufacturing/Construction, Operation and Maintenance of Rolling Stock, traction distribution on Railways/ Metros and should be conversant with functioning in computerized environment.
  • Desirable Work Experience: Experience of working on Electrical and Mechanical services, Metro lifts, escalators, electricity rules & renewable energy will be added advantage. Hands on knowledge on various computer applications, relating to the job is desirable.

Salary/ Stipend

  • (i) Parent pay plus deputation allowance on deputation basis.
  • (ii) Rs 1,20,000- 2,80,000/- on absorption basis.

Age Limit (as on 08-01-2026)

  • Max. 55 years

Important Dates

Notification Date 08 January 2026
Closing Date 07 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Eligible candidates would be called for interview at Lucknow & selection is on Interview basis.
  • The Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview.
  • The candidate should be free from D&AR/ Vigilance.

General Information / Instructions

  • Cutoff date for age & eligibility criteria would be reckoned as on the date of notification of vacancy.
  • Experience should be with Railway/Railway CPSEs/PSUs/Government Metro Companies/other Central/State Govt. undertakings or their instrumentalities.
  • The applicant should not only be fit in related field but should also be physically and medically fit.
  • The applicant should continue with their email address and mobile/phone number so as to reach them as and when required.
  • Applications received through proper channel and with verification of service particulars, SPE/ D&AR/ VIGILANCE clearance and enclosure of APARs will be preferred. However, a copy of application may also be sent by the applicant in advance to UPMRC. Applications received after closing date and time and incomplete applications shall not be entertained. UPMRC will not be responsible for any postal delay/ wrong delivery/ non-delivery of communication by the candidate at any stage of the recruitment process. The advance copy of the application along with all the supporting documents may be sent at the email id [email protected], however sending hard copy of the application is mandatory.
  • Payment of TA: All the candidates called for interview shall not be paid any travelling allowance by UPMRC for attending the interview.
  • All appointees are to be deemed as public servants for the purpose of the UPMRC's Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules, 2017 and such other statutes as notified by the government from time to time.
  • Candidates will be informed of the final result in due course through UPMRC website and any interim enquiries about the result are therefore, unnecessary and will not be attended to. UPMRC do not enter into correspondence with the candidates about reasons for their non-selection for interview/appointment.
  • Candidates are advised to check their e-mail (including spam) and official website of UPMRC from time to time for any information/ updates on the recruitment process.
  • Management reserves the right to cancel/postpone the entire process itself due to various administrative reasons.
  • Candidates may note that they may be posted at any of the project sites/ offices at any location of UPMRC projects during their tenure in UPMRC.
  • Vacancies are provisional and subject to increase or decrease.
  • Character & Antecedents- The success in the screening process does not confer any right to appointment unless the Corporation is satisfied after such enquiry, as may be considered necessary, that the candidate having regard to his/ her character & antecedents is suitable in all respects for appointment to the service.
  • Surety Bond- Applicable to those who will join on absorption basis and not applicable to executives who will join on deputation basis. The candidate selected for the post will have to execute Surety bond of Rs. 3,00,000/- to serve the Corporation for a minimum period of three years (exclusive of the period in which one remained in LWP or EOL) and also three months prior notice, will be required before seeking resignation from the Corporation.
  • Physical & Medical Fitness- The applicant should not only be suitable in related field, but should be physically and medically fit.
  • Probation- The selected candidate on appointment will be on probation for a period of two years (including the period of training).

How to Apply

  • The candidates should submit their application to "Advisor (HR) Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited, Administrative Building, Near Ambedkar Samajik Parivatan Sthal, Vipin Khand, Gomti nagar, Lucknow-226010" as per enclosed application form before closing date (07/02/2026).
  • The applicant should submit application through proper channel as per enclosed application form requesting their parent organization to forward their application along with NOC, D&AR and Vigilance Clearance and APARs ratings for the preceding 04 years.
  • Submission of NOC before interview is must for participating in the interview process.

  • Alternative Payment Mode: In case candidates face any issues while making the application fee payment through SBI e-Collect, they may deposit the fee using bank details: Account Name: M/S ALIMCO, Current Account Number: 10384171780, IFSC: SBIN0003962, Bank Name: State Bank of India, Branch Address: ALIMCO, G. T. Road, Naramau, Kanpur - 209217

Eligibility Criteria

  • PG Degree or equivalent in concerned specialty from Recognized University With 3 (three) years' experience after acquiring PG Degree.
  • OR
  • Minimum of 5 (Five) years' experience in the concerned specialty after acquiring PG Diploma.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Full Time Specialists: For Junior Specialist, (Level 11; 3 Yrs. Exp. post PG as per RR) Rs. 1,31,880/- plus transport allowance with DA on transport allowance as per rules. For Senior Specialist (Level 12; 5 Yrs. Exp. post PG as per RR) Rs 1,53,502/- plus transport allowance with DA on transport allowance as per rules.
  • Part Time Specialists (with no case to case): Rs. 60,000/- per month for 16 hours per week (maximum 4 hrs per day), Additional Rs. 15,000/- Charges if opt. for Emergency visit. Additional Rs. 800/- for every additional hour beyond 16 hrs/week. (The additional hour of work shall be subject to approval by MS/Dean).
  • Senior Resident- 3 Year on contract basis (Under Senior Residency Scheme): The Senior Residents will be paid in the Pay Band 3, Level-11 of Rs. 67,700.00 plus other allowances (DA, HRA, NPA, TA, etc.) as applicable under Govt. Of India. An amount of Rs. 1350/- will be deducted for S.R.s possessing only Diploma.

Age Limit

  • Full Time / Part Time Specialists Age: not to exceed 69 years as on date of Advertisement.
  • Senior Resident- 3 Year on contract basis (Under Senior Residency Scheme) Age: 45 years as on the date of Advertisement. (Age relaxation is applicable as per Govt. of India Rules)

Important Dates

Anaesthesiology/Pathology/Dermatology/Radiologist 12 February 2026
Biochemistry/ENT/Eye/Psychiatry 13 February 2026
Medicine/OBG/Orthopaedics/Accident & Emergency 17 February 2026
Surgery/Paediatrics 18 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Walk-in Interview

General Information/ Instructions

  1. The number of vacancies may be changed without any prior notice.
  2. No TA/DA will be admissible either for the 'Walk- in- interview' or for joining the post.
  3. The Competent Authority reserves the right to fill up all or not to fill up any post or cancel any vacancy /interview at any stage.
  4. The selected candidates will have to join stipulated date given in offer of appointment.
  5. The selection is subjected to the candidates providing their medical fitness Certificate issued by Medical Board at ESIC Hospital Rudrapur.
  6. Candidates must be registered with Medial Council of India before joining the post.
  7. The candidate who is in the Service should submit "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of interview.
  8. The selected candidate will have to furnish a DD/Bankers Cheque for an amount of Rs. 10,000/-(Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) drawn in favour of 'ESIC fund A/c No 1' payable at Rudrapur, towards security deposit.
  9. Candidate seeking reservation benefits for SC/ST/OBC/EWS must ensure that they are entitled to such reservations per eligibility prescribed in the Notice. They should also be in possession of the required certificates in the prescribed format in support of their claim as stipulated in this Notice. OBC candidates should ensure that they are in possession of valid OBC Certificate issued within such issued by the authority mentioned in the format.
  10. The candidate claiming reservation / age relaxation on grounds of belonging to OBC should submit the community Certificate in prescribed proforma vide Govt. Of India, Department of Personnel and Training OM No.36036/2/2013-Estt(Res). Date 30.05.2014 failing which the benefit of reservation / relaxation will not be given or their application shall be rejected and no request/correspondence will be entertained. Certificates issued in other format will not be accepted and the candidates will be treated as "General Category" for all purpose. Validity of OBC certificates issued by the Central Government in One Year from the date of issuance. So Candidate will not submit this Certificate One Year old.
  11. Those who belong to SC/ST/OBC category should produce valid caste certificate issued by the Tahsildar/Revenue Divisional Officer. OBC certificate must be as prescribed vide DoPT, Govt of India OM No. 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 15.11.1993 which should certify that the candidate do not belong to anyone of the Creamy Layers.
  12. Candidates claiming reservation under EWS category should produce their EWS certificate as prescribed vide DoPT, Govt of India OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt.(Res) dated 31.01.2019.
  13. All the candidates are directed to report in the office of the Medical Superintendent ESIC Hospital, Rudrapur, Uttarakhand as per the timing mentioned above.
  14. The decision of the selection board will be final on all aspects of selection and no further correspondence will be entertained under any circumstance.
  15. The candidates shall be governed by the relevant Rules and Regulations adopted by the ESIC in this regard.
  16. Other terms & conditions will be applicable as issued by the Competent Authority from time to time.
  17. Selected candidates will have no claim for regularization of the service in the hospital or No claim for any service benefit like, PF, Pension, Gratuity, medical Allowance, Seniority, and Promotion.
  18. Hostel accommodation/quarters/uniform will not be provided.
  19. The appointment shall not offer any right or preference for regular appointment.
  20. In case regular incumbent joins in, the appointment shall be terminated immediately. The discretion will be solely of Medical Superintendent.
  21. Available on call 24x7 if he/she is drawing/opted emergency call charges.
  22. The Specialist / SR shall be responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his supervision in his discipline.
  23. The posts are contractual and the contractual engagement may be terminated / discontinued by either side giving one-month prior notice to this effect without assigning any reason.
  24. Selected candidates will have to sign Agreement of Terms & Conditions on Rs.100/- Stamp paper to be purchased by the candidate prior to joining.
  25. In case of non-appearance of eligible candidates for SR and specialist against the advertised category, the vacancy may be filled by available qualified and eligible candidates for less than 45 days.
  26. The selected Specialist must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover the period as desired by ESIC. The policy is meant to cover the professional liability falling on them as a result of errors and omissions committed by them while rendering professional services. The minimum sum assured per annum should be- a. Rs 30 lakhs: Anaesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeons, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons etc. b. Rs 20 lakhs: for General Surgeons, Gynaecologists and Obstetricians etc. c. Rs 10 lakhs: for Physicians, Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists, Chest (Pulmonologists) etc. d. A copy of the Insurance & Premium Receipt must be submitted within 7 days from the date of engagement. Private practice will not be allowed for Senior Residents on contract.
  27. Candidates who have already worked as SR for 3 years after PG Degree/Diploma under central Residency scheme in any govt. Organization are not eligible to apply for the post of Senior Residents on contract basis under 3 Year Senior Residency Scheme.

How to Apply

  • The eligible candidates, along with their application should appear for a walk-in interview on the appointed date & time. They should also bring two recent passport size photographs along with one set of attested photocopies and originals of testimonials.

Eligibility Criteria

  • BE/B. Tech or Equivalent Degree with 60% or equivalent CGPA OR
  • ME/M. Tech/Equivalent Degree OR
  • Post Graduate Degree in Science/Computer Application or in relevant Domain with 60% or equivalent CGPA OR
  • PhD. in relevant discipline

in  Computer Science and Engineering and aligned branches - AI, data science, cybersecurity, IoT, etc., or Information Security, or Electronics & Communication Engineering or Electrical Engineering

 Age Limit and Relaxation

  • Maximum Age limit: 56 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Upper Age limit will be as specified against each post

Applicants belonging to reserved category (SC/ST/OBC) / physically challenged/Ex-servicemen could be eligible for relaxations according to the ‘Government of India’ norms.

 Government employees on payscale will be eligible for relaxation in age by 5 years including  other  age relaxations as applicable.

 The cut-off date for ascertaining the age and experience will be Last Date of submission of    application.

Candidates seeking age relaxation need to submit a copy of caste certificate when called for document verification.  

 SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/ certificate and any other valid document will be considered as proof of date of birth.

The Economically Weaker Section’s Certificate should be strictly in the format prescribed by DoPT.  The format is available on the website www.persmin.nic.in

The application of the candidates not meeting the prescribed age criteria will be reject/cancelled without any prior intimation.

Candidates belonging to OBC category (Non creamy layer) should produce the certificate issued in prescribed format.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is charged by C-DAC for applying to this advertisement.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date: 01-02-2026
  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 01-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 20-02-2026
  • Interview Dates: Will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other    forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC

How to Apply

  • Before filling the online application form, Candidates should read General Terms and Conditions carefully.
  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.
  • On filling the correct OTP, the applicant will be directed to fill in the application form. In case you have filled in an application in our previous advertisement, the applicant will receive a prefilled editable application.
  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)
  • A unique application number will be generated by the system, please note this application number for future reference and use. Candidates can take a print of the application form and keep it with them for their own records.
  • No hard copy/printed applications should be sent to C-DAC. Incomplete and defectively filled online forms shall be rejected straightway and no subsequent correspondences will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Govt. Autonomous bodies should also apply online in advance and print of the application form, duly filled and signed should be forwarded through proper channel to HRD Section, C-DAC, Bangalore.
  • Those who are not forwarding their application through proper channel are required to produce 'No objection certificate (NOC)' from their current employer at the time of interview, if called for, failing which they will not be permitted to attend the interview.
  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.
