  • PwBD Candidates (HR & Finance posts): 40% of total marks

Certificate Verification

  • Candidates who score minimum pass marks shall be shortlisted for certificate verification
  • Minimum ratio of 6 candidates against one post in order of merit/reservation
  • Only candidates who successfully complete certificate verification shall be allowed to attend Phase II

Phase-II: Group Discussion, Writing Skills and Personal Interview (40 marks)

  • Group Discussion (GD): 10 marks
  • Writing Skills: 10 marks
  • Personal Interview: 20 marks
  • Venue: CSL, Kochi

Final Selection

  • Total marks: 100 (Phase-I: 60 marks + Phase-II: 40 marks)
  • Rank lists prepared based on total marks secured in Phase I & Phase II
  • In case of tie: marks scored in discipline part of Objective test shall be basis
  • If tie persists: relative merit decided based on seniority in age

General Information/Instructions

Posting Location

  • CSL, Kochi
  • CSL Mumbai Ship Repair Unit (CMSRU), Mumbai
  • CSL Kolkata Ship Repair Unit (CKSRU), Kolkata
  • CSL AN Ship Repair Unit (CANSRU), Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands
  • Candidates liable to be transferred within different units of CSL
  • May be posted in any department or on-board ships or any units/work sites/projects in India or abroad

Service Agreement

  • Selected candidates required to execute Service Agreement to serve CSL for at least 3 years after successful completion of training
  • During training and service agreement period, application for outside employment shall not be forwarded
  • No Objection Certificate for outside employment will not be issued

Reservation Policy

  • Government of India Directives on reservation shall apply
  • EWS candidates should produce valid Income and Asset Certificate in prescribed format
  • SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer) candidates should produce valid community certificate issued by Revenue Authority not below rank of Thahsildar
  • PwBD candidates: minimum 40% disability required (for HR & Finance posts)
  • Valid Certificate of disability in prescribed format as per Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017 required

PwBD Categories Identified (HR & Finance Posts Only)

  • Low vision
  • Deaf and hard of hearing
  • One Arm, One Leg, Both Leg
  • Leprosy Cured without functional impairment
  • Dwarfism
  • Acid Attack Victims without other functional disability

Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply
  • Applicants should apply for only one post as online exams for various posts will be conducted simultaneously
  • Application once submitted shall be final - no changes allowed
  • Applicants in regular Government service should upload declaration that they have informed their employer
  • Original certificates will be verified at time of joining or at any other stage as decided by CSL
  • Biometric/photograph will be captured at time of online examination
  • No travelling allowance for objective type test
  • SC/ST/PwBD candidates appearing for certificate verification shall be reimbursed single to & fro third AC rail fare
  • Call letters shall not be sent by post - will be available for download from website
  • Candidates should frequently check CSL website for updates
  • Medical examination required at hospitals prescribed by CSL
  • CSL reserves right to increase/decrease vacancies or cancel recruitment process
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • Documents related to selection preserved for 2 years from date of publication of results
  • Legal jurisdiction: Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Ernakulam only

How to Apply

  • Visit official website www.cochinshipyard.in
  • Go to Career page CSL, Kochi
  • Click on the link for online application
  • Complete Registration phase first
  • Fill in all details correctly in the online application
  • Ensure you meet the notified requirements before applying
  • Upload required documents:
    • Certificates towards proof of age, qualification, caste, disability etc
    • Recent passport size colour photograph
    • Signature
    • Educational qualification certificates/mark sheets
    • Declaration (for Government employees as per Annexure-I)
  • Submit the application online
  • Pay application fee of ₹1,000 using online payment options (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking/Wallets/UPI)
  • Note down the unique registration number generated by the system
  • Retain soft copy/printout of online application for reference
  • Do not submit more than one application
  • Do not send application printout/certificates/fee by post
  • Submit application well in advance to avoid last minute rush
  • Last date for submission: 20 February 2026
  • Quote Registration Number for any correspondence with CSL
  • Check CSL website regularly for updates and selection schedule

Technical Support

  • For technical queries related to online application: [email protected]
  • For clarification related to advertisement and conduct of selection: [email protected]

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification for Pre School Teacher: A Pass in SSLC or its equivalent qualification and Certificate in Pre-Primary Teacher's Training Course (PPTTC).
  • Experience for Pre School Teacher: 5 years of experience in Pre-School Clinic.
  • Qualification for Development Therapist: A Degree in any subject and Post Graduate Diploma in Clinical Child Development (PGDCCD) or Diploma in Clinical Child Development (DCCD).
  • Experience for Development Therapist: 5 years of experience in New-born follow up clinics.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Pre School Teacher: Rs. 31,100/- to Rs. 66,800/-.
  • Development Therapist: Rs. 43,400/- to Rs. 91,200/-.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Upper Age Limit: 40 years

Important Dates

Start date for submitting online application 21 January 2026 (10.00 AM)
Last date for submitting online application 04 February 2026 (05.00 PM)

Selection Process

  • CMD reserves the right to determine the selection process based on requirements.
  • The selection process may include application screening, criteria-based screening, a written test, group discussion, skill test/proficiency test, an interview, or any combination of these methods.
  • Please note that only shortlisted candidates will receive intimations via email, SMS, or phone call regarding the selection process.

General Information / Instructions

  • Applicant must be citizens of India
  • The applicants are required to go through the detailed notification carefully and decide themselves about their eligibility for this recruitment before applying online.
  • CMD Kerala/CMD shall not be responsible for any discrepancy in submitting the online application.
  • Applicants must compulsorily fill-up all relevant fields of the online application.
  • Incomplete/incorrect application form will be summarily rejected. CMD Kerala/CMD under any circumstances will not entertain the information, if any, furnished by the candidate subsequently. Applicants should be careful in filling-up the application form at the time of submission. If any lapse is detected during the scrutiny, the candidature will be rejected even though he/she comes through the final stage of recruitment process or even at a later stage.
  • The applicant should not furnish any false, tampered, fabricated information or suppress any material information while filling up the application form. If the particulars furnished in the online application form do not tally with the original documents produced by the Candidate, his/her candidature will be rejected.
  • The qualification stipulated for the post must be from a recognized University/ Institute. Those applicants having qualification equivalent to any of the prescribed qualification should submit equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority and without such certificate, their applications shall not be considered.
  • In the event of any information provided by the candidates being found false or incorrect at any stage, their candidature/appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated without any notice.
  • CMD reserves the right to call for any additional documentary evidence from candidates in support of educational qualifications/experience/ other notified eligibility requirements.
  • Candidates must upload either the scanned copy of original certificate or the provisional certificate issued by a competent authority when submitting their educational qualification certificates. Uploading mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets, or statements instead of certificates will not be accepted, and such applications will be rejected.
  • Applicants should have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. CMD may send intimation to download call letters for written test/proficiency assessment/interview through the registered e-mail ID. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying online and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • The copy of the Appointment letters, Salary Certificates, pay slip etc. will not be accepted in lieu of work experience certificate. In the case of latest experience, applicants may upload an AFFIDAVIT with details of employer, designation, period, nature of job, tasks and responsibilities. Affidavit is applicable only for latest experience. Experience certificates submitted without specific information like date of joining, relieving, duties and responsibilities, signature and seal of authorised person will not be considered.
  • Enable email notifications to stay informed about updates and communications. Also, regularly check your spam or junk email folder for important messages
  • Applications with blurred/ illegible Photograph/ Signature/ ambiguous experience certificates will be rejected.
  • CMD/CMD Kerala reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason or to stop the recruitment process altogether.
  • Rights for the rules for the cut off marks/short listing in all stages of recruitment are reserved by CMD/CMD Kerala
  • The CMD/CMD Kerala reserves the right to debar any candidate for any malpractice, including for a fraudulent claim of any kind of benefit / relaxation / concession, misconduct.
  • In case of any problems faced by the candidates in filling up the online application form they may contact the HELP DESK on the phone number: 0471 2320101 ext: 237,250 between 10 am and 5 pm on working days (Monday – Friday).

How to Apply

  • The eligible candidates may apply ONLINE through the website of Centre for Management Development (www.cmd.kerala.gov.in) by satisfying themselves with terms and conditions of this recruitment.
  • Scan the latest photograph of the candidate and upload the same in the space provided in the online application[scanned image shall be less than 200KB in.JPG format only]
  • Candidate shall makes his / her signature on a white paper, scan the same and upload it in the space provided in the online application [scanned image shall be less than 50KB in .JPG format only]
  • The candidate has to scan his full signature, since the signature is proof of identity, it must be genuine and in full: initials are not sufficient. Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS is not permitted. The signature must be signed only by the candidate and may not by any other person.

Name of the Post No. of vacancies & reservation category

Eligibility Criteria

  • Marine Engineer: MOT 1st Class Motor Certificate or Marine Engineer Officer Class I Certificate issued under Merchant Shipping Act, 1958. One year post qualification experience as Chief Engineer/2nd Engineer on board a foreign going ship.
  • Superintending Engineer (Civil): Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution. Nine years experience in executive cadre in Planning/Construction/Design/Maintenance preferably of Port and Marine Structures in an Industrial/Commercial Govt. Undertaking.
  • Dy. Director (Research): Degree in Economics or Statistics or Mathematics from a recognized University/Institution. Five Years executive experience in Planning or in Collection, Compilation & Interpretation of data or in conducting field surveys, investigations etc.
  • Desirable (Dy. Director (Research)): PG Degree/Diploma in Economics or Statistics or Mathematics or Operational Research and allied subjects from a recognized University/Institution. Knowledge of computer operations.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Marine Engineer: Rs. 70000-200000
  • Superintending Engineer (Civil): Rs. 60000-180000
  • Dy. Director (Research): Rs.50000-160000
  • In addition to Basic Pay, other allowances and benefits like VDA, accommodation/HRA, Cafeteria Allowance @ 35% of Basic Pay, Encashment of Earned Leave etc. would be admissible as per rules.

Age Limit (as on 23 February 2026)

  • Marine Engineer: 40 years
  • Superintending Engineer (Civil): 40 years
  • Dy. Director (Research): 35 years
  • Age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST candidates on reserved posts.
  • Age relaxation of 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) on identified posts.
  • Employees of Major Port Authorities: Age limit up to 55 years.

Application Fee

  • Application processing fee: Rs.400/-
  • Candidates will have to bear any additional payment gateway/bank charges.

Important Dates

Online Registration & Fee Payment – Start date 21 January 2026
Online Registration & Fee Payment – Closing Date 23 February 2026 17.00 hrs

Selection Process

  • Personal Interview for final selection.
  • CoPA may conduct examination (written test objective/descriptive/both and/or Group Discussion and/or presentation) to shortlist candidates depending on number of applications.
  • Weightage: Examination 85% and Interview 15%.
  • If no examination required, shortlisting by ranking on Educational Qualification (max 30 marks) and Experience (max 55 marks), total 85 marks, followed by Personal Interview (15 marks).
  • CoPA reserves right to conduct Group Discussion and/or Presentation as part of Personal Interview (15 marks total for interview including GD/Presentation).
  • Number of candidates called for interview: 6 to 12 times vacancies if no examination; up to 3 times if examination conducted.

General Information/ Instructions

  • Number of posts is provisional/indicative. CoPA reserves right to increase/decrease vacancies or cancel recruitment.
  • Crucial date for eligibility: 23 February 2026.
  • Experience after date of passing qualifying exam only. Training/apprentice period not counted as experience.
  • Proof of experience required (appointment letter, payslips, experience certificate etc.).
  • Posts identified suitable for specific Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) categories only.
  • SC/ST candidates eligible for 5 years age relaxation on reserved posts.
  • Online application only through the portal. Multiple applications lead to rejection.
  • Candidates advised to check CoPA website regularly for updates.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify candidature.
  • Legal proceedings only in competent Courts/Forums at Cochin.

How to Apply

  • Apply online only through the application portal: https://career.itiltd.in/careers_cochin_port/login_form.php?id=MTk=
  • Online registration and fee payment available from 21 January 2026 to 23 February 2026 17.00 hrs.
  • Fill application carefully with accurate details and percentage of marks.
  • Pay Rs.400/- application processing fee through State Bank Collect (SBI Collect) using link https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm or direct link in portal.
  • Select “Cochin Port Trust” and payment category “Application Fee – Marine Engineer or Accounts Officer Gr.I”.
  • Enter Application reference No. received after basic registration, fill details, make payment, download receipt and upload in portal under “Payment details”.
  • Complete application well in advance to avoid last-minute issues.

Cochin Port Chief Mechanical Engineer 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for Cochin Port Chief Mechanical Engineer Recruitment 2026 is 1 post in Class-I cadre, to be filled by absorption through composite method from eligible officers of Major Ports, failing which by deputation and failing both by direct recruitment.

Name of Post No. of Posts Scale of Pay (Rs.)
Chief Mechanical Engineer 01 1,00,000 – 2,60,000 (upgradable to 1,20,000 – 2,80,000 after 3 years, as per RR)

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualifications (as per RR)

  • Degree or equivalent in Mechanical Engineering from a recognised University/Institution, OR
  • Degree or equivalent in Electrical/Electronics & Communication Engineering/ Naval Architecture from a recognised University/Institution, OR
  • MOT 1st Class Motor Certificate issued under Merchant Shipping Act 1958.

2. Experience (for Direct Recruitment as per RR)

  • Fifteen years’ experience in managerial capacity dealing with Mechanical/Electrical/Marine/Electronics Engineering works.
  • Out of the above, 8 years’ experience shall be in workshops undertaking maintenance of cargo handling equipments/Electrical Installations/Ship Repairs in any Major Port Trusts/Industrial/Commercial/Government Undertaking.

3. Eligibility for Absorption through Composite Method (Major Ports)

  • Officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs. 90,000 – 2,40,000 with two years’ regular service; OR
  • Officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs. 80,000 – 2,20,000 with three years’ regular service in the Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Department and Marine Department (applicable to categories of Marine Engineers only) in a Major Port.

4. Eligibility for Deputation (other than Major Ports)

  • Officers holding posts of Chief Mechanical Engineer and equivalent in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Department in the scale of pay of Rs. 1,00,000 – 2,60,000 with two years’ regular service in the grade; OR
  • Officers holding posts of Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer and equivalent in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Department in the scale of pay of Rs. 80,000 – 2,20,000 and above with five years’ regular service in the grade in Central Government/State Governments/Union Territory Administration/Public Sector Undertakings/Autonomous Bodies (other than Major Port Trusts).

5. Other Criteria

  • Selection is by merit; benchmark in overall grading in ACRs/APARs shall not be below “Very Good”.
  • The crucial date for determining qualification, experience and age shall be 13.03.2026 (as per Ministry Circular No.I-26/25/2013-PE-I dated 26.09.2019).

Age Limit

  • Upper age limit for direct recruitment: 45 years (as per Recruitment Rules table).
  • Crucial date for determining age: 13.03.2026.

Selection Process

  • Selection is by merit with overall APAR/ACR grading benchmark of “Very Good”.
  • Applications from eligible officers of Major Ports will be processed as per provisions of Recruitment Rules.
  • Composite method for absorption: eligible officers from Major Ports as specified in RR will be considered first.
  • If suitable candidates are not available under absorption, the post will be filled by deputation, and failing both by direct recruitment.

How To Apply

  • Eligible and willing officers from Major Ports who satisfy the provisions of the Recruitment Rule shall apply through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in.
  • The applicant has to register in the Online Application Portal; no application other than OAP shall be accepted.
  • A hard copy of the application filed online must be sent through proper channel in an envelope superscribing “Application for the post of Chief Mechanical Engineer in Cochin Port Authority on absorption basis”.
  • The hard copy must reach the following address on or before 13.03.2026:

Address for Submission:
The Secretary,
Cochin Port Authority,
Willingdon Island,
Cochin – 682 009, India.

  • Applications must be routed through proper channel along with required documents as listed below.

Important Dates

Event Date
Vacancy Circular Date 27/01/2026
Last Date for Receipt of Hard Copy Application 13/03/2026
Crucial Date for Determining Qualification, Experience and Age 13/03/2026
Last date for receipt of application through proper channel (advance copy condition) Within 15 days of 13/03/2026, failing which advance copy will not be considered

Instructions

  • Eligible and willing officers from Major Ports must ensure they satisfy all provisions of the Recruitment Rules for the post of Chief Mechanical Engineer.
  • A hard copy of the online application should be forwarded through proper channel with all requisite documents.
  • Applications must reach the Secretary, Cochin Port Authority, by the stipulated last date; incomplete applications or applications not submitted as per the vacancy circular will not be considered.
  • If an advance copy of application is received by the Port, the candidature will not be considered if the application through proper channel is not received within 15 days of the last date of receipt of application.
  • The veracity of University certificates and recognition of degrees of applicants shall be ensured and certified by the concerned officer of the Port.

Documents to be enclosed with hard copy application:

  • Attested copies of APARs/ACRs of the applicant for the last 5 years (01.04.2020 to 31.03.2025), attested by an Officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD on each page.
  • A statement showing year-wise availability of APARs/ACRs and grading, duly signed by Competent Authority; ‘No Report Certificate’ for any missing period may be furnished with preceding years’ APARs.
  • Attested copies of all certificates and proof of educational qualifications, present and past work experience in the respective post and pay scale.
  • No-Objection Certificate of the concerned Port.
  • An undertaking by the applicant not to withdraw his/her candidature if selected; officers withdrawing after selection by the Services Selection Committee will be liable for debarment from future selection to HOD level posts in all Major Ports for two years.
  • Certificate by Head of Office of the applicant as per Annexure-II.
  • Vigilance status of the candidate as per Annexure-III, duly signed by CVO; in case of any penalty during last 10 years, details of disciplinary case and documents to be enclosed.
  • Two recent passport size photographs in a sealed envelope.
  • Details of applicants, length of service in feeder grade posts with pay scales, final APAR gradings and eligibility position clearly indicated in the proposal.

Application Fee

Details regarding application fee are not mentioned in this vacancy circular.

Salary/Stipend

  • Scale of pay for Chief Mechanical Engineer: Rs. 1,00,000 – 2,60,000.
  • The pay scale shall be upgraded to Rs. 1,20,000 – 2,80,000 after completion of three years’ regular service in the grade with approval of the Central Government, as per Recruitment Rules.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates must possess the trade-wise qualifications listed above.
  • Qualifications must be obtained through regular full-time mode; Distance Learning, Part Time and Correspondence modes are not acceptable.
  • Candidates having higher/professional qualifications than those prescribed are not eligible to apply.

2. Apprenticeship Status

  • Candidates currently undergoing Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in any Govt./Public Sector/Private industrial establishment are NOT eligible.
  • Candidates who have already undergone Apprenticeship Training in IREL or any other organization are not eligible.

3. Age Limit

  • Minimum age: 18 years as on the last date of application.
  • Maximum age: 25 years as on the last date of application.
  • Age relaxation: SC/ST up to 5 years; OBC (NCL) up to 3 years; PWBD up to 10 years.

Age Limit

  • As on the last date of application, the candidate should be between 18 and 25 years of age.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable as per Government guidelines: SC/ST – 5 years; OBC (NCL) – 3 years; PWBD – 10 years.
  • Proof of age must be supported by Matriculation/10th certificate or Birth Certificate.

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on merit list prepared from marks scored in the specified educational qualification, subject to being found “Medically Fit” by the company’s authorised Doctor.
  • In case of tie, higher marks in the qualifying exam will be considered; if still equal, elder candidate (earlier date of birth) will be given preference.
  • Priority order for selection at Rare Earths Division:
    • Candidates belonging to Land Affected Category (if applicable, with documentary proof).
    • Candidates from peripheral villages within 10 km radius of RED and wards of serving/deceased employees of IREL.
    • Candidates from Ernakulam District.
    • Candidates from Kerala State.
    • Others.
  • Merit list candidates will be called for document verification; originals and self-attested photocopies of all required documents must be produced.
  • Shortlisted candidates must undergo medical examination and be declared “Medically Fit” before engagement.
  • Entry to RED, a highly protected area, requires submission of Police Verification Certificate from the concerned Police authorities prior to joining.
  • Final selection and department allocation within the unit are at the discretion of management; there is no obligation to offer regular employment during or after apprenticeship.

Application Fee

The advertisement does not specify any application fee for engagement of apprentices at IREL Rare Earths Division.

  2. Apply through Establishment Registration Numbers:

  4. Prepare Scanned Documents: Scan and self-attest photocopies of:
    • 10th Pass/Matriculation Certificate or Birth Certificate (proof of date of birth).
    • 10th Mark Sheet.
    • SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/Disability certificates (as applicable) in prescribed format.
    • Declaration form for OBC-NCL, if applicable.
    • All semester/year-wise mark sheets and final certificate of ITI/Diploma/Degree, as applicable to the apprentice category.
    • Nativity Certificate.
    • Aadhaar Card.
    • Proof of enrollment/registration in the respective apprenticeship portal (NATS/NAPS).
  5. Email Submission: Send the scanned copy of duly filled application form affixed with passport size photograph along with all supporting documents to [email protected].
  6. Subject Line: Mention in email subject: “APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT OF APPRENTICES AGAINST NOTIFICATION NO. IREL/RED/HRM/Apprentices Engagement/2026-27/01”.

Date Type Date

Cochin Port Reserves the right to fix qualifying cut-off marks and limit the number of candidates for shortlisting, if deemed necessary. Candidates shortlisted or scoring above the prescribed cutoff marks at this stage will be required to make a presentation before a Board of Selectors on a topic given by them, which will carry 20% weightage. Thereafter, an interview carrying the 10% weightage will be held and selection will be based on the cumulated weightage score.
  • An evaluation committee will be constituted by the Port under the Chairmanship of an appropriately high ranked officer, for selection of the functionaries. The Committee will first shortlist the applications on the basis of the criteria decided by it. Thereafter, the Committee will hold a personal interaction/interview.

  • Duration: The tenure of contract is for a period of 3 years from the date of joining, which may be extended by another 2 years based on the performance of the candidate/ necessity of engagement.
  • He/ She will be allowed to avail weekly day off, closed holidays, national holidays & Casual Leave as applicable to regular officers with prior permission of reporting HoD. Failure to report for duty will entail deduction of wages on pro-rata basis.
  • Working days/ hours would be on par with regular employee/ officer. This includes overstay beyond normal working hours in case of exigencies.
  • He/ She should not leave the headquarters without prior permission.
  • The Port will reserve the right to terminate the contract at any time on the ground of misconduct or otherwise, without any notice.
  • He/ She has to give 3 months advance notice prior to leaving the contract engagement. If he/ she leaves without notice, or without acceptance of notice of termination, the amount due i.e. consolidated pay payable will be forfeited.
  • The engagement is purely on contract basis and will not confer any right to claim regular appointment, etc.
  • He/ She cannot claim any right/ title/ interest at par with the regular employees of the Port on similar or any other post doing similar work or otherwise.
  • He/ She will be entitled for medical treatment in the Port hospital to the extent the facilities are available in house, for self only. No medical claims for treatment in any other hospital/facility will be entertained.
  • He/ She may be provided with residential quarters of the Port as per availability, upon mutual agreement, and on payment of user charges as applicable to regular employees/officers.
  • The contractual appointment will be subject to verification of antecedents by the Police. If any adverse report is received from the Police, his/her services are liable to be terminated.
  • He/ She will not be permitted to take any other assignment during the period of contract with the Port.
  • On official tour outside the headquarters, he/she will be the entitled to draw TA/DA as applicable.
  • The contractual appointment will be subject to the candidate being found medically fit, as per requirement of the Port.
  • He/ she will maintain absolute integrity and devotion to duty and will be liable for penal action for misconduct or causing loss to Port property attributable to him/her during the period of contractual engagement.
  • He/ She will be governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923, as amended from time to time and will not disclose any information/data available during their engagement to any unauthorized person(s).
  • It is advised that the Employees working in Central State Government/Semi-Govt. Autonomous Bodies/CPSEs shall get approval from their competent authority to apply. They shall be required to submit No Objection Certificate, if shortlisted.
  • The crucial date for determining the qualification and age shall be 16.02.2026 (closing date of on-line registration in the OAP). Vacancy advertised can be cancelled at the discretion of Cochin Port Authority without assigning any reasons thereof. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate(s).
  • The date and schedule of interview, if any, will be intimated to the shortlisted candidates through email ID only provided in the applications by the candidates. For any enquiries, candidates may contact the office of Secretary, Cochin Port Authority (Ph.No.0484-258-2113) or email ID provided herein during office hours (0930 hrs to 1700 hrs).
  • Candidates are advised to complete their online application process well in advance to avoid any difficulties caused due to internet traffic surges towards the closing date.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and willing candidates have to submit their applications through the online application portal (OAP) in the link mentioned below, and which is published in career page of website of Cochin Port Authority (www.cochinport.gov.in), which will be opened from 16.01.2026 Link :- https://career.itiltd.in/careers_cochin_port/login_form.php?id=MTg=
  • This online application process is the only valid method. No other application modes will be accepted.
  • Online registration on the portal will close on 16.02.2026 at 17:00 hrs. Candidates are advised to regularly check the website/ OAP for any updates regarding the selection process. Candidates are advised to keep the essential documents ready by the time of start of online registration. CoPA shall not be responsible for any omission on part of the candidates to keep themselves informed of the updates provided through the website/ portal/e-mail.
  • While applying for the post, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfills the eligibility and other norms mentioned above. In case, it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and /or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/her candidature will stand rejected. If any of the above shortcoming(s) is/are detected even after contract engagement, his/her services are liable to be terminated without any notice.
  • The mere fact that a candidate has submitted the application against the advertisement would not bestow upon him/her the right to be considered for the contract engagement.
  • Cochin Port reserves the right to shortlist the number of candidates for interview out of eligible candidates.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks.
  • Pilot: BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Air Traffic Controller (ATC): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Logistics: BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with First Class or MBA with First Class, or B.Sc/ B.Com/ B.Sc.(H) with First class along with PG Diploma in Finance / Logistics / Supply Chain Management / Material Management or MCA/ M.Sc.(H) with First Class.
  • Education: MSc/MA with minimum 60% marks in Maths/ Operational Research (with Physics in BSc) or MSc/MA with minimum 60% marks in Physics/ Applied Physics (with Maths in BSc)/ Meteorology/ Oceanography/ Atmospheric Sciences (with Physics and Maths in BSc) or BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Mechanical/ Production Engineering or BE/ B.Tech/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Computer Science Engineering/ MCA (with either Physics or Mathematics in graduation level) or BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Electrical/ Electronics and Communication/ Electronics and Instrumentation or ME/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Electronics & Communication/ Controls/ Radar and Microwave/ Optical Fibre Communication/ Digital Signal Processing/ Wireless Communication/ Laser and Electro Optics/ VLSI/ Power Systems/ Communications Systems/ Electronics & Instrumentation or ME/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Thermal/ Production Engineering/ Machine Design/ System and Controls/ Manufacturing/ Mechatronics/ Meteorology/ Oceanography/ Atmospheric Sciences (with Physics and Maths at graduation level). Candidates applying for the Education entry must have scored minimum of 60% marks in class X or class XII.
  • Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)): BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Marine Engineering, Aero Space Engineering, Metallurgy Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Automobiles Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering.
  • Submarine Tech Engineering: BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Production Engineering, Control Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Industrial Engineering & Management, Instrumentation & Control, Mechanical/Mechanical with Automation.
  • Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)): BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Power Electronics, Electronics Engineering, Tele Communication, Power Engineering.
  • Submarine Tech Electrical: BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Tele Communication, Applied Electronics and Communication (AEC).

Salary/Stipend

  • The initial gross salary of Sub Lieutenant starts from Rs 1,25,000/- (approximately) per month alongwith other allowances as applicable.
  • Pilot/ NAOO allowance of Rs 31,250/- will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of training.
  • Submarine allowance of Rs 31,250/- will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of training.
  • Submarine allowance will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of submarine training in accordance with extant rules.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2027)

  • Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007
  • Pilot: Born Between 02 Jan 2003 to 01 Jan 2008
  • Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers): Born Between 02 Jan 2003 to 01 Jan 2008
  • Air Traffic Controller (ATC): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2006
  • Logistics: Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jun 2007
  • Education: Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2006
  • Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007
  • Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007

Important Dates

Event Date
Apply Online from 24 Jan 2026
Last date for Online Application 24 Feb 2026
Course commencing Jan 2027
Inform final result to Indian Navy prior 20 Dec 2026

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting of application will be based on normalised marks obtained by the candidates in the qualifying degree. Marks obtained by the candidates in the qualifying degree will be normalised using formulae mentioned in Join Indian Navy website (URL: - https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/files/normalisation.pdf)
  • BE/ B.Tech. For candidates who have completed or are in final year of BE/ B.Tech, marks obtained upto fifth semester will be considered for SSB shortlisting.
  • Post-Graduate Degree Programme. For candidates who have completed MSc, MCA, MBA, M.Tech, marks obtained in all semesters will be considered. For candidates who are in final year, shortlisting will be based on pre-final year performance.
  • Candidates selected in the final merit list will be required to submit the proof of completing the qualifying degree with minimum 60% marks by sending an email at the address [email protected]. Candidates failing to meet the criteria will not be permitted to join the Academy.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed about their selection for SSB interview through e-mail or SMS (provided by candidates in their application form). Candidates are advised not to change their e-mail/ mobile number till selection process is over and check their inbox and spam folder periodically.
  • Change of SSB Centre for interview is not permissible under any circumstances.
  • Any correspondence regarding change of SSB dates be addressed to the call up officer of the concerned SSB on receipt of call up letter. Candidates are to download the call up letter on receiving intimation from Naval Headquarters through SMS/ email (provided by candidates in their application).
  • No compensation is admissible in case of any injury sustained as a result of tests during SSB interviews.
  • AC 3 tier rail fare is admissible for the SSB interview, if appearing for the first time for particular type of commission. Candidates are required to bring photocopy of the first page of pass book or cheque leaf where the name, A/C No. & IFSC details are mentioned, while appearing for SSB.
  • Details of SSB procedure are available on Indian Navy website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in
  • Merit list will be prepared based on SSB marks for all entries as per availability of vacancies and medical clearance for respective entry. Candidates declared fit in medical examination would be appointed as per availability of vacancies in the entry.

General Information/Instructions

  • Vacancies mentioned in para 2 are tentative and may be changed depending on availability of training slots.
  • Only one application can be filled by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, candidature will be cancelled.
  • Male Candidates shortlisted for GS(X) are also eligible to volunteer for submarine arm subject to medical fitness, vacancies and service requirements. Candidates exercising option for this branch will have to additionally indicate option for submarine specialisation while filling the online application form.
  • Eventual selection/ nomination to undergo submarine specialisation will be subject to clearing submarine medicals (after joining INA) and service requirements.
  • Submarine allowance will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of submarine training in accordance with extant rules.
  • Candidates selected under GS(X) may be nominated to undergo specialisation in RPA (after completion of training at INA), subject to medical fitness and service requirements.
  • Candidates having Government of India, Ministry of Shipping & Transport Certificate of Competency (Foreign going) either as a Second Mate, Mate or Master and born between 02 Jan 1997 to 01 Jul 2007 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Executive Branch entry (General Service) as per stipulations stated at Para 2(1).
  • Candidates having Government of India, Ministry of Shipping & Transport Certificate of Competency as 1st class Engineer and born between 02 Jan 1997 to 01 Jul 2007 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Technical Branch entry (SSC Engineering) as per stipulations stated at Para 2(7) and 2(8).
  • Candidates having valid CPL issued by DGCA (India) and born between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2008 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Pilot entry as per eligibility criteria stated at Para 2(2).
  • NCC 'C' certificate holders will be given relaxation of 5% in cut off marks towards shortlisting for SSB subject to meeting following criteria: Having NCC 'C' certificate of Naval/Army/Air Wing with minimum 'B' Grade. Not served less than two academic years in the Senior Division, Naval/Army/Air Wing of the NCC. 'C' certificate should not be dated prior to 01 Jan 2024.
  • The final selection will be subject to verification of the certificate by DG(NCC) concerned NCC unit for its validity. Candidature of individual will be cancelled at any stage of selection/ training/ post-commissioning, in case of false declaration, misinformation or concealing of information.
  • The candidate will be required to fulfil the educational qualification stipulated above before joining INA, Ezhimala by Jan 2027.
  • The candidate failing to meet stipulated educational criteria will not be permitted to join INA, Ezhimala.
  • All SSB recommended candidates would be required to inform their final result of respective degree to Indian Navy at the email ID [email protected] prior 20 Dec 2026.
  • Specified number of candidates based on service requirement, who have chosen SSC (Pilot) entry will be considered for SSB/ CPSS/ Aviation Medical Examination and are advised to check physical/ medical standards (Height, leg length etc) for this entry prior selecting this option. Remaining candidates will be considered for other preferences opted by them.
  • Candidates must indicate their preference for other branches/ cadres also, if they wish to be considered for those branches/ cadres.
  • Candidates will not be considered for branches/ cadres that they have not selected.
  • Candidates are advised to ascertain their eligibility for branches/ cadres, with respect to applicable medical standards, prior to indicating their preference.
  • No equivalent stream of BE/ B.Tech qualifications other than those mentioned in para 2(5), 2(6), 2(7), 2(8), 2(9) and 2(10) above, will be considered valid for selection process at any stage.
  • Candidates will be denied to appear SSB if any backlog in any subject is pending at the time of document verification at SSB centers.
  • Medical standards/ Relaxation in Height and Weight/ Tattoo. Please visit website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in for information. SSB recommended candidates are required to undergo medical examination as applicable to their entry. Change of medical hospital/ centre is not permissible under any circumstances.
  • Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission initially for 12 years extendable by maximum 02 years, subject to service requirement, performance, medical eligibility and willingness of candidates
  • Candidates will be inducted in the rank of Sub Lieutenant subject to clearing of induction medical examination at INA, Ezhimala post reporting.
  • Only unmarried candidates are eligible for training. Any candidate who is found to be married or marries while under training will be discharged from service and shall be liable to refund full pay and allowances drawn by him/ her and other expenditure incurred on the candidate by the Government.
  • If the officer voluntarily withdraws from initial training or resigns during the probationary period, he/ she shall be required to refund the cost of training in whole or in part, as may be determined by Govt and all money received by him/ her as pay and allowances from the Govt together with the interest on the said money calculated at the rate in force for Govt loans.
  • Probation period for all branches/cadres is two years. The probation period will commence from the date of grant of the rank of Sub Lieutenant and will terminate after two years or on completion of initial training (whichever is later). During probation the officers are liable to be discharged in case of unsatisfactory performance at any stage.
  • All officers/ cadets would be compulsorily members of the Naval Group Insurance Scheme (NGIS) as received and approved for insurance cover on contribution basis. The cover would be applicable whilst in service and post retirement as per extant regulations.
  • Mere inclusion of candidates in the Select List/Merit list does not confer upon them a vested right to appointment.
  • Candidates may also note that mere empanelment is under no circumstances be treated as final selection and is not an enforceable claim to the post applied for.
  • All vacancies are to be filled as per service requirement and as per statutory guidelines issued in this regard from time to time.
  • Please read the instructions given on the website carefully before finally submitting your online application.
  • Your candidature will be cancelled if any declaration is found wrong at any stage of selection.
  • Use/ possession of narcotics is banned. Candidate may be tested for presence of drugs in the body during SSB selection/ medical/ training and subsequently during service. If candidate is found to be using/ in-possession of narcotics during any time of selection/ medical/ training/ service, candidate would be debarred from joining the Indian Navy or be removed from service if already joined.
  • Your application is subject to subsequent scrutiny and the application can be rejected, if found INELIGIBLE/ INVALID at any point of time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are to register and fill application on Indian Navy website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in. To save time during the application submission window, candidates can fill in their details and upload documents in advance.
  • Whilst filling up the e-application, it is advisable to keep the relevant documents readily available to enable the following: Correct filling up of personal particulars. Details are to be filled up as given in the Matriculation Certificate. Fields such as e-mail address, mobile number are mandatory fields and need to be filled.
  • All relevant documents (preferably in original), marks sheets upto 5th & 7th semester for regular and integrated BE/ B.Tech courses respectively and all semesters for other degree examination, date of birth proof (as per 10th & 12th certificate), CGPA conversion formula for BE/ B.Tech, Merchant Navy certificate issued by Government of India, Ministry of Shipping and Transport, NCC 'C' certificate issued by National Cadet Corps and a recent passport size colour photograph should be scanned in original JPG/TIFF format, for attaching the same while filling up the application.
  • If any scanned document is not legible/readable for any reason, the application will be rejected. Candidates are to take print out of application and carry it while appearing for SSB interview.
  • The application once submitted will be final and no request for amendments/change will be entertained.

in  Computer Science and Engineering and aligned branches - AI, data science, cybersecurity, IoT, etc., or Information Security, or Electronics & Communication Engineering or Electrical Engineering

 Age Limit and Relaxation

  • Maximum Age limit: 56 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Upper Age limit will be as specified against each post

Applicants belonging to reserved category (SC/ST/OBC) / physically challenged/Ex-servicemen could be eligible for relaxations according to the ‘Government of India’ norms.

 Government employees on payscale will be eligible for relaxation in age by 5 years including  other  age relaxations as applicable.

 The cut-off date for ascertaining the age and experience will be Last Date of submission of    application.

Candidates seeking age relaxation need to submit a copy of caste certificate when called for document verification.  

 SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/ certificate and any other valid document will be considered as proof of date of birth.

The Economically Weaker Section’s Certificate should be strictly in the format prescribed by DoPT.  The format is available on the website www.persmin.nic.in

The application of the candidates not meeting the prescribed age criteria will be reject/cancelled without any prior intimation.

Candidates belonging to OBC category (Non creamy layer) should produce the certificate issued in prescribed format.

Application Fee

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date: 01-02-2026

  • Last Date for Apply Online: 20-02-2026
  • Interview Dates: Will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other    forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC

How to Apply

  • Before filling the online application form, Candidates should read General Terms and Conditions carefully.
  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.
  • On filling the correct OTP, the applicant will be directed to fill in the application form. In case you have filled in an application in our previous advertisement, the applicant will receive a prefilled editable application.
  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)
  • A unique application number will be generated by the system, please note this application number for future reference and use. Candidates can take a print of the application form and keep it with them for their own records.
  • No hard copy/printed applications should be sent to C-DAC. Incomplete and defectively filled online forms shall be rejected straightway and no subsequent correspondences will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Govt. Autonomous bodies should also apply online in advance and print of the application form, duly filled and signed should be forwarded through proper channel to HRD Section, C-DAC, Bangalore.
  • Those who are not forwarding their application through proper channel are required to produce 'No objection certificate (NOC)' from their current employer at the time of interview, if called for, failing which they will not be permitted to attend the interview.
  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

MRVC Project Engineer (Civil / Electrical) Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Full Time B.E./B.Tech in Civil/Electrical Engineering from recognized University/Institute with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA.
  • Essential qualifications: Candidates should have qualified in the GATE-2023/2024/2025 in Civil/Electrical respective discipline.

Salary/Stipend

  • The selected candidates will be placed in the IDA equivalent E1/40,000-140000 grade. They shall be paid Basic Pay of Rs. 40,000/-, Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Cafeteria Allowances and other allowances, medical facilities and leave as per the policy of the corporation.

Age Limit (as on 16-01-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years
  • Relaxation in Upper Age Limit : 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (NCL), subject to submission of a copy of Caste Certificate/OBC (NCL) certificate along with NCL declaration, in the format prescribed by the Govt. of India for "Appointment to Posts under Govt. of India" from a competent authority, at the time of application and interview, if called for.

Important Dates

Date Type Date
Notification Date 16.01.2026
Last Date for Submission of Application 10.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Only those candidates eligible in all respects and have qualified in the relevant GATE 2023/2024/2025 Score and have submitted their applications with all necessary documents shall only be considered for further selection process in MRVC.
  • Based on their GATE Score, candidates shall be shortlisted for document verification and personal interview on the basis of discipline-wise category-wise merit list (Not more than 5 times of vacancies).
  • In case a candidate does not appear for document verification along with original documents, his/her candidature shall be rejected.
  • Upon completion of document Verification, the candidates shall be Personally Interviewed.
  • Candidates shall obtain information about their status through the Corporation's website only.
  • Weightage to Different Parameters: GATE score (out of 100) 80%, Personal Interview 20%.
  • The qualifying percentage of marks in the personal interview is 60%.
  • In case of a tie in the total marks (GATE Score weightage + Personal Interview marks) scored between two or more candidates, following criteria will be adopted in order of sequence for deciding position in merit list: The candidate having higher score in the relevant GATE examination will be ranked higher. Where GATE scores are tied, candidates older in age shall be placed higher in the merit list. Where both GATE score and date of birth are tied, candidates with higher marks in qualifying degree shall be placed higher in the merit list.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidature of a candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of engagement process or after engagement or joining, if any information provided by the candidate is false or is found to be not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Candidates if shortlisted for document verification and Personal Interview are required to bring their valid GATE- Admit Card and GATE Score Card, Engineering Graduation Mark Sheet, Engineering Graduation Certificate, PG certificate if any, SSC Mark Sheet, Date of Birth Certificate/ID proof, SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS Certificate as the case may be, copy of the Application Form and recent Passport size photograph (photograph should match with the one pasted in the Application Form) for verification with other relevant documents at the time of document verification.
  • Photocopies of the original identification documents shall not be acceptable. Candidates will not be permitted to appear for the personal interview if original and valid photo ID proof is not presented along with the GATE Admit Card and Score Card.
  • Valid OBC-NCL/EWS certificate should be produced as per the format at Annexure II & III valid on the closing date of the application.
  • Candidates employed with Government Departments / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies have to produce NOC failing which they would not be allowed to appear for document verification.
  • Candidates must correctly enter their name, date of birth, qualification details. Applications once submitted cannot be altered. Accordingly, no request for change in applicant's data after submission of application shall be entertained.
  • MRVC reserves the right to cancel / restrict / enlarge/ modify / alter the engagement process, if need so arises, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason whatsoever.
  • Only Indian Nationals of age 18 years or above are eligible to apply for the post.
  • Before applying, the candidate should ensure that he / she fulfills the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in this advertisement.
  • Essential qualification should be recognized in India and from a recognized Institution or University.
  • Date of issuance of final mark sheet shall be taken as the date of acquiring qualification.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA/DGPA is awarded, its equivalent percentage of marks must be indicated in the application form as per norms adopted by University / Institute.
  • Percentage of marks obtained by the candidate in the bachelor's degree shall be calculated based on the practice followed by the university/institution from where the candidate has obtained the degree. In case the candidates are awarded grades/CGPA instead of marks, the conversion of grades/CGPA to percentage of marks shall be based on the procedure certified by the university/ institution from where they have obtained the bachelor's degree. In case the university/ institution does not have any scheme for converting CGPA into equivalent marks, the equivalence would be established by dividing the candidate's CGPA by the maximum possible CGPA and multiplying the result with 100.
  • Marks in Essential Qualification will not be rounded off for deciding eligibility of any candidate.
  • Mere submission of application to MRVC does not guarantee the adequacy of candidature for being considered for further selection process.
  • All information regarding this recruitment process would be made available in the career section of MRVC website only. Applicants are advised to check the website periodically for important updates. All correspondences shall be made through the registered e-mail ID only.
  • For any queries regarding this recruitment please send email to [email protected].
  • Legal jurisdiction will be Mumbai in case of any cause / dispute.

How to Apply

  • The duly filled in application as per the format at Annexure-I with following documents should be mailed to "[email protected]": GATE-2023/2024/2025 Admit Card & Score Card, Engineering Graduation Marksheet, PG Mark sheet, if any, SSC Marksheet, ID Proof (Aadhar Card/PAN Card), Experience certificate (if any), SC/ST/OBC NCL/EWS Certificate.
  • Candidates should have a valid personal email ID, which should be kept active till the completion of selection process. MRVC shall send communication calling shortlisted candidates for Document Verification etc. through e-mail only.
  • Application should be complete in all respects, and as per the prescribed format. Applications not conforming to the prescribed format and without the required documents annexed will be summarily rejected.
  • THE LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION OF APPLICATION BY MAIL IS 10.02.2026.

MRVC Project Engineer (MEP) Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Category No. of Posts
Project Engineer (MEP) UR 2

Eligibility Criteria

  • Project Engineer (MEP): BE/B.Tech (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical) with not less than 60% marks from recognised (AICTE) University.
  • Where percentage of marks is not awarded by the university but only CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA is awarded, the same shall be converted into percentage in terms of conversion norms of the university.
  • Rounding off percentage will not be acceptable for considering eligibility; e.g. 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%.
  • Minimum 2 years of post-qualification work experience in MEP in Government organization/Public Sector Undertaking or Public Limited Company as Project Engineer or equivalent as on date of issue of the vacancy notification.
  • An in-depth understanding of MEP System is crucial, including expertise in HVAC components like air distribution and renewable energy systems, electrical systems such as power distribution, and plumbing knowledge for water system, storm drains, and gas piping.
  • Knowledge of tools like AutoCAD, Revit MEP software, MATLAB, and Simulink to create precise system designs and models.
  • Experience certificate issued by Public listed company having average annual turnover of Rs 500 Crore and above in last 3 Financial years (excluding current financial year), listed on National Stock Exchange or Bombay Stock Exchange, incorporated/registered at least 5 years prior to the date of issue of experience certificate, shall also be considered, provided the experience certificate has been issued by a person authorized by the Public listed company.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: IDA Equivalent E1 grade Rs.40,000-1,40,000.
  • Basic Pay: Rs.40,000/- per month.
  • Pay and perks include Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, Cafeteria of Allowances, House Rent Allowance, Consolidated Travelling Allowance, Provident Fund (employer's share) etc.
  • Other entitlements like mobile phone, laptop, sodexo etc. are as per the policy of the corporation.
  • Pay protection will be given to candidates working in IDA E1 grade as Project Engineer or equivalent in the relevant field.
  • PF, Income Tax and any other incidental recovery will be deducted from Gross Salary as per extant rules.
  • Medical facility as per the policy of the corporation.
  • Leave: 8 days Casual Leave per annum, 2 days Restricted Holidays per annum, 10 days sick leave for six months (like Half pay leave with provision for commutation), and 12 days special leave per annum.

Age Limit

  • The upper age should not exceed 30 years as on the date of issue of Vacancy Notification (05.01.2026).

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Issue of Vacancy Notification 05/01/2026
Last Date for Submission of Application by Mail 04/02/2026
Cut-off Date for Eligibility 05/01/2026

Selection Process

  • After preliminary screening of the applications received from candidates by mail, the eligible candidates will only be called for document verification and interaction.
  • In case of more number of eligible applications received, candidates equal to 5 times the notified vacancies will only be called for document verification and interaction based on their engineering marks and experience.
  • The candidate will be interviewed by a nominated Committee, and the selection will be finalized on merit based on the performance in the interview, qualification and post qualification experience gained by the candidate.
  • The candidate must qualify with minimum 60% marks in the personal interview.
  • The decision of the Nominated Committee of MRVC shall be final and binding.
  • A panel of standby candidates over and above requirement will be maintained as per merit as decided by MRVC, and such candidates may be engaged as per requirements of MRVC projects within the validity of panel.
  • The period of contract will be initially for a period of two years, extendable on yearly basis on satisfactory performance and mutual consent, and can be renewed as a fresh contract on year-to-year basis if required.
  • The posts notified are not regular establishment posts and the candidates shall not have right to claim for permanent absorption in MRVC.

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidates must bring with them original application, original certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopy in proof of photo identity, age, caste, educational qualification along with mark sheets of all semesters of Degree and experience on the date of document verification and interaction; formula of aggregate percentage calculation of Degree (CGPA/SGPA etc.) to be attached with application.
  • Candidate should bring one character certificate from Gazetted Officers/Executives Officers for certifying that he is bearing good moral character (not older than six months).
  • Incomplete or vague educational qualification will be invalid.
  • Even after contractual agreement, if any document/certificate/information is found incorrect or false in any scrutiny or verification, then the contractual service will be immediately terminated forthwith without assigning any reason and prior notice, besides legal action.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the contract engagement process, if need so arises, without any prior notice and without assigning any reasons.
  • No train/bus fare/TA/DA shall be payable by the Corporation to the candidates for appearing document verification and interaction.
  • Selected candidate will have to pass prescribed medical examination before the contract is entered into, for fitness to perform the work awarded.
  • The selected candidates should be able to join at the project site within maximum 45 days after issuing of offer of appointment by MRVC; any deviation will be dealt with on case-to-case basis, based on the merits of the case.
  • The selected candidates will have to serve the Corporation for at least two years for which he/she should execute a Surety Bond of Rs.1 Lakh in favour of Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. on Rs.500/- stamp paper to serve the Company for two years.
  • The candidate should have sound health and before joining will have to undergo medical examination and produce the certificate of fitness for job issued by a doctor (at least MBBS).
  • The contract can be terminated on completion of last day of contract period or any extended period, on breach of any terms of contract, or on the last day of one month notice period of termination issued by either side or payment in lieu thereof.
  • Upon premature termination or expiration of contract, the contract appointee shall return to MRVC any property belonging to MRVC, tools and plants, documents, passwords or user IDs etc., and clear all advances or dues.
  • Selected candidates shall use electronic resources of MRVC in strict adherence to the policies and guidelines issued by MRVC, and misuse may result in termination of employment and legal action.

How to Apply

  • Duly filled in application should be sent to Senior Manager (HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. by email on [email protected].
  • Last date for submission of application by mail is 04.02.2026.
  • The cut-off date for eligibility is 05.01.2026.
  • Applications should be complete in all respects and strictly as per the prescribed format (Annexure-I).
  • Applications not conforming to the prescribed format or having illegible/ambiguous certificates or without certificates or incomplete will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates employed with Government Departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies have to produce NOC at the time of document verification, failing which they would not be allowed to appear for document verification.
  • Mandatory documents to be attached with the filled application include: self-attested copies of certificate in proof of qualification (as per the qualification specified in Notification), self-attested copy of Proof of Date of Birth (SSLC/SSC Certificate/Birth Certificate), self-attested copy of Photo ID proof (Aadhar/Pan Card), self-attested copy of document regarding experience, last served and others, and character certificate from Gazetted Officer/Executive Officers for certifying that he/she is bearing good moral character (not older than six months).
  • Recommended documents include: self-attested copy of employment letter issued by previous as well as present employer, self-attested copy of Form 16 issued by previous/present employer, and self-attested document indicating Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Number/PF Number.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applications are invited only from eligible and willing Officers of all Major Port Authorities possessing prescribed qualifications, experience and other conditions as per MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, 2010 (Recruitment Rules at Annexure I).
  • Absorption/deputation will be of Officers holding analogous posts or officers in feeder posts with required qualifying service and experience in a Major Port Trust as specified in the Recruitment Rules.
  • Promotion channel in the Recruitment Rules specifies promotion from Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) in the scale of pay Rs.9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade, with Degree in Civil Engineering from recognised University/Institution (or essential Diploma in Civil Engineering in specified cases).
  • Industrial/commercial/Govt. undertakings experience in planning/construction/design/maintenance, especially of Port and Marine structures, is required as per detailed Recruitment Rules extract.

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Executive Engineer (Civil) carries the pay scale of Rs.50000-160000.
  • The circular also refers to pre-revised scales of Rs.20600-46500 and Rs.10750-16750 for the post, as per earlier pay structures in the Recruitment Rules.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • The crucial date for determining eligibility is 01.01.2026 in terms of Regulation 10(2) of the MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority & Promotion) Regulations, 2010.
  • The circular and attached Recruitment Rules do not explicitly mention minimum or maximum age limits in years; eligibility is governed by service, cadre and qualification conditions as on 01.01.2026.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the circular.

Notification Date 19/01/2026
Crucial Date for Eligibility 01/01/2026 (as per Regulation 10(2) of MbPT (RS&P) Regulations, 2010)
Last Date for Receipt of Applications by Mumbai Port Authority 20/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Filling up of the posts of Executive Engineer (Civil) will be by absorption/deputation from Officers of all Major Port Authorities, in accordance with MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, 2010.
  • Applications will be forwarded by the concerned Port Authority along with Vigilance and administrative clearance, certified copies of ACRs/ APARs and required certificates, for consideration by Mumbai Port Authority.
  • The process is a selection post as per the Recruitment Rules, with scrutiny of eligibility, ACRs and vigilance status; no written test or interview details are specified in the circular text.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications must be made in the format at Annexure II and submitted through proper channel by the concerned Major Port Authority.
  • The concerned Port Authority must forward the application along with: certificate on last page of application duly completed by HoD; certified copies of ACRs for last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25) duly attested by an Officer not below Dy. HoD on each page; statement showing year-wise availability of ACRs and grading signed by Secretary/HoD; and Vigilance & administrative clearances.
  • The circular, along with Annexures, is also available on www.mumbaiport.gov.in under “People & Career/Jobs”.
  • Applicants are advised that payscale granted as financial upgradation under MACP should not be indicated as it is not regular service in the grade, as mentioned in the application form instructions.
  • Self-attested copies of certificates in support of educational and other qualifications, and documents in support of employment in organisations other than Major Port Authority, may be enclosed with the application.

How to Apply

  • Download and fill the application form in the format given at Annexure II of the circular.
  • Route the application through proper channel, ensuring the Head of Department completes the certificate on the last page of the application form.
  • Attach certified copies of ACRs for the last five years (2020-21 to 2024-25), the year-wise ACR availability and grading statement signed by Secretary/HoD, and Vigilance & administrative clearances.
  • The concerned Major Port Authority must forward the complete application and enclosures to the designated authority in Mumbai Port Authority so as to reach on or before 20.02.2026.
  • Candidates must ensure that they meet all eligibility conditions as per the MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, 2010 as on the crucial date 01.01.2026.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Academic Qualifications: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised University or any equivalent qualification recognised as such by the Central Government including Integrated Dual Degree (IDD). Candidates possessing qualifications such as Medical, Engineering, Chartered Accountant, Cost Accountant would also be eligible.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience as on 31.12.2025 as an officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank or any Regional Rural Bank as listed in Second Schedule of Reserve Bank of India.
  • Salary Requirement: Candidates having experience in Scheduled Commercial Banks other than Public Sector Banks/Regional Rural Banks shall be drawing minimum annual gross salary of Rs. 9.50 lacs for each year and shall provide documentary evidence for their annual gross salary such as Form-16/Annual Income Statement (AIS)/pay slips for last 24 months or certificate from employer.
  • Local Language: Candidates applying for vacancies of a particular Circle should be proficient (reading, writing and understanding) in any one of the specified opted local language of that Circle.
  • Exclusions: Candidates working with subsidiaries of Scheduled Commercial Banks, candidates working in SBI in clerical/supervisory cadre, employees engaged on contract basis, and candidates who have resigned from officer grade in SBI/Associate Banks will not be eligible to apply.
  • CIBIL Status: Candidates who have defaulted in repayment under any lending arrangement with Banks or NBFCs including credit card dues and have not regularised/repaid their outstanding are not eligible for appointment.
  • Character & Antecedents: Candidates against whom there is/are adverse report regarding character & antecedents, moral turpitude are not eligible to apply for the post.

  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (SC/ST): 15 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (OBC): 13 Years
