Selection Process

  • Phase 1 - Online Examination: Online test will consist of Objective Tests for 120 marks and Descriptive Test for 50 marks. The duration of objective test is 2 hours consisting of 4 Sections - English Language (30 marks, 30 minutes), Banking Knowledge (40 marks, 40 minutes), General Awareness/Economy (30 marks, 30 minutes), and Computer Aptitude (20 marks, 20 minutes). The Descriptive Test (30 minutes) will be a Test of English Language (Letter Writing & Essay) for total 50 marks.
  • Phase 2 - Screening: The Screening Committee will examine whether candidates fulfil the required eligibility criteria of experience and match the job profile submitted by candidates with the job profile of Scale-I Generalist Officer of State Bank of India. Candidates numbering up to 3 times (approx.) of the Circle wise and Category wise vacancies will be called for interview from the top of the merit list.
  • Phase 3 - Interview: Interview will consist of 50 marks. Candidates will have to score minimum qualifying marks in interview to be considered for final selection.
  • Phase 4 - Local Language Proficiency Test: Test of knowledge of specified opted local language will be conducted for provisionally selected candidates before joining the Bank. Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language will not be required to undergo the language test.
  • Final Selection: Final merit list is prepared based on normalization of marks scored in Online Test and Interview with 75:25 weightage respectively. Marks secured by candidates in Online Test (out of 170 marks) are converted to out of 75 marks and Interview scores (out of 50 marks) are converted to out of 25 marks.
  • Note: There will be no penalty for wrong answers marked in Objective Tests. Sectional marks will not be maintained for Online Examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidate will have to apply for vacancy of one Circle only. A candidate applying against vacancy of one Circle will not be eligible to apply against vacancy of any other Circle.
  • Candidature of the applicant will be considered only against the vacancies in the Circle for which he/she has applied/opted. Merit list will be drawn Circle wise and category wise.
  • Selected candidates will be posted in the Circle against whose vacancy they are selected.
  • The selected candidates will not be entitled for Inter-Circle transfer/Corporate Centre Posting/Corporate Centre Establishment Posting/Foreign Posting up to his/her promotion to SMGS-IV Grade OR 12 years of service, whichever is later.
  • On joining, the selected candidates will be designated as "Circle Based Officers" (CBOs) and will be on probation for a period of 6 months from their joining the Bank.
  • The CBOs will be subjected to continuous assessment during probation period for judging their suitability for confirmation.
  • Reservation for Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates is horizontal and will be guided by various guidelines of Government of India. Only those persons with benchmark disabilities (not less than 40% of a specified disability) would be eligible for reservation.
  • OBC category candidates should submit the OBC certificate on format prescribed by Govt. of India, having "Non-Creamy Layer (NCL)" clause issued during period 01.04.2025 to the date of interview.
  • EWS candidates are required to produce 'Income & Asset Certificate' issued based on gross annual income for the Financial Year 2024-25 and valid for the year 2025-26 at the time of interview.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi Government, Public Sector Undertakings including Nationalised Banks/RRBs are required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Bank will arrange pre-examination training (PET) in online mode for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates in consonance with the guidelines issued by Government of India.
  • Outstation candidates called for interview will be reimbursed Railway AC-III fare for the shortest route in India or actual expenses incurred (whichever is lower) from place of residence/posting to Interview venue.
  • Bank reserves right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai and Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • State Bank of India does not endorse, authorize or associate with any external coaching platform, consultancy, individual or digital channel claiming to provide guaranteed selection, influence in recruitment or insider guidance.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only from 29.01.2026 to 18.02.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates should have valid email ID and mobile no. which should be kept active till the declaration of final results.
  • Visit Bank's website https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings and open the Online Application Form available under 'Current Openings'.
  • Fill the application carefully. Once the application is filled completely, candidates should submit the data.
  • After ensuring the correctness of the particulars of the application form, candidate should pay fees through the payment gateway integrated with the application.
  • The payment can be made by using debit card/credit card/Internet Banking by providing information as asked on the screen.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, e-receipt and application form will be generated, which may be printed for record.
  • Before applying online, candidates will be required to have a scanned (digital) image of their photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, and all relevant documents (ID Proof, Date of Birth Proof, Job Profile, Resume, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificate, Form-16, Salary Slip) as per specifications.
  • Candidates should download their call letter (for Online Exam & Interview) by entering their registration number and password/date of birth from the Bank's website. No hard copy of the call letter will be sent by post.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 23/01/2026
Date of Opening of Online Application 28/01/2026
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 10/02/2026, 11:59 PM (IST)
Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification etc. 31/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited mentioned below:
    • Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) - NATS: EWBKOC000079, NAPS: E11181900005
    • Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) - NATS: WGJRAC000006, NAPS: E11182400087
    • Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) - NATS: NHRPPC000001, NAPS: E12180600006
    • Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) - NATS: STNCHC000040, NAPS: E12183300008
    • South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) - NATS: EORBBSC000001, NAPS: E02252100002
  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
  • Step 5: The candidate must use the same e-mail ID and Mobile Number used in respective NAPS/NATS Portal which must be valid for the entire apprenticeship period.
  • Step 6: There are two steps for Registration process (Part-I & Part-II) in Indian Oil Pipelines portal:
    • Part-I Registration: Candidate must fill their basic details like name, category etc. and must create their own password. After successful Part-I registration, system generated registration number is sent to their registered email id/SMS.
    • Part-II Registration: Candidates must upload their scanned photograph (Size: between 20-50 KB in JPG Format) and signature in black ink (Size: between 10-30 KB in JPG Format) and furnish educational qualification, experience details etc. and submit the same. This is the final submission process and after that candidates cannot change the details furnished.
  • Step 7: Candidates must complete the application process in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026.
  • Step 8: The candidate must mention the registration/enrolment number of NAPS/NATS Portal while applying for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Step 9: After successfully applying/registration of Online Application in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal, the candidate must take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
  • Important: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted other than what is mentioned above. Candidates to ensure that they have successfully applied for the relevant opportunity through respective NAPS/NATS Portal BEFORE applying/registration in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Applications/Registration which are incomplete or are received in any other mode/form or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria and/or those received after the last date of submission of application shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected".

  • After preliminary screening of the applications received from candidates by mail, the eligible candidate(s) will only be called for document verification and interaction.

  • The overall qualifying marks shall be minimum 60%. The candidates must qualify with minimum 60% marks in the personal interview.
  • The decision of the Nominated Committee of MRVC shall be final and binding.
  • Panel of standby candidates over and above requirement will be maintained as per merit as decided by MRVC. Such candidates may be engaged as per requirements of MRVC projects within the validity of panel. Posts notified are not regular establishment posts.

General Information/ Instructions

  • Candidate should bring one character certificate from Gazetted Officers/Executives Officers for certifying that he is bearing good moral character.

  • No train/bus fare/ TA/DA shall be payable by the Corporation to the candidates for appearing document verification and interaction.
  • The selected candidates should be able to join at the project site within maximum 45 days after issuing of offer of appointment by MRVC. Any deviation in the said policy will be dealt on case to case basis, based on the merits of the case.
  • Officials serving Govt./PSUs / Autonomous Bodies, if selected, will be allowed to join only after they are properly relieved from their parent organisation.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to terminate the contract if the contract appointee is found unsuitable, by giving one month notice or payment in lieu thereof. Similarly, the appointee will be required to give one month notice to MRVC for termination of contract.
  • The selected candidate on engagement should also attend emergencies and other calls of duties, as demanded and expected, during their day to day activities.
  • In the event the appointee is found involved in undesirable activities such as embezzlement, unlawful activities (including passing on confidential information of MRVC), unauthorized absence, in-subordination or breach of any of the terms of contract without prejudice to the right to initiate civil/criminal proceedings, the contract appointment shall be terminated.
  • Selected candidates shall use electronic resources of MRVC in strict adherence to the policies and guidelines issued by MRVC from time to time. The email account and user ID's created for official purposes shall always be used in a responsible, effective, ethical and lawful manner. Any misuse of these resources and / or putting the Corporation at risk of any liability based on such misuse shall result in termination of employment and appropriate legal action.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

  • Total CTC: Rs. 30,000/- per month (inclusive of statutory deductions) and other allowances as applicable.
  • Daily Allowance: Rs. 350/- per day for on-duty on-board in trains (100% for more than 12 hours, 70% for 6–12 hours, 30% for less than 6 hours).

  • Upper age relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST applicants.
  • Upper age relaxable by 3 years for OBC applicants.

Application Fee

Event Date & Day Venue

Walk-in Interview – Ahmedabad (Gujarat) 05-03-2026 (Thursday) 10:30 AM to 05:30 PM Institute of Hotel Management (IHM) – Ahmedabad, Bhaijipura Chokdi, PDPU Road, Airport Gandhinagar Highway, Gandhinagar, Gujarat – 382426

  • Candidates must fill the prescribed application form (attached with the notification) completely and submit it at the interview venue.

  • Selection will be based on credentials and performance in personal interview; shortlisted candidates will be placed in order of merit and offered engagement subject to verification of antecedents.
  • In addition to selected candidates, a 100% Reserve Panel will be formed.
  • Engagement is subject to medical fitness as prescribed by IRCTC.

  • This engagement is purely contractual and does not confer any right for regular/permanent employment in IRCTC.
  • Initial contract is for 2 years and may be extended by one year based on requirement and satisfactory performance; contract may be terminated by one month’s notice by either side, or without notice if performance is not satisfactory.

  • Candidates can appear for interview at any one convenient place only.

    • Original certificates and one set of attested copies of educational qualification, experience, date of birth and category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/Ex-servicemen/PwBD) as applicable.
    • Two recent passport-size photographs.
  • Submit the application form and documents at the venue for verification before the interview.
  • Attend the personal interview as per the schedule; latecomers beyond the stated time window will not be entertained.
  • Keep checking the IRCTC website (www.irctc.com) for any corrigendum/clarification including changes in date/place of interview.

Selection Process for Bombay High Court District Judge Recruitment 2026

The selection will be based on performance in the following stages:

Stage 1: Preliminary Written Examination (if conducted)

  • Multiple choice objective type questions (computer-based evaluation)
  • Purpose: Short-listing candidates for Main Written Examination
  • Candidates will be called in ratio of 1:10 of advertised vacancies
  • Marks NOT counted for final selection

  • Duration: To be announced
  • Exam Centers: Mumbai, Nagpur, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Kolhapur

Stage 2: Main Written Examination

  • Number of Papers: 2 papers

Eligibility Criteria for NABARD Development Assistant Recruitment 2026

    • Official language would be the main language declared in State gazette of concerned state

  • All educational qualifications should be from Universities/Institutions incorporated by Act of Central or State legislature or declared deemed University under Section-3 of UGC Act 1956
  • For CGPA/OGPA conversion: 6.75=60%, 6.25=55%, 5.75=50%, 5.25=45% (on 10-point scale)

Selection Process for NABARD Development Assistant Recruitment 2026

  • Stage-I: Preliminary Examination (Online) - Qualifying Nature
    • For Development Assistant:
      • Test of English Language: 40 Questions, 40 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of Numerical Ability: 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of Reasoning: 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Total: 100 Questions, 100 Marks, 60 Minutes
    • For Development Assistant (Hindi):
      • Test of English Language: 40 Questions, 40 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of Professional Knowledge (Hindi/English): 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of Reasoning: 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Total: 100 Questions, 100 Marks, 60 Minutes
    • Shortlisting ratio: Maximum 1:25 based on performance
  • Stage-II: Main Examination (Online)
    • For Development Assistant:
      • Test of Reasoning: 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 30 Minutes
      • Quantitative Aptitude: 30 Questions, 30 Marks, 30 Minutes
      • General Awareness (Agriculture, Rural Development, Banking): 50 Questions, 50 Marks, 25 Minutes
      • Computer Knowledge: 40 Questions, 40 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of English Language (Descriptive - Essay, Precis, Report/Letter): 3 Questions, 50 Marks, 30 Minutes
      • Total: 200 Marks, 135 Minutes
    • For Development Assistant (Hindi):
      • Test of Reasoning: 20 Questions, 20 Marks, 25 Minutes
      • Test of Professional Knowledge (Hindi/English): 50 Questions, 50 Marks, 35 Minutes
      • General Awareness (Agriculture, Rural Development, Banking): 40 Questions, 40 Marks, 25 Minutes
      • Computer Knowledge: 40 Questions, 40 Marks, 20 Minutes
      • Test of English Language (Descriptive): 3 Questions, 50 Marks, 30 Minutes
      • Total: 200 Marks, 135 Minutes
  • Stage-III: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) - Qualifying Nature
    • Conducted after Main Examination at Regional Office
    • Test conducted in official language of concerned State
    • Candidates who passed 10th/12th with declared language as subject are exempted (need to submit proof)
    • Candidates not qualifying LPT will not be offered appointment
  • Negative Marking:
    • 1/4th mark deducted for each wrong answer in objective tests (both phases)
  • Final Merit List:
    • State-wise merit list based on Main Examination marks only (Preliminary marks not added)
    • Both Objective Test and Descriptive Test marks of Main Exam added for final merit
  • Tie Resolution:
    • Higher educational qualification
    • If tie in qualification, higher marks in graduation
    • If tie in graduation marks, higher age preference
  • Wait List:
    • Upto 50% of vacancies (State-category wise), minimum 3 candidates
    • Valid for one year from approval date or next recruitment declaration, whichever earlier
  • Medium: Bilingual (English and Hindi) except English/Hindi language test
  • Biometric Verification: Mandatory at all stages from Main Examination onwards
  • Medical Fitness: Appointment subject to being declared medically fit as per Bank rules

General Information/Instructions

  • NABARD is wholly owned by Government of India and is equal opportunity employer
  • Candidates can apply only ONLINE through www.nabard.org
  • Candidates can apply for vacancies in one State only
  • Candidates can apply for only one post - either Development Assistant or Development Assistant (Hindi)
  • Admission to examination purely provisional without verification of documents
  • NABARD reserves right to increase/reduce vacancies or cancel recruitment process
  • Valid personal email ID and mobile number mandatory (kept active till completion of recruitment)
  • DigiLocker integration available for voluntary document upload
  • Only one application per post - multiple applications will result in retention of last valid application only
  • Biometric data (thumb impression) and photograph capture from Main Examination onwards

  • TDS as admissible shall be deducted from the monthly remuneration of Jr. Professional Interns . A TDS certificate shall be issued by the concerned department on demand.
  • Jr. Professional Intern shall be eligible for Casual Leave of 20 Days in a calendar year on pro- rata basis. MbPA would be free to terminate the services of Jr. Professional Intern in case of absence of more than 15 days beyond the entitled leave. No carry forward of the unconsumed leave as also no encashment of leave would be allowed.
  • As regards accommodation facility, accommodation at MbPA quarters can be provided, subject to availability of accommodation in the category of Class III B quarters and on the personnel engaged. The rent payable for accommodation will be @10% of consolidated remuneration and single licence fees per month. In addition, electricity & water charges would be recovered on actual consumption basis. In case accommodation at MbPA Quarters is availed, a Security Deposit of amount equivalent to two times of rent payable per month, will have to be paid as a security against Rent, electricity, water charges and damages, if any.   • As regards, Medical facility, since MbPA has its own Hospital, OPD as well as IPD facility will be provided to contractual personnel at MbPA hospital/ dispensary along with medicines. However, the Jr. Professional Intern will not be referred outside for treatment. No medical facilities would be available to family/ dependent of the Jr. Professional Intern.
  • A candidate can apply for engagement only once during a financial year. The applicants who do not fulfill the eligibility conditions, their applications shall be rejected.
  • Applicants must clearly indicate their area(s) of interest.
  • Mere fulfillment of qualification or shortlisting shall not confer any right to be engaged as Jr. Professional Intern .

Eligibility Criteria

  • Project Engineer (MEP): BE/B.Tech (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical) with not less than 60% marks from recognised (AICTE) University.
  • Where percentage of marks is not awarded by the university but only CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA is awarded, it shall be converted into percentage as per conversion norms of the university.
  • Rounding off percentage will not be acceptable; 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%.
  • Minimum 2 years of post-qualification work experience in MEP in Government organization/Public Sector Undertaking or Public Limited Company as Project Engineer or equivalent as on date of issue of the vacancy notification.
  • An in-depth understanding of MEP System including HVAC components like air distribution and renewable energy systems, electrical systems such as power distribution, and plumbing knowledge for water system, storm drains, and gas piping.
  • Knowledge of tools like AutoCAD, Revit MEP software, MATLAB, and Simulink to create precise system designs and models.

Salary / Stipend

  • IDA Equivalent E1 grade Rs.40,000-1,40,000.
  • Basic Pay Rs.40,000/- per month.
  • Pay and perks include Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, Cafeteria of Allowances, House Rent Allowance, Consolidated Travelling Allowance, Provident Fund (employer's share) etc.
  • Other entitlements like mobile phone, laptop, sodexo etc are as per the policy of the corporation.
  • Pay protection will be given to candidates working in IDA E1 grade as Project Engineer or equivalent in the relevant field.
  • PF and Income Tax and any other incidental recovery will be deducted from Gross Salary as per extant rules.
  • Medical facility as per the policy of the corporation.
  • Leave: Casual Leave 8 days p.a.; Restricted Holidays 2 days p.a.; 10 days sick leave for six months (like Half pay leave with provision for commutation); 12 days special leave per annum.

Age Limit 

  • The upper age should not exceed 30 years as on the date of issue of Vacancy Notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of issue of Vacancy Notification 05/01/2026
Last date for submission of application by mail 04/02/2026
Cut-off date for eligibility 05/01/2026

Selection Process

  • After preliminary screening of the applications received from candidates by mail, the eligible candidates will only be called for document verification and interaction.
  • If large number of eligible applicants are received, candidates equal to 15 times the notified vacancies only may be called for document verification and interaction based on their engineering marks and experience.
  • The candidate will be interviewed by a nominated Committee, and the selection will be finalized on merit basis, on the performance in the interview, qualification and post qualification experience.
  • The candidate must qualify with minimum 60% marks in the Personal Interview.
  • The decision of the Nominated Committee of MRVC shall be final and binding.
  • The period of contract will be initially for a period of two years, extendable on yearly basis on satisfactory performance and mutual consent, and may be renewed on a fresh contract on year-to-year basis.
  • Panel of standby candidates over and above requirement will be maintained as per merit as decided by MRVC, and such candidates may be engaged as per requirements of MRVC projects within the validity of panel.

General Information / Instructions

  • The selected candidates will have to serve the Corporation for at least two years for which he/she should execute a Surety Bond of Rs.1 Lakh in favour of Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. on Rs.500/- stamp paper.
  • The candidate should have sound health and, before joining, will have to undergo medical examination and produce the certificate of fitness for job issued by a doctor (at least MBBS).
  • The candidates must bring original application, original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies in proof of age, caste, educational qualification with all semester mark sheets and experience on the date of document verification and interaction.
  • Formula of aggregate percentage calculation of Degree (CGPA/OGPA etc.) is to be attached with application.
  • Candidates must bring one character certificate from Gazetted Officers/Executive Officers certifying good moral character (not older than six months).
  • Incomplete or vague educational qualification will be invalid.
  • Even after contractual agreement, if any document/certificate/information is found incorrect or false, the contractual agreement will be immediately terminated without prior notice and legal action may be initiated.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the contract engagement process without prior notice and without assigning any reasons.
  • No travelling/DA will be paid to any candidate for appearing for document verification and interaction.
  • The selected candidates should be able to join at the project site within maximum 45 days after issue of offer of appointment by MRVC.
  • The candidate selected on contractual agreement shall not be absorbed in MRVC regular service and shall not have right to claim for permanent absorption in MRVC.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to terminate the contract if the contract appointee is found unsuitable, by giving one month notice or payment in lieu thereof; similarly, the appointee will be required to give one month notice to MRVC for termination.
  • The selected candidate on engagement should also attend emergencies and other calls of duties during their day-to-day activities.
  • If the appointee is found involved in undesirable activities such as embezzlement, unlawful activities, unauthorized absence, in-subordination or breach of any terms of contract, the contract appointment shall be terminated.
  • Selected candidates shall use electronic resources of MRVC in strict adherence to the policies and guidelines issued by MRVC from time to time.
  • Upon termination or expiry of contract, the contract appointee shall return to MRVC any property belonging to MRVC including tools, documents, passwords, user IDs and all confidential information.
  • Contract appointee will be responsible for the acts and omissions in the course of contractual service during the period and thereafter.

How to Apply

  • Duly filled in application should be sent to Senior Manager (HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. by email on [email protected].
  • Last date for submission of application by mail is 04.02.2026.
  • The cut-off date for eligibility is 05.01.2026.
  • Applications should be complete in all respects and strictly as per the prescribed format (Annexure-I).
  • Applications not conforming to the prescribed format or having illegible/ambiguous certificates or without certificates or incomplete will be summarily rejected.
  • Self-attested copies of certificates of qualification, proof of date of birth, photo ID proof, experience documents and character certificate from Gazetted Officer/Executive Officer must be attached.
  • Recommended documents include employment letters from previous and present employers, Form 16 and document indicating Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Number/PF Number.

  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate
  • No TA/DA will be provided for attending the exam or interview

  • Step 2: On the homepage, locate the "Recruitment" or "Career" section
  • Step 3: Click on the relevant recruitment notification link for NMMC Recruitment 2025
  • Step 4: Read the detailed notification and instructions carefully
  • Step 5: Click on "Apply Online" button to start the application process
  • Step 6: Register yourself by providing basic details like name, email ID, and mobile number
  • Step 7: After registration, login using the credentials received on your email/mobile
  • Step 8: Fill the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and other required details
  • Step 9: Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and other required documents in prescribed format and size
  • Step 10: Pay the application fee online through available payment modes (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI)
  • Step 11: Review all the entered information carefully before final submission
  • Step 12: Submit the application form and take a printout of the confirmation page for future reference
  • Step 13: Keep the payment receipt and application confirmation safe until the recruitment process is complete

1. What is the starting date to apply for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

2. What is the last apply date for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

3. What is the Eligibility to apply for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Eligibility varies by post. For Junior Engineer posts, Diploma in relevant engineering is required. For medical posts, MBBS with respective post-graduate qualification is mandatory. For administrative posts, Graduate degree with relevant qualifications is required.

4. What is the Maximum Age Limit to apply for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

  • Consultant (Administration): Officials retired from Level - 8 (as per 7th CPC) or above from Central Government Service / Central Autonomous bodies and having experience in General Administration, GFR, FRSR, RTI, GeM, CCS (Conduct) Rules, Purchase, Stores, Legal matters etc.

Salary/ Stipend

  • A fixed monthly remuneration shall be admissible and shall remain fixed during the entire period of contract.
  • In case of Retired employees who are drawing pension (as per CCS Pension Rules), the fixed monthly remuneration shall be arrived at by deducting basic pension (before commuting any pension) from the pay drawn in the Pay Matrix at the time of retirement plus Transport Allowance (TA) including DA on TA as was applicable to the appointee at the time of retirement.
  • In case of Retired employees who are not drawing pension (as per CCS Pension Rules), the fixed monthly remuneration shall be arrived at by taking 50% of their Basic Pay drawn at the time of retirement plus Transport Allowance (TA) including DA on TA as was applicable to the appointee at the time of retirement.
  • No House Rent Allowance or any other allowance shall be admissible during the period of contract. However, retired employee engaged as consultant will be allowed TA/DA on official tour, if any, as per their entitlement at the time of retirement.

Age Limit

Salary / Stipend

  • Stringers will be paid for coverages, irrespective of the length of footage or its usage, but inclusive of transportation and delivery charges.
  • (i) local coverage of duration of less than 6 Hours @ Rs. 1500 per coverage, and in case duration of 6 Hours is exceeded or when it involves locations apart from more than 10 kms, it will be treated as two coverages and the 2nd coverage will be paid @ Rs. 1,000.

Application Fee

Selection Process

  • Proof of ownership of the equipment must be submitted at the time of the interview, if shortlisted.
  • A physical verification of the equipment and documents will be done on the day of the interview.
  • A test coverage assignment will be given to all applicants for their submission to RNU before their interview date.
  • Submission of the test coverage assignment on time is essential for being called for the interview.

General Information / Instructions

  • Empanelled Stringers are expected to do news coverages and short features on news, current affairs, sports, business and other subjects. Applicants preferably equipped with four-wheel vehicles, should have qualifications, experience, and expertise in cinematography/videography/ news-gathering / broadcast journalism. Details of other terms and conditions prescribed in Guidelines issued by Directorate General, Doordarshan, New Delhi vide their Memo No. 3/4/2003-P-III dated 02.07.2010 are available in the Annexure to this notification.
  • Stringers should have adequate facilities and equipment to undertake the coverage.
  • The coverages by a stringer should contain all elements of a news story. For each coverage, the stringer should provide raw footage, press material and a script. Stringers should not only cover assigned tasks but also alert the RNU on major news fall/breaking stories/stories of interest in their area. The Panel of Stringers shall be revised every two years.

Stringers will be removed from the panel on all or any of the following grounds:

  1. When the Stringer refuses to cover the assigned coverages on two or more occasions;
  2. If the coverages are poor in content or in technical quality (poor audio quality, noisy video, variation in luminance level, defocused pictures, etc.);
  3. Delay in providing timely coverage;
  4. When the Stringer is suspected of subcontracting the assigned work to others;
  5. If the Stringers are found to be operating a cartel system among themselves;
  6. If the information furnished by the Stringer in the application form for empanelment is found to be incorrect.
  7. Any act on the part of the stringer that creates embarrassment to Prasar Bharati.

  • Separate Annexures can also be given along with the application detailing the experience or qualifications of the applicant and the team, if required.

Eligibility Criteria

  • ME/M. Tech/Equivalent Degree OR
  • Post Graduate Degree in Science/Computer Application or in relevant Domain with 60% or equivalent CGPA OR
  • PhD. in relevant discipline

in  Computer Science and Engineering and aligned branches - AI, data science, cybersecurity, IoT, etc., or Information Security, or Electronics & Communication Engineering or Electrical Engineering

 Age Limit and Relaxation

  • Maximum Age limit: 56 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Upper Age limit will be as specified against each post

Applicants belonging to reserved category (SC/ST/OBC) / physically challenged/Ex-servicemen could be eligible for relaxations according to the ‘Government of India’ norms.

 Government employees on payscale will be eligible for relaxation in age by 5 years including  other  age relaxations as applicable.

 The cut-off date for ascertaining the age and experience will be Last Date of submission of    application.

Candidates seeking age relaxation need to submit a copy of caste certificate when called for document verification.  

 SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/ certificate and any other valid document will be considered as proof of date of birth.

The Economically Weaker Section’s Certificate should be strictly in the format prescribed by DoPT.  The format is available on the website www.persmin.nic.in

The application of the candidates not meeting the prescribed age criteria will be reject/cancelled without any prior intimation.

Candidates belonging to OBC category (Non creamy layer) should produce the certificate issued in prescribed format.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is charged by C-DAC for applying to this advertisement.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date: 01-02-2026
  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 01-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 20-02-2026
  • Interview Dates: Will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other    forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC

How to Apply

  • Before filling the online application form, Candidates should read General Terms and Conditions carefully.
  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.
  • On filling the correct OTP, the applicant will be directed to fill in the application form. In case you have filled in an application in our previous advertisement, the applicant will receive a prefilled editable application.
  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)
  • A unique application number will be generated by the system, please note this application number for future reference and use. Candidates can take a print of the application form and keep it with them for their own records.
  • No hard copy/printed applications should be sent to C-DAC. Incomplete and defectively filled online forms shall be rejected straightway and no subsequent correspondences will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Govt. Autonomous bodies should also apply online in advance and print of the application form, duly filled and signed should be forwarded through proper channel to HRD Section, C-DAC, Bangalore.
  • Those who are not forwarding their application through proper channel are required to produce 'No objection certificate (NOC)' from their current employer at the time of interview, if called for, failing which they will not be permitted to attend the interview.
  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Academic Qualifications: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised University or any equivalent qualification recognised as such by the Central Government including Integrated Dual Degree (IDD). Candidates possessing qualifications such as Medical, Engineering, Chartered Accountant, Cost Accountant would also be eligible.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience as on 31.12.2025 as an officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank or any Regional Rural Bank as listed in Second Schedule of Reserve Bank of India.
  • Salary Requirement: Candidates having experience in Scheduled Commercial Banks other than Public Sector Banks/Regional Rural Banks shall be drawing minimum annual gross salary of Rs. 9.50 lacs for each year and shall provide documentary evidence for their annual gross salary such as Form-16/Annual Income Statement (AIS)/pay slips for last 24 months or certificate from employer.
  • Local Language: Candidates applying for vacancies of a particular Circle should be proficient (reading, writing and understanding) in any one of the specified opted local language of that Circle.
  • Exclusions: Candidates working with subsidiaries of Scheduled Commercial Banks, candidates working in SBI in clerical/supervisory cadre, employees engaged on contract basis, and candidates who have resigned from officer grade in SBI/Associate Banks will not be eligible to apply.
  • CIBIL Status: Candidates who have defaulted in repayment under any lending arrangement with Banks or NBFCs including credit card dues and have not regularised/repaid their outstanding are not eligible for appointment.
  • Character & Antecedents: Candidates against whom there is/are adverse report regarding character & antecedents, moral turpitude are not eligible to apply for the post.

  • Maximum Age: 30 years (candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.01.1996)
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 Years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (SC/ST): 15 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (OBC): 13 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (Gen/EWS): 10 Years
  • Age Relaxation for Eligible Ex-Servicemen: 5 Years
  • Note: Cumulative age relaxation will not be available either under the above items or in combination with any other items.

SC/ST/PwBD Nil

Selection Process

  • Phase 1 - Online Examination: Online test will consist of Objective Tests for 120 marks and Descriptive Test for 50 marks. The duration of objective test is 2 hours consisting of 4 Sections - English Language (30 marks, 30 minutes), Banking Knowledge (40 marks, 40 minutes), General Awareness/Economy (30 marks, 30 minutes), and Computer Aptitude (20 marks, 20 minutes). The Descriptive Test (30 minutes) will be a Test of English Language (Letter Writing & Essay) for total 50 marks.
  • Phase 2 - Screening: The Screening Committee will examine whether candidates fulfil the required eligibility criteria of experience and match the job profile submitted by candidates with the job profile of Scale-I Generalist Officer of State Bank of India. Candidates numbering up to 3 times (approx.) of the Circle wise and Category wise vacancies will be called for interview from the top of the merit list.
  • Phase 3 - Interview: Interview will consist of 50 marks. Candidates will have to score minimum qualifying marks in interview to be considered for final selection.
  • Phase 4 - Local Language Proficiency Test: Test of knowledge of specified opted local language will be conducted for provisionally selected candidates before joining the Bank. Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language will not be required to undergo the language test.
  • Final Selection: Final merit list is prepared based on normalization of marks scored in Online Test and Interview with 75:25 weightage respectively. Marks secured by candidates in Online Test (out of 170 marks) are converted to out of 75 marks and Interview scores (out of 50 marks) are converted to out of 25 marks.

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidate will have to apply for vacancy of one Circle only. A candidate applying against vacancy of one Circle will not be eligible to apply against vacancy of any other Circle.

  • Selected candidates will be posted in the Circle against whose vacancy they are selected.
  • The selected candidates will not be entitled for Inter-Circle transfer/Corporate Centre Posting/Corporate Centre Establishment Posting/Foreign Posting up to his/her promotion to SMGS-IV Grade OR 12 years of service, whichever is later.
  • On joining, the selected candidates will be designated as "Circle Based Officers" (CBOs) and will be on probation for a period of 6 months from their joining the Bank.
  • The CBOs will be subjected to continuous assessment during probation period for judging their suitability for confirmation.
  • Reservation for Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates is horizontal and will be guided by various guidelines of Government of India. Only those persons with benchmark disabilities (not less than 40% of a specified disability) would be eligible for reservation.

  • Bank will arrange pre-examination training (PET) in online mode for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates in consonance with the guidelines issued by Government of India.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.

  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information / Instructions

  • Reservation for Economically Weaker Section (EWS) in recruitment is governed by Office Memorandum no. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dt. 31.01.2019 of Department of Personnel & Training, Ministry of Personnel (DoPT), Public Grievance & Pensions, Government of India. EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further directives of Government of India and outcome of any litigation. The appointment is provisional and is subject to the income & Asset certificate being verified through the proper channels. Benefit of reservation under EWS category can be availed upon production of an ‘Income and Asset Certificate’ issued by a Competent Authority in the format prescribed by Government of India. Candidates may please note that they should be in possession of Income and Assets Certificate as mentioned above issued on or after 01.04.2025 and before the date of document verification at the time of interview. Candidates qualifying for interview under EWS category would be required to submit EWS certificate, at the time of interview. In case candidates fail to produce the same at the time of interview, they will not be allowed to appear for interview. Further, their request for interview under General category will also not be entertained.
  • NOTE: Reservations are applicable as per prevailing Government of India (GoI) guidelines.
  • All the eligibility [age, educational qualification etc.] shall be computed as mentioned in subsequent paragraphs.
  • Candidates should possess excellent communication skills and should be proficient in the use of computers and information technology.
